tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

matches.line: description: "dsh 的浏览器 GUI：交互式聊天、模型与设置管理、会话历史，供运行 dsh web 表层的用户使用。"

运行 `dsh --profile web`，获得浏览器内的聊天、模型与设置管理以及会话历史，并与其他 dsh 表层共用同一套模型访问、工具与安全默认值。启动时会打印带 token 的 URL，通常还会在默认浏览器中打开；SSH 会话和 `--no-open` 需要手动打开。你可以更改端口、允许额外 authority、绑定一个具体的本机 IP，并用自己提供的证书直接提供 HTTPS；通配地址会被拒绝。跨机访问使用剥离前缀代理后公告的 HTTP(S) URL、监听器 TLS，或非 loopback 绑定上的明文 HTTP。一次性的命令行任务应使用 headless 配置。

启动后你会看到 `dsh web:` 行，其根 URL 携带新的进程 token。除非 `--no-open` 或 SSH 会话抑制，否则默认浏览器会打开该 URL、取得签名 cookie，再重定向到不含认证参数的同一目录。页面加载且你可以与 agent 对话，就说明成功了。两种可预期的失败：前端未构建时，启动会以构建提示停止（checkout 中运行 `pnpm run build`）；浏览器无法打开时，stderr 会打印不含凭据的诊断，但服务器会继续运行——请自行打开已打印的启动 URL。

`minimal` agent preset 使用持久 Shell、`read_image` 工具和固定 persona，支持自动历史压缩以及会话空闲时的 `/compact` 命令。它复用 Host token meter，并拥有隔离的压缩后端。[压缩配置与保留策略](../../compaction/compaction-basic/README.zh.md#use-this-package) 沿用现有后端。图片读取复用 Host 文件系统和附件存储，要求模型支持图片输入；不加载文本读取、写入和编辑工具。

默认情况下 GUI 只监听 loopback，只接受本机的连接。只有 `--host` 会改变监听器：它接受一个具体的本机 IPv4 或 IPv6 地址，不接受通配地址。未启用 TLS 的非 loopback 监听器提供明文 HTTP，并在启动时警告，即使前置 HTTPS 的 `--public-url` 也不例外。Host/Origin 栅栏接受绑定 IP 本身；其他非 loopback authority 需要 `--trusted-host`，因此远端浏览器要么经由剥离前缀的代理访问 GUI，要么通过以可信主机名呈现的端口转发客户端访问。启动 token 交换与签名会话 cookie 认证每个 API 方法与 WebSocket 流。

同时传入 `--tls-cert` 与 `--tls-key`，监听器便以 HTTPS 而非明文 HTTP 提供服务。两者各指定一个相对进程工作目录解析的文件：证书文件包含完整证书链，密钥文件为不带口令的 PEM 私钥。它们属于同一个设置——只提供一个会报用法错误，两个都不提供则保持明文 HTTP 默认值。文件缺失、不可读、为空，或不是有效的证书与密钥对时启动失败；绝不回退到 HTTP。监听器运行期间不会重新读取这些材料，因此更换证书需要重新加载监听器或重启进程。DSH 不签发、不续期也不监视任何证书：没有 ACME 客户端、没有自签名兜底，也没有重定向监听器。浏览器使用自己的信任库与主机名匹配，因此浏览器不信任的证书，或其 subject alternative name 未覆盖你所访问 authority 的证书，会在页面加载前失败。默认端口仍为 3080，且 `--tls-cert`/`--tls-key` 不跟随 `--public-url`：监听器的证书覆盖浏览器实际访问的 authority。TLS 不改变授权模型：Connection 仍认证每个请求并仍校验 Host/Origin，且只要接收请求的监听器提供 HTTPS，它所签发的会话 cookie 就带 `Secure`。
### 按会话的 agent 设置
每个浏览器会话选择一个随发行版交付的 preset（默认 `standard`）。Agent 预设设置页可更改默认项并编辑预设的子插件；保存结果持久化到 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`。只有 Host 提供可编辑的 profile 时，Creator 的插件管理工具才会启用。

patch 会替换目标行的整个 `config`，因此每个 Web 行都重述自己拥有的每个键：基础行上的 persona 前缀模板、`DSH_TOOLS_MODE` PTC mode 开关与 `session-query-sqlite` 值，随后 `insert` 添加 Web 宿主行、传输层与浏览器名录。`webserver`、`web-runtime` 与 `connection` 行都注入 `webStartup` 提供方并直接读取本次调用的取值；Connection 的被接受 authority 全部来自 `ctx.webStartup.trustedHosts`，Host/Origin 栅栏则独立于该列表接受监听器的绑定 IP。base 以进程级挂载的按 agent 工具行在这里被禁用，由 preset 名录接管；每项宿主层与 preset 层归属决策的理由以行内注释写在 patch 里。
这些限制告诉你在不常见的环境下会遇到什么——源码 checkout、SSH 会话或严格网络。它们是当前包约束，不是通用的浏览器对比或任务积压。
- **SSH 会话保留 URL 但跳过浏览器交接**——没有公告根时，打印的 URL 指向远端宿主机的绑定地址；SSH 客户端或编辑器必须暴露并打开本地转发地址。

lines.text: description: "面向 Session Controller 列表、交互状态与逐会话上下文的 React 与 Slot 适配器。"

使用本包可通过标准 Slot 钩子公开 Session catalog、retain 信息与统一 UI 状态。它按 `SessionBinding` 物化钩子和 prop，而 `SessionProvider` 可以继承外围 binding 或绑定显式 `SessionReference`。它拥有进程本地的 pending-interaction 与完成提醒策略，但不拥有 Controller transport、历史或 reference。
运行状态来自 Host 列表基线或状态事件。Subagent 目录行和已保留子会话的 fallback 行不会建立运行状态；主视图引用仍会确认完成提醒。

本包注入 Client `remoteAccess` 服务，并在其 `source()` 之上发布会话访问 Hook：根作用域的 `useSessionAccess(sessionId, action)` 回答某一个 Session 资源上的访问，Session 作用域的 `useAccess(action)` 回答所绑定 Session 资源上的访问；`global` 资源上的答案是另一个 Hook `useRemoteAccess(action)`，两者互不遮蔽。SessionMaybe 作用域的 `useAccess(action)` 在未绑定 Session 时返回 `undefined`，调用方将其视为不允许；需要 `global` 资源上的判断时读 `useRemoteAccess`。快照语义归 [`dsh-api-remote-access`](../../api/remote-access/README.zh.md#client-face)。
无，因为本包适配浏览器侧 Session 状态，不注册任何面向模型的内容。
无；Session selector 与 Slot scope 不会组装模型请求。
- **Pending interaction 是进程本地投影**——浏览器重连后，所属 Remote waterfall（瀑布式事件）必须重放仍未完成的请求。

matches.line: 本包让用户浏览分组或扁平的 Session 列表、为新 Session 选择 Workspace，并通过添加、重命名、重排序、搜索、fork、归档和删除 Workspace 来管理 Workspace 与 Session；Session 行菜单及其悬停按钮是可由客户端插件扩展的 slot 列表。待处理交互显示为警告点，subagent 来源的 Session 则保持隐藏。处于空闲状态且未归档、其 Session 有活动定时任务的 Session 行会显示时钟标记，其悬浮卡片会列出这些任务。规范化后仍有差异的文件夹路径会保留为独立 Workspace。添加 Workspace 需要组合目录选择器；没有目录选择器时，添加操作不可用。
分组和平铺视图都先显示置顶 Session，再显示普通 Session。**最近更新**在各分区内严格按最近一次用户提示词或 steering（中途引导）时间降序排列，置顶时间不影响它。**手动排序**使用同一条完整 Session 序列中的相对位置，包括隐藏的归档项。返回最近更新会丢弃手动布局，再次进入手动排序时冻结当时的时间顺序。浏览器默认采用最近更新，并在重新加载后记住所选模式。

置顶把 Session 移到完整保存序列的首位，但不切换所选模式。它在手动模式下排在置顶区最前，在最近更新模式下则不一定。取消置顶不改变保存的位置。拖拽置顶行或普通行都修改同一条完整序列并选择手动模式，隐藏的归档成员始终保留。缺失的置顶成员按置顶数组顺序补到头部。新增的普通 fork 在完整序列中插在来源之前，不继承置顶成员关系；可见置顶行仍排在普通行之前。其他缺失成员按最近更新时间追加，缺失归档项放在最后。补齐仅在内存中完成，直到一次 Session 顺序写入保存完整结果。单纯切换归档筛选既不改变保存的位置，也不改变成员关系。
层级仅使用已注册的规范路径，不扫描项目，也不解析符号链接别名。嵌套不会改变 Session 的工作目录、日志或 Workspace 归属。删除父 Workspace 后，子 Workspace 仍保持注册，并归入下一个已注册祖先；没有祖先时显示在根层级。

折叠搜索是视图和添加操作旁的一枚区头按钮：激活后输入框会扩展并占据区头。非空白查询会以单一扁平结果列表替代任一浏览模式——不区分大小写的标题和 Workspace 子串匹配项会立即显示，经 250 ms 防抖的 Host 请求则会加入经过排序的当前对话内容匹配项及其摘要片段。每次新查询都会中止前一个请求；内容搜索失败时，元数据匹配项仍会显示，不另给警告。列表最多显示 20 条结果。选择未归档结果会清空并收起搜索、打开 Session，并在当前浏览模式中将其行滚动到可见区域；分组浏览还会按需展开所属 Workspace 和完整 Session 列表。已归档结果提供取消归档操作；尝试打开时会说明限制，不清空查询，也不导航。

Session 行内的 Rename 操作打开一个以该行显示标题预填的对话框；确认未修改的标题是有意允许的——这正是把当前自动标题钉住、不再被重新生成覆盖的手势。双击标题也会打开 Rename；对于未归档 Session，先发生的点击会打开其对话。Rename 使用临时 `workspaceOperation` reference，并等待首次历史打开。行内 Fork 正常读取普通冷历史。Host 报告源会话需要迁移时，应用级 Toast 提供打开该会话的操作；该操作仅导航，不重试 fork。成功的 fork 在源会话最后一个已完成轮次处创建分支，通过 Session Controller 递增继承的持久化标题，不 retain 子会话、不打开其历史，也不改变选择。Workspace 行内的 Delete 操作会打开确认框，说明保留边界；成功后该分组被移除，其 Session 则留在 Ungrouped 下。Pin、Rename、Fork、Archive 和复制 Session ID 本身就是 `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` 列表的条目（pin 与 archive 同时也是 `sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action` 的条目），因此客户端插件的 action 由其 `order` 决定落在哪个位置。

对静止的 Session，Archive 不经确认对话框直接提交，并保留 Session 的记账位置。仍有工作在跑的 Session 是唯一会先询问的情形：Host 拒绝普通归档并列出这些工作，侧栏随即打开"停止并归档"对话框，按族列出——进行中的回合、运行中的子代理、后台任务、定时提醒，各带名称——并写明恢复路径；确认后请 Host 按停止按钮同样的方式停止这些工作，归档集合持久化后即完成归档，停止在后台收敛；取消则让 Session 继续运行并保持可见。视图选项以一组显式三选一控制显隐：隐藏已归档（默认项）隐藏已归档 Session，全部对话（显示已归档）将其纳入列表，仅显示已归档则隐藏普通 Session，并丢弃没有归档 Session 的 Workspace；树形分组下，被丢弃 Workspace 的子级挂到最近一个仍显示的祖先下。可见的归档行置灰，并提供无障碍说明，告知取消归档后才能打开；Rename、Fork 与取消归档仍然可用。归档成功后的提示提供"撤销"动作，并在归档行仍被隐藏时附带"筛选已归档会话"动作，后者直接把筛选切到全部对话（显示已归档）；停止并归档显示同样的提示但措辞不同，撤销只恢复 Session，不会让被停止的工作继续。取消归档移除归档标记，但不恢复置顶，也不改变保存的位置。列表为空时显示居中的"图标在上、文字在下"占位；仅显示已归档视图用自己的文案（暂无已归档会话），并附"查看其他会话"文字按钮，点击把筛选切回隐藏已归档。
会话更新时间使用 tertiary 文本色，包括已归档行。标题宽于所在行时，静止状态以省略号裁切。把指针停在行上，标题会滚动到远端——例如 fork 递增后的标题——并在揭示时不显示省略号；指针离开后标题回到开头。

快捷键速查提供新建会话、搜索会话、添加工作区、重命名会话、分叉会话和归档会话。桌面默认使用平台的主修饰键，搜索为 Mod+K；Windows 和 macOS Web 使用[快捷键服务的平台默认值](../shortcuts/README.zh.md)；Linux Web 在用户配置前不绑定这些命令。按钮提示和会话行菜单显示当前有效绑定。点击菜单项操作该行，按快捷键操作主会话。Desktop 和 Windows/macOS Web 的重命名均使用 Mod+Alt+G，将 Mod+Shift+R 留给浏览器刷新。重命名要求主区域正在显示非空会话，且没有模态对话框遮挡；切换到其他主面板后，后台保留的会话不可作为重命名目标。其他 Windows 和 macOS Desktop 绑定也可从终端输入区域和模态对话框中执行；其他环境遵循命令的区域和模态限制。搜索和重命名的打开请求归本包管理，输入草稿保留在浏览器中。目录选择或工作区接纳尚未结束时，目录选择器拒绝重复打开。分叉捕获主视图已持有并发起历史打开的会话，保留自动迁移；它使用与行菜单相同的 Host 操作选择最近已完成轮次，不读取更早的 Client 历史。没有会话或会话为空时不可用；没有已完成轮次的源会话由 Host 拒绝。快捷键分叉被拒绝时保留当前选择、显示本地化提示，并允许重试；非预期失败还会保留诊断日志。该提示共用应用级 Workspace 通知通道：只显示最新提示，移除浏览区域不会关闭它。

Session 行渲染运行时的实时 `pendingInteraction` 分类：审批显示**等待审批**，计划审阅显示**计划待审**，普通问题显示**等待回答**。交互待处理期间，该行使用共享 warning 橙点，并以**待批准**、**计划待审**或**待回答**替换尾部更新时间；悬停详情仍保留完整状态和相对时间。待处理交互的优先级高于共享 ongoing loading；已完成但未查看的 Session 使用 done，idle 在行内不显示点，在悬停详情中使用共享 idle 灰点。 行首 seat 仅在该行的主状态为 idle 时渲染——没有待处理交互、没有自身或后代活动、也没有未查看的完成提醒——因此该处的占用方不会与行自身的状态点同时出现。归档行该格整体留空：既不显示状态点也不挂 seat，其活动状态只出现在悬浮卡片上。

当成组的与平铺的 Session 行所对应的 Session 存在活动定时任务时，该行显示时钟标记。它是行首 `sidebar.session.row.leading` seat 的占用方，因此仅在该行主状态为 idle 时渲染，绝不与行自身的状态点同时出现；归档行该格同样留空，搜索结果没有该 seat，也不显示标记。它不是按钮，没有 Tab stop，点击其所在区域不会打开整行。标记自身的读取及其「活动」条件的确切含义由 [ui-schedule](../ui-schedule/README.zh.md) 负责。

`ctx.uiWorkspace.openSession(target)` 会同步替换其拥有的 `mainView` reference，并让主区域返回 Conversation，而不等待 `reference.ready`，因此历史加载会显示在已经选中的 Session 视图内。目标可以是已知 Session id，也可以是持久的直接父子 subagent 地址；显式地址不要求预先加载 parent catalog。`openWorkspace(id, beforeOpen?, options?)` 仅在请求未被后续导航替代时打开工作区空白 Session；显式新会话操作会创建新的 Session。`forkSession(id)` 创建子会话，不导航，也不替代尚未完成的导航。可选的同步准备回调在目标被 retain 后执行，并且仅对仍有效的 Workspace 请求执行，因此过期请求不会搬移 composer 草稿。后续导航或 owner 释放会阻止晚到的 UI 提交，但不取消底层 Session 创建。启动恢复会 retain 主 reference，不改变已选面板，也不取消后续导航。归档主 Session 会释放其 reference 并清除主选择。选择失败时保留当前全局面板。Session 行读取 `usePanelInfo`，在全局面板活跃时不显示 Session 选中样式；仅把焦点移到搜索框或目录选择器不会离开该面板。

首次使用的目录名与其存储标题都是固定的，都不跟随读者语言：`workspaces.initializeDefault` 不携带任何名称，同一安装环境在切换语言后仍只有一个磁盘路径和一个存储标题。仍保留该自动标题的工作区，在本包展示它的所有位置——侧栏行及其悬浮卡片、搜索结果元信息、hero 选择器菜单、重命名与删除对话框——都通过控制器的 `workspaceDisplayTitle` 显示为本地化的默认名称。重命名对话框以屏幕上的标签作为初值，而判断确认是否需要保存用的是存储标题，因此对这类工作区直接确认未改动的初值即可固定该名称，该行不再跟随语言；重名检查按工作区身份而非标题排除目标自身。

浏览器入口还为每个 Session 行声明两个 root 作用域的 `list` 子 slot：`sidebar.session.row.leading` 仅在该行主状态为 idle 时渲染、归档行留空，`sidebar.session.row.hover` 仅在该行的悬浮卡片打开时挂载。两者只接收行的 Session 身份，占用方据此读取自己的数据；Session 作用域的 slot 会强制建立 Session 绑定，从而激活并保留列表中每个 Session。

客户端调用方可以在 `uiWorkspace.startSession` 的第二参数中传入 `prompt` 与 `clearPreviousDraft`。提示词仅接受普通文字；结构化草稿由内部恢复和工作区携带流程处理。不清空时保留已有文字或附件；显式清空只替换目标 Session 的文字和内联引用，不删除附件。在异步创建前捕获选项值，在导航提交前应用到准确保留的 binding。已被后续操作取代的导航不写内容；输入处于提交阻塞状态时拒绝准备并保留原选择。不传选项时按当前 Agent 预设定义创建新的 Session。工作区重连和显式草稿准备仍可复用已有空 Session。[草稿初始化决策](../../../.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-09-30-structured-draft-initialization.zh.md)说明输入 owner 的数据流。

条目只接收行身份（`sessionId`、`displayTitle`），其余一切自己负责：用自己注入的 hook 读自己关心的 Host 状态（置顶与归档集合，以每次 Workspace 快照只派生一次的 Set 形式），自己决定是否显示（Host 规定归档与置顶互斥，所以 pin 在归档行上不渲染；`useSessionAccess(sessionId, 'session/fork')` 为 false 时 fork 不渲染），整套行为放在注册项自己的 `inject` face 里（置顶成功后顺带把会话推到保存顺序最前，归档成功后发提示），浮层也自己带——重命名对话框、停止并归档对话框和行 action 的提示是本包注册在 `shell.overlay` 的条目，由 action 注入的请求驱动。菜单条目渲染一个 `role="menuitem"` 的按钮（本包自己的行用 ui-primitives 的 `MenuItemButton`，它带宿主样式，开启新分组的行加 `separatorBefore`，分隔线随行一起出现和消失），并通过 slot 级 `useMenuOpenState` hook（菜单自身的打开状态，从该行的渲染出现处绑定）关闭菜单；悬停按钮条目渲染一个图标按钮，按钮条会拦住点击、不让它打开该行。browser 不再向行传任何 action 回调，它剩下的动作只有搜索结果里的恢复按钮和标题双击，后者发出的是同一个重命名请求。
现有通知浮层按通知 kind 分派 `workspace.toast`。各 keyed 注册注入本地化展示映射与自己的操作，只有归档通知订阅查看筛选状态。它们渲染包内的 `workspace.toast.content` Factory，所有展示共用一处 Toast primitive。现有通知状态、显示序号、最新提示替换及关闭逻辑仍共享；语言或筛选变化不会重新启动同一条提示的计时。

Workspace 基线就绪后，浏览器持久化的展开状态和 Session 顺序记录只保留当前 Workspace id、Ungrouped 和单列表记账。`WorkspaceView.sessionIds` 提供真实 Workspace 的成员关系，而不提供 Session 显示顺序。视图操作接收完整记账顺序，而不是筛选后的行。尚无 Session 摘要的新成员会等待摘要，已保存的位置则在摘要暂时缺失时保留。归档显隐仅在派生行时应用。置顶和拖拽写入完整顺序，普通派生不执行写入。当前选中的空白 Session 仍是一次显式位置写入；Workspace 重连时同样如此，此时保留其他已保存成员，直到基线确定成员关系。侧边栏收成窄栏或搜索替代列表主体时，排序仍保持挂载。最近更新从当前摘要派生，不读取已保存位置；时间相同时按 Session id 稳定排序。

Workspace 与 Session 悬浮卡片会复制对应行被截断的值：激活 Workspace 卡片会写入其完整目录路径，激活非空白 Session 卡片则会写入其完整显示标题。临时的空白「新会话」卡片保持只读，因为其本地化标签是占位文案，并非会话内容。 Session 卡片在卡片打开期间还会在相对时间与行尾状态行之间渲染 `sidebar.session.row.hover` seat，与行自身状态无关。同一物理列表中的首张 Workspace 或 Session 卡片等待 800ms；实际显示一张后，移到该列表的其他 Workspace 或 Session 会立即替换卡片。列表与其当前活动的 portal 卡片构成一次指针交互：进入卡片阅读或复制后，移到相邻 Workspace 或 Session 仍会立即切换。指针离开两者后，共享等待在活动卡片通过原有指针宽限及关闭生命周期关闭时重置，不另设分组计时器。列表没有活动卡片时，指针离开便立即重置等待。小型操作提示与右侧悬浮卡片同时显示；置顶、归档、Workspace 新建会话及搜索结果取消归档的提示通过 portal 保持在卡片上层。悬停操作按钮（包括「更多」）保留卡片；打开「更多」菜单或开始拖拽 Session 会关闭卡片。
这些限制定义搜索深度、归档界面与选取载体；它们是当前包约束。
- **没有 Session 删除**：会话可以归档但绝不会被删除；已归档的行通过「已归档会话」视图筛选与搜索结果中的取消归档操作原位恢复，删除 Workspace 注册记录不会删除 Session。

Excellent. The authoritative answer:

- GUI: no delete; there's Archive (归档) via session row menu ("…" more menu) → 归档 (Archive). Keyboard shortcut too. Archived sessions view filter: 视图选项三选一 (隐藏已归档默认 / 全部对话 / 仅显示已归档). Rows greyed out, menu has 取消归档 (Unarchive).
- If a session still has running work, Host asks "停止并归档" dialog.
- Workspace deletion (删除工作区) only removes registration, not sessions or files.
- True deletion: not exposed anywhere in the app; the persistence backend has no delete API ("Nothing deletes session files — logs accumulate under root until removed externally"). So to truly reclaim disk, delete the folder manually: %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\sessions\<workspace-slug>\<session-id>\session.v4.jsonl.zstd, with DSH stopped / session not open. Also there may be an sqlite index (dsh-session-query-sqlite) that needs to be consistent — deleting files while running could leave stale index entries. Where's the sqlite db? Check $DSH_HOME/storages or sessions index files.

Let me verify:
1. The exact menu label wording in zh locale for the workspace client bundle: find keys like "sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.archive".
2. Whether the session query sqlite index exists at $DSH_HOME (storages?) and whether deleting file manually is safe.
3. Check shortcut for archive (Mod+... ). README mentions shortcuts list includes 归档会话.

Let me grep the workspace client for archive labels and any "删除" strings to confirm no session delete.

Also check index dir: list ~/.dsh/storages and look for sqlite files.

284: def parse_transcript(path):
285:     blocks = []
286:     current = None
287:     with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
288:         for raw in f:
289:             line = raw.rstrip("\n")
290:             if not line.strip():
291:                 continue
292:             m = re.match(r"^\[([A-Z0-9]+)\]\s*(.*)$", line.strip())
293:             if m:
294:                 kind, rest = m.group(1), m.group(2)
295:                 if kind in ("PAGE", "FIG"):
296:                     if kind == "FIG":
297:                         fm = FIG_RE.search(rest)
298:                         if fm:
299:                             page = int(fm.group(1))
300:                             box = tuple(float(fm.group(i)) for i in range(3, 7))
301:                             blocks.append(Block("FIG", rest, page=page, fig_id=fm.group(2), box=box))
302:                     current = None
303:                     continue
304:                 if kind in ("H1", "H2", "H3", "P", "Q", "OPT", "FORMULA"):
305:                     current = Block(kind, rest.strip())
306:                     blocks.append(current)
307:                     continue
308:                 # Unrecognized prefix: keep as paragraph.
309:                 current = Block("P", line.strip())
310:                 blocks.append(current)
311:             elif current is not None:
312:                 current.text += " " + line.strip()

[PAGE] 1
[H1] 模块五　正交分解
[H2] 知识解读
[H3] 1. 正交分解法
[P] (1)定义：把力沿着两个选定的互相垂直的方向分解，叫做力的正交分解法.
[P] 正交分解法尤其适用于物体受多个共点力的作用时.
[H3] (2)正交分解求合力
[P] 共线的两个或两个以上的力，其合力可由代数运算求得. 当物体受到多个力的作用，并且这几个力只共面不共线时，其合力 $F$ 用平行四边形定则求解很不方便. 为此，我们建立一个直角坐标系，先将各力正交分解在互相垂直的坐标轴上，求 $x$、$y$ 轴上的合力 $F_x$，$F_y$：
[FORMULA] F_x=F_{x1}+F_{x2}+F_{x3}+\cdots
[FORMULA] F_y=F_{y1}+F_{y2}+F_{y3}+\cdots
[P] 最后将 $F_x$ 和 $F_y$ 合成，即是合力 $F$ 的大小：
[FORMULA] F=\sqrt{F_x^2+F_y^2}
[P] 合力方向(与 $x$ 方向的夹角)：
[FORMULA] \tan\theta=\frac{F_y}{F_x}
[FIG] page=1 id=1a box=0.380,0.450,0.590,0.550
[H3] (3)正交分解法的步骤
[P] ①以力的作用点为原点作直角坐标系，标出 $x$ 轴和 $y$ 轴，两轴的方向可根据方便自己选择.
[P] ②将与坐标轴不重合的力沿 $x$ 轴方向和 $y$ 轴方向分解为两个分力，并在图上标明，用符号 $F_x$ 和 $F_y$ 表示.
[P] ③在图上标出力与 $x$ 轴或力与 $y$ 轴的夹角，然后列出 $F_x$、$F_y$ 的数学表达式. 如：$F$ 与 $x$ 轴夹角为 $\theta$，则 $F_x=F\cos\theta$，$F_y=F\sin\theta$. 与两轴重合的力就不需要分解了.
[P] ④$x$ 轴方向上的各分力的合力和 $y$ 轴方向上的各分力可直接求代数和得到.
[FIG] page=1 id=1b box=0.414,0.733,0.592,0.855
[H3] (4)力的正交分解法的优点：
[P] ①借助数学中的直角坐标系对力进行描述：$(F_x,\ F_y)$；

[PAGE] 2
[P] ②几何图形关系简单，分解时只用到直角三角形，比较容易求解；
[P] ③未来处理做功问题时，互相垂直的两方向互相独立，易于计算.
[P] (5)正交分解需要选择合理的方向建立直角坐标系，一般原则是：尽可能让更多的力直接处于坐标轴方向上.
[H2] 典题精讲
[Q] 例1 一物体受到三个共面共点力 $F_1$、$F_2$、$F_3$ 的作用，三力的矢量关系如图所示(小方格边长相等)，则下列说法正确的是(    )
[FIG] page=2 id=2a box=0.500,0.290,0.712,0.410
[OPT] A. 三力的合力大小为 $F_1+F_2+F_3$
[OPT] B. 三力的合力大小为 $3F_3$
[OPT] C. 三力的合力大小为 $2F_3$
[OPT] D. 由题给条件无法求出合力大小
[H2] 实战演练
[Q] 练1 如图所示，两个力 $F_1$、$F_2$ 的图示画在方格纸上，方格的边长代表 2 N，则 $F_1$、$F_2$ 的合力大小为______N.
[FIG] page=2 id=2b box=0.497,0.598,0.697,0.755

[PAGE] 3
[H1] 模块一　共点力平衡问题
[H2] 知识解读
[H3] 1. 共点力平衡
[H3] (1)平衡状态
[P] 一个物体在力的作用下保持静止或者匀速直线运动状态，则该物体处于平衡状态.
[H3] (2)平衡条件
[P] 物体所受合外力为零，其数学表达式为：$F_{合}=0$ 或 $F_{x合}=0$，$F_{y合}=0$，其中 $F_{x合}$ 为物体在 $x$ 轴方向上所受的合外力，$F_{y合}$ 为物体在 $y$ 轴方向上所受的合外力.
[H3] (3)平衡条件的推论
[P] ①物体在多个共点力作用下处于平衡状态，则其中的一个力与其余的力的合力等大反向.
[P] ②物体在三个共点力作用下处于平衡状态时，这三个力的有向线段必构成封闭三角形，即表示这三个力的矢量首尾相接，恰能组成一个封闭的矢量三角形.
[H2] 典题精讲
[Q] 例1 如图，物体 $A$ 的质量为 1 kg，与水平面间的动摩擦因数为 0.5. 用一恒力沿着右偏上 $37^{\circ}$ 的方向拉物体 $A$，使得物体向右匀速直线运动. 求这一恒力的大小 $F$.（取 $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$）
[FIG] page=3 id=3a box=0.405,0.618,0.638,0.708

[PAGE] 4
[Q] 例2 倾角为 $\theta=37^{\circ}$ 的斜面上有质量为 1 kg 的木块，它们之间的动摩擦因数为 0.5. 现用水平力推动木块，如图所示，使木块恰好沿斜面向上做匀速运动. 若斜面始终保持静止，求水平推力的大小 $F$.（取 $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$）
[FIG] page=4 id=4a box=0.356,0.200,0.553,0.287
[Q] 例3 将一个质量为 4 kg 的铅球放在倾角为 $45^{\circ}$ 的斜面上，并用竖直挡板挡住，铅球处于静止状态. 不考虑铅球受到的摩擦力，铅球对挡板的压力和对斜面的压力分别是多少？(取 $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$)
[FIG] page=4 id=4b box=0.316,0.628,0.545,0.772

    crop = im.crop((int(x0*w), int(y0*h), int(x1*w), int(y1*h))).convert("RGB")
    scale = 2
    crop = crop.resize((crop.width*scale, crop.height*scale), Image.LANCZOS)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(crop)
    for i in range(cols+1):
        x = (xs[0] + (xs[1]-xs[0])*i/cols) * crop.width
        for j in range(rows+1):
            y = (ys[0] + (ys[1]-ys[0])*j/rows) * crop.height
            d.ellipse([x-4, y-4, x+4, y+4], fill=(255,0,0))
            d.text((x+5, y+5), f"{i},{j}", font=font, fill=(200,0,0))
    crop.save(name)
    print(name, crop.size)

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

name.description: Short kebab-case workflow name.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

The user asks: "我想要开发一个AGENT帮我管理美团和淘宝闪购商家后台数据，你能帮我完成么" — can I help build an agent to manage Meituan and Taobao Shangou (闪购) merchant backend data?

This is a big open-ended request. I should:
1. Understand the constraints: 美团/淘宝闪购 merchant backends (美团外卖商家版 / 闪购 = 淘宝闪购, Alibaba). Both require login, anti-bot, and have no public APIs for merchants (Meituan has 开放平台 API for 门店/商品/订单 — 美团开放平台 requires 服务商资质; 淘宝开放平台 (TOP) requires 店铺授权).
2. Be honest about what's feasible: official APIs vs browser automation (RPA) vs data export.
3. Propose an architecture and a first concrete step, then ask for key info (有没有开放平台账号/服务商资质、后台是否有导出功能、要管理哪些数据、是否要写操作还是只读).

Given the workspace already has BBQ shop data (兵哥烧烤), the user is a merchant wanting to manage Meituan + 淘宝闪购 merchant backends — likely a real business need: 订单、商品、库存、评价、营销、对账.

Approach: Rather than diving into code immediately, I should scope it. But the user asks "你能帮我完成么" — answer yes with a concrete plan, and propose a phased approach where phase 1 is feasible today without API credentials: 数据采集（浏览器自动化登录态）+ 本地数据仓库 + 报表/告警 + agent 工具封装 (DSH plugin or standalone).

I should also assess risk/legality: automation of merchant backends may violate platform ToS; official API is the compliant path. I should mention this briefly but not moralize.

Also I can leverage DSH itself: build a custom DSH plugin (agent) with tools, or a headless agent script. Since DSH is the harness here, an "AGENT" could be:
- Option A: DSH profile with custom tools (MCP server) for 美团/淘宝 data.
- Option B: standalone Python service + LLM agent (Claude/DeepSeek API) + scheduled jobs + web dashboard.
- Option C: RPA (Playwright) + local DB + reporting, with human-in-the-loop.

I should ask a few key questions (but user may not like many questions). Better: give a crisp plan, state assumptions, and ask 3 decisive questions (数据源接入方式、只读还是可写、交付形态).

Since this is a big multi-step effort, maybe create a goal? The instructions: create_goal for long-running objectives. This could be a long-running dev project. But at this point it's a scoping/feasibility question; I should first clarify. Creating a goal prematurely may be wrong.

I think best response: 
1. 直接回答：能，分三层（合规接入 → 数据层 → Agent 层），并说明我能在本机直接做出来的部分。
2. 现实约束：美团/淘宝闪购商家后台没有面向小商户的公开 API（美团开放平台需服务商资质；淘宝开放平台需店铺授权 + 类目权限），所以现实路径有三条：官方 API、后台导出文件（CSV/Excel）、浏览器自动化（Playwright 带登录态，建议只读 + 低频）。
3. 我建议的架构（本地优先）：采集器（Playwright/导出导入）→ SQLite/DuckDB 数据仓库（订单/商品/评价/流量/对账）→ 规则+LLM 分析 → 日报/告警（飞书/微信/邮件）→ Agent 工具集（DSH 插件或 MCP server）+ 看板。
4. 第一个可交付的最小版本（MVP）：先做「只读数据同步 + 日报」两周内可跑；给出目录结构与技术栈。
5. 需要你确认的三件事：能否拿到开放平台/服务商权限？后台能否导出报表（哪些）？要只读还是也要改价/上下架/回复评价？
6. 风险提示：账号安全（别把密码放脚本里，用本地浏览器 profile + 扫码登录）、频率控制、平台条款。

Keep it structured and concise-ish. Maybe offer to start by building the skeleton today: repo layout + SQLite schema + Playwright login-state collector stub + daily report generator, so they can see something running.

Also ask whether to use DSH plugin form (so it lives as a tool in this GUI) or standalone.

I could also do a quick web search to verify current API availability for 美团开放平台 / 淘宝闪购 (Taobao Shangou) merchant APIs. That would make the answer accurate. Let me do a couple of searches: "美团 开放平台 商家 API 门店 商品 订单", "淘宝闪购 商家后台 API 开放平台", "美团外卖 商家版 导出 订单 报表".

Given web_search is available and accuracy matters (API availability changes), do 2-3 queries.

Then compose answer with citations.

Let me search.

8月5日，淘宝闪购面向服务商与自研系统商家正式开放MCP（Model Context Protocol）能力，成为餐饮外卖领域首个开放该能力的平台。首批上线35个MCP Server，覆盖商品、订单、财务、评价、营销等15大业务场景，帮助服务商与商家以更低成本快速构建智能化经营能力。

近年来，MCP正逐渐成为AI与业务系统对话的“通用协议”。它相当于为AI接入业务系统提供了一套标准接口——过去AI要对接某个平台的商品、订单、财务等数据，往往需要为每个场景单独开发适配接口；有了MCP，AI Agent可以用统一协议直接“读懂”并操作这些业务系统，大幅提高开发效率。淘宝闪购此次开放的，正是这样一套面向AI Agent的标准化协议。

[![淘宝闪购开放MCP能力 餐饮外卖行业首批35个Server覆盖15大业务场景](//img1.mydrivers.com/img/20260805/S0f34f09f-977b-4160-8df6-d183c414c33f.png)](//img1.mydrivers.com/img/20260805/0f34f09f-977b-4160-8df6-d183c414c33f.png)

这35个MCP Server围绕商家日常经营链路做了系统性覆盖，既有查询类能力，也有管理操作类能力。在商品与菜单方面，8个Server支持商品查询、批量改价、上下架与库存沽清置满；订单与履约方面，4个Server打通了订单查询、配送轨迹与准时率、退款索赔；财务与账单方面，4个Server覆盖单店与连锁总店的结算关系；评价与互动、营销活动与拼团、店铺基础信息、经营分析等业务场景同样纳入开放范围，共计覆盖15个业务场景。

这些能力组合后，可直接落地到实际经营场景。例如，接入生意参谋、店铺分与账单能力后，AI店长助手可自动生成经营日报、预警异常波动；评价查询、批量回复与赠券能力组合，可让评价运营实现自动化；商品上下架、批量改价、库存沽清置满Tool化后，连锁门店可实现批量同步。

对开发者而言，此次开放的最大价值在于“复用”。应用、凭证、接口权限申请及商户授权全部沿用开放平台原有对接关系，开发者只需在自有服务端搭建一层转接能力，即可让AI直接调用淘宝闪购的经营接口，无需从零开发、无需商户二次授权。接入方式上，同时支持标准MCP协议与HTTP Tool两种形态，兼容主流MCP Client及平台型Agent，服务商可以在既有系统基础上快速搭建AI应用，大幅降低接入AI的门槛。

淘宝闪购相关负责人表示：“作为餐饮外卖行业首个开放MCP能力的平台，我们希望把平台经营能力以更高效的方式交到服务商与商家手中，让AI真正成为驱动生意增长的基础设施。我们诚邀广大开发者接入，共建行业智能化生态。”

- **P0（今天-3天，零权限）**：你把后台导出的订单/账单/评价表丢给我 → 我搭数据仓库 + 指标口径 + 每日经营日报 + 差评/退款异常告警。**这一步做完你就已经能每天看数了。**

{"content": """"连接已登录的 Edge（CDP 调试端口），列出当前标签页。

只读：不点击、不提交表单、不读取密码。

用法：
    python probe.py                 # 列出标签页
    python probe.py --dump 0        # 把第 0 个标签页的标题/URL/正文前 2000 字打印出来
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

CDP_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--dump", type=int, default=None, help="打印该索引标签页的正文摘要")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        try:
            browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(CDP_URL)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            print(f"连不上 CDP（{CDP_URL}）：{exc}")
            print("请先运行 start-browser.ps1 并登录。")
            return 1

        pages = []
        for ctx in browser.contexts:
            pages.extend(ctx.pages)
        print(f"标签页 {len(pages)} 个：")
        for i, page in enumerate(pages):
            try:
                title = page.title()
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                title = "<无法读取>"
            print(f"  [{i}] {title}  ->  {page.url}")

        if args.dump is not None:
            page = pages[args.dump]
            text = page.inner_text("body")[:2000]
            print("\n--- 正文摘要 ---\n" + text)

        browser.close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# 3) 登录完回来跟我说一声

我接着会跑 `probe.py` 确认能读到你的订单页、商品页，然后开始写第一个采集器：**今日订单 + 商品列表 → 本地 SQLite → 日报**。

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

content.arguments:
{"content": """"本地数据仓库：SQLite 表结构与读写工具。

设计原则：
- 原始数据永远先落 raw_* 表，解析失败也不丢；
- 业务表（orders/skus/reviews）做幂等 upsert，重复采集不会产生脏数据；
- 金额一律用「分」存整数，避免浮点误差。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sqlite3
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path

DB_PATH = Path(__file__).with_name("data") / "shop.db"

SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS raw_pages (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    platform TEXT NOT NULL,
    url TEXT NOT NULL,
    fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_raw_platform ON raw_pages(platform, fetched_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
    platform TEXT NOT NULL,
    order_no TEXT NOT NULL,
    shop TEXT,
    created_at TEXT,
    status TEXT,
    amount_cents INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    discount_cents INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    packing_cents INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    delivery_cents INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    commission_cents INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    refund_cents INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    items_json TEXT,
    fetched_at TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (platform, order_no)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_date ON orders(platform, created_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS order_items (
    platform TEXT NOT NULL,
    order_no TEXT NOT NULL,
    sku_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    qty REAL DEFAULT 0,
    unit_price_cents INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    amount_cents INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (platform, order_no, sku_name)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS skus (
    platform TEXT NOT NULL,
    sku_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT,
    price_cents INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    stock REAL,
    status TEXT,
    updated_at TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (platform, sku_key)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reviews (
    platform TEXT NOT NULL,
    review_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    shop TEXT,
    star INTEGER,
    content TEXT,
    replied INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    reply_text TEXT,
    created_at TEXT,
    fetched_at TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (platform, review_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settlements (
    platform TEXT NOT NULL,
    bill_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    shop TEXT,
    gross_cents INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    commission_cents INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    refund_cents INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    net_cents INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    fetched_at TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (platform, bill_date, shop)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS daily_metrics (
    date TEXT NOT NULL,
    platform TEXT NOT NULL,
    shop TEXT,
    orders INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    gmv_cents INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    net_cents INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    refund_cents INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    avg_ticket_cents INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    bad_reviews INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    reviews INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (date, platform, shop)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_runs (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    platform TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    finished_at TEXT,
    status TEXT,
    rows INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    message TEXT
);
"""


@contextmanager
def connect():
    DB_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    try:
        yield conn
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()


def init() -> None:
    with connect() as conn:
        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)


def save_raw(conn: sqlite3.Connection, platform: str, url: str, fetched_at: str, payload) -> None:
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO raw_pages (platform, url, fetched_at, payload) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
        (platform, url, fetched_at, json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)),
    )


def upsert_orders(conn: sqlite3.Connection, rows: list[dict]) -> int:
    if not rows:
        return 0
    cols = ["platform", "order_no", "shop", "created_at", "status", "amount_cents",
            "discount_cents", "packing_cents", "delivery_cents", "commission_cents",
            "refund_cents", "items_json", "fetched_at"]
    sql = f"INSERT INTO orders ({','.join(cols)}) VALUES ({','.join('?' * len(cols))}) " \
          f"ON CONFLICT(platform, order_no) DO UPDATE SET " + \
          ",".join(f"{c}=excluded.{c}" for c in cols[2:])
    conn.executemany(sql, [tuple(r.get(c) for c in cols) for r in rows])
    return len(rows)


def upsert_skus(conn: sqlite3.Connection, rows: list[dict]) -> int:
    if not rows:
        return 0
    cols = ["platform", "sku_key", "name", "category", "price_cents", "stock", "status", "updated_at"]
    sql = f"INSERT INTO skus ({','.join(cols)}) VALUES ({','.join('?' * len(cols))}) " \
          f"ON CONFLICT(platform, sku_key) DO UPDATE SET " + \
          ",".join(f"{c}=excluded.{c}" for c in cols[2:])
    conn.executemany(sql, [tuple(r.get(c) for c in cols) for r in rows])
    return len(rows)


def upsert_reviews(conn: sqlite3.Connection, rows: list[dict]) -> int:
    if not rows:
        return 0
    cols = ["platform", "review_id", "shop", "star", "content", "replied",
            "reply_text", "created_at", "fetched_at"]
    sql = f"INSERT INTO reviews ({','.join(cols)}) VALUES ({','.join('?' * len(cols))}) " \
          f"ON CONFLICT(platform, review_id) DO UPDATE SET " + \
          ",".join(f"{c}=excluded.{c}" for c in cols[2:])
    conn.executemany(sql, [tuple(r.get(c) for c in cols) for r in rows])

{"content": """"把当前打开的商家后台页面存档（HTML + 可见文本），用于分析页面结构和排查问题。

用法：
    python capture.py                # 抓所有标签页
    python capture.py --index 1      # 只抓第 1 个标签页
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

CDP_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"
OUT = Path(__file__).with_name("data") / "snapshots"


def slug(text: str) -> str:
    text = re.sub(r"[^\w\u4e00-\u9fff-]+", "_", text)[:40]
    return text or "page"


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--index", type=int, default=None)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(CDP_URL)
        pages = [pg for ctx in browser.contexts for pg in ctx.pages]
        if args.index is not None:
            pages = [pages[args.index]]

        for i, page in enumerate(pages):
            try:
                page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=8000)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass
            title = page.title()
            url = page.url
            html = page.content()
            try:
                text = page.inner_text("body")
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                text = ""
            base = OUT / f"{stamp}_{i:02d}_{slug(title)}"
            base.with_suffix(".html").write_text(html, encoding="utf-8")
            base.with_suffix(".txt").write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
            print(f"[{i}] {title} | {url}\n    html={len(html)}B text={len(text)}B -> {base.name}.*")

        browser.close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

{"content": """"把当前打开的商家后台页面存档（HTML + 可见文本），用于分析页面结构和排查问题。

用法：
    python capture.py                # 抓所有标签页
    python capture.py --index 1      # 只抓第 1 个标签页
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

CDP_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"
OUT = Path(__file__).with_name("data") / "snapshots"


def slug(text: str) -> str:
    text = re.sub(r"[^\w\u4e00-\u9fff-]+", "_", text)[:40]
    return text or "page"


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--index", type=int, default=None)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(CDP_URL)
        pages = [pg for ctx in browser.contexts for pg in ctx.pages]
        if args.index is not None:
            pages = [pages[args.index]]

        for i, page in enumerate(pages):
            try:
                page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=8000)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass
            title = page.title()
            url = page.url
            html = page.content()
            try:
                text = page.inner_text("body")
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                text = ""
            base = OUT / f"{stamp}_{i:02d}_{slug(title)}"
            base.with_suffix(".html").write_text(html, encoding="utf-8")
            base.with_suffix(".txt").write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
            print(f"[{i}] {title} | {url}\n    html={len(html)}B text={len(text)}B -> {base.name}.*")

        browser.close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

用法：
    python open_tab.py https://napos.ele.me/
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

CDP_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"


def main() -> int:
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("usage: python open_tab.py <url>")
        return 2
    url = sys.argv[1]
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(CDP_URL)
        ctx = browser.contexts[0]
        page = ctx.new_page()
        page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000)
        page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
        print("title:", page.title())
        print("url  :", page.url)
        text = page.inner_text("body")[:1500]
        print("--- text ---")
        print(text)
        browser.close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":

content.arguments:
{"content": """"打开「订单管理 → 全部订单」，并抓取该页发出的接口返回。

用法：
    python meituan_orders.py            # 打开页面并旁听接口
    python meituan_orders.py --save     # 额外把接口返回落库（raw_pages）
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import re
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

CDP_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"
OUT = Path(__file__).with_name("data") / "spy"


def hover_menu(page, menu_id: str) -> dict:
    """把鼠标移到左侧菜单项上，返回其中心坐标（菜单的 sub-menu 只在 hover 时渲染）。"""
    return page.evaluate(
        """(id) => {
            const el = document.querySelector('#' + id);
            if (!el) return null;
            const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            return {x: r.x + r.width / 2, y: r.y + r.height / 2};
        }""",
        menu_id,
    )


def click_submenu(page, menu_id: str, sub_id: str) -> str:
    page.mouse.move(0, 0)
    page.wait_for_timeout(300)
    center = hover_menu(page, menu_id)
    if not center:
        return "menu-not-found"
    page.mouse.move(center["x"], center["y"])
    page.wait_for_timeout(900)
    rect = page.evaluate(
        """(id) => {
            const el = document.querySelector('#' + id);
            if (!el) return null;
            const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            return {x: r.x + r.width / 2, y: r.y + r.height / 2};
        }""",
        sub_id,
    )
    if not rect:
        return "submenu-not-found"
    page.mouse.click(rect["x"], rect["y"])
    return "clicked"


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--save", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    outdir = OUT / f"orders-{stamp}"
    outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    records: list[dict] = []

    def on_response(resp):
        try:
            req = resp.request
            if req.resource_type not in ("xhr", "fetch"):
                return
            if "order" not in resp.url.lower():
                return
            body = None
            try:
                body = resp.text()[:300_000]
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass
            records.append({"url": resp.url, "status": resp.status, "method": req.method,
                            "post": (req.post_data or "")[:3000], "body": body})
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(CDP_URL)
        ctx = browser.contexts[0]
        page = ctx.pages[0]
        page.on("response", on_response)

        print("nav:", click_submenu(page, "订单管理", "全部订单"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(6000)

        frames = [f for f in page.frames if "business_gw" in f.url]
        frame = frames[0] if frames else page
        print("frame:", frame.url)
        try:
            print("text:", frame.inner_text("body")[:400].replace("\n", " | "))
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass
        print("captured:", len(records))

        (outdir / "responses.json").write_text(json.dumps(records, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
        for r in records:
            key = re.sub(r"\?.*$", "", r["url"])
            print(f"  {r['status']}  {key}  body={len(r['body'] or '')}B")
        print("saved ->", outdir)

        if args.save:
            sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
            import db

            db.init()
            now = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
            with db.connect() as conn:
                for r in records:
                    db.save_raw(conn, "meituan", r["url"], now, r)
            print("raw saved to db")

        browser.close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

    return page.evaluate(
        """(id) => {
            const el = document.querySelector('#' + id);
            if (!el) return null;
            const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            return {x: r.x + r.width / 2, y: r.y + r.height / 2};

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import sys, json, re
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

recs = []
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9222")
    pg = b.contexts[0].pages[0]
    frame = [f for f in pg.frames if "orderbusiness" in f.url][0]

    def on_resp(r):
        try:
            if r.request.resource_type not in ("xhr", "fetch"): return
            if "/order/" not in r.url: return
            body = None
            try: body = r.text()[:300000]
            except Exception: pass
            recs.append({"url": r.url, "status": r.status, "post": (r.request.post_data or "")[:2000], "body": body})
        except Exception: pass

    frame.on("response", on_resp)
    frame.get_by_text("昨日", exact=True).first.click()
    frame.wait_for_timeout(6000)
    print("text:", frame.inner_text("body")[:200].replace("\n", " | "))
    print("captured", len(recs))
    for r in recs:
        print(" ", r["status"], re.sub(r"\?.*$", "", r["url"]), len(r["body"] or ""))
    json.dump(recs, open("data/spy/yesterday.json", "w", encoding="utf-8"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
    b.close()

{"content": """"批量探测候选后台地址：判断是登录页 / 下载页 / 跳转到别处。

用法：
    python probe_urls.py https://a.example https://b.example
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

CDP_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"
LOGIN_HINTS = ("登录", "扫码", "密码", "验证码", "账号")


def classify(text: str) -> str:
    if any(k in text for k in ("下载", "扫二维码进行下载", "Android下载")):
        return "下载页"
    if sum(1 for k in LOGIN_HINTS if k in text) >= 2:
        return "登录页"
    return "其他"


def main() -> int:
    urls = sys.argv[1:]
    if not urls:
        print("usage: python probe_urls.py <url> [<url> ...]")
        return 2

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(CDP_URL)
        ctx = browser.contexts[0]
        for url in urls:
            page = ctx.new_page()
            try:
                page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=25000)
                page.wait_for_timeout(3500)
                title = page.title()
                final = page.url
                text = page.inner_text("body")[:600]
                kind = classify(text)
                print(f"{kind}  {url}\n     -> {final}  |  {title}")
                print("     ", text.replace("\n", " | ")[:160])
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                print(f"错误  {url}  ({type(exc).__name__}: {exc})")
            finally:
                try:
                    page.close()
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    pass
        browser.close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import sys, pathlib
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
out = pathlib.Path("data/screenshots"); out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9222")
    pages = b.contexts[0].pages
    print("pages:", len(pages))
    for i, pg in enumerate(pages):
        print(i, pg.url[:90])
    target = [pg for pg in pages if "melody.shop.ele.me" in pg.url]
    pg = target[-1] if target else pages[-1]
    pg.bring_to_front()
    pg.wait_for_timeout(1200)
    path = out / "ele_login.png"
    pg.screenshot(path=str(path), full_page=False)
    print("shot:", path, path.stat().st_size)
    b.close()

{"content": """"生成经营日报（当前支持美团；淘宝闪购接入后按 platform 汇总）。

用法：
    python report.py --date 2026-11-10
    python report.py --date 2026-11-10 --md reports/2026-11-10.md
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sqlite3
import sys
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

DB = Path(__file__).with_name("data") / "shop.db"
PLATFORM_NAME = {"meituan": "美团", "eleme": "淘宝闪购"}


def yuan(cents) -> str:
    return f"¥{(cents or 0) / 100:,.2f}"


def build(date: str) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row

    head = conn.execute(
        """SELECT platform, shop, COUNT(*) n,
                  SUM(amount_cents) amount, SUM(food_cents) food,
                  SUM(packing_cents) pack, SUM(delivery_cents) delivery,
                  SUM(commission_cents) comm, SUM(settle_cents) settle
           FROM orders WHERE date(created_at) = ? GROUP BY platform, shop""",
        (date,),

lines += [f"| **合计** | **{tn}** | **¥{ta/100:,.2f}** | **¥{ts/100:,.2f}** | ¥{sum(r['comm'] for r in rows)/100:,.2f} | ¥{ta/tn/100:,.2f} |", ""]

                      from orders group by h order by n desc limit 8"""):

for t in c.execute("""select sku_name, sum(qty) q, sum(amount_cents) a from order_items
                      group by sku_name order by a desc limit 10"""):
    lines.append(f"| {t['sku_name']} | {t['q']:.0f} | ¥{t['a']/100:,.2f} |")
out = pathlib.Path("reports/trend-7d.md"); out.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

print("\n".join(lines))
print("\nsaved ->", out)

|---|---|---|---|---|

content.arguments:
{"content": """"采集淘宝闪购（饿了么体系）经营分析的实时 KPI，并写入 daily_metrics。

后台的数据接口带 secretkey 签名（每次请求都不同），所以这里不调接口，
而是读取页面渲染出来的指标文本——只读、稳定、不触发风控。

用法：
    python ele_metrics.py            # 读今日实时
    python ele_metrics.py --save     # 同时写库
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
import sys
import time
from datetime import date, datetime
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
import db  # noqa: E402

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

CDP_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"
HOME = "https://melody.shop.ele.me/app/shop/546266599/#app.shop.dashboard"

PATTERNS = {
    "revenue": r"预计收入\s*([\d.]+)",
    "gmv": r"营业额\s*([\d.]+)",
    "orders": r"有效订单\s*(\d+)",
    "exposure": r"曝光人数\s*(\d+)",
    "visit_rate": r"进店转化率\s*([\d.]+)\s*%",
    "order_rate": r"下单转化率\s*([\d.]+)\s*%",
}


def parse_metrics(text: str) -> dict:
    out = {}
    flat = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    for key, pat in PATTERNS.items():
        m = re.search(pat, flat)
        if m:
            out[key] = m.group(1)
    return out


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--save", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(CDP_URL, timeout=60000)
        page = [pg for ctx in browser.contexts for pg in ctx.pages if "melody.shop.ele.me" in pg.url][-1]
        # 进入数据中心 → 经营分析
        try:
            page.get_by_text("数据中心", exact=True).first.click(timeout=6000)
            page.wait_for_timeout(1200)
            page.get_by_text("经营分析", exact=True).first.click(timeout=6000)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            print("导航告警：", type(exc).__name__)
        page.wait_for_timeout(12000)

        frame = None
        for fr in page.frames:
            if "business-analysis" in fr.url:
                frame = fr
        if frame is None:
            print("没找到经营分析 iframe，当前页面：", page.url)
            browser.close()
            return 1

        text = frame.inner_text("body")
        metrics = parse_metrics(text)
        print("淘宝闪购 KPI：", metrics)

        if args.save and metrics:
            db.init()
            today = date.today().isoformat()
            with db.connect() as conn:
                conn.execute(
                    """INSERT INTO daily_metrics (date, platform, shop, orders, gmv_cents, net_cents, avg_ticket_cents)
                       VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
                       ON CONFLICT(date, platform, shop) DO UPDATE SET
                         orders=excluded.orders, gmv_cents=excluded.gmv_cents,
                         net_cents=excluded.net_cents, avg_ticket_cents=excluded.avg_ticket_cents""",
                    (today, "eleme", "兵哥烧烤(顶社路店)",
                     int(metrics.get("orders", 0)),
                     int(round(float(metrics.get("gmv", 0)) * 100)),
                     int(round(float(metrics.get("revenue", 0)) * 100)),
                     int(round(float(metrics.get("gmv", 0)) * 100 / max(1, int(metrics.get("orders", 1)))))),
                )
                db.log_run(conn, "eleme", "metrics", today, datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                           "ok", 1, str(metrics))
            print("已写入 daily_metrics:", today)
        browser.close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":

用法：
    python ele_metrics.py            # 读今日实时
    python ele_metrics.py --save     # 同时写库
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
import sys
import time
from datetime import date, datetime
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
import db  # noqa: E402

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

CDP_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"
HOME = "https://melody.shop.ele.me/app/shop/546266599/#app.shop.dashboard"

PATTERNS = {
    "revenue": r"预计收入\s*([\d.]+)",
    "gmv": r"营业额\s*([\d.]+)",
    "orders": r"有效订单\s*(\d+)",
    "exposure": r"曝光人数\s*(\d+)",
    "visit_rate": r"进店转化率\s*([\d.]+)\s*%",
    "order_rate": r"下单转化率\s*([\d.]+)\s*%",
}


def parse_metrics(text: str) -> dict:
    out = {}
    flat = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    for key, pat in PATTERNS.items():
        m = re.search(pat, flat)
        if m:
            out[key] = m.group(1)
    return out


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--save", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(CDP_URL, timeout=60000)
        page = [pg for ctx in browser.contexts for pg in ctx.pages if "melody.shop.ele.me" in pg.url][-1]
        # 进入数据中心 → 经营分析
        try:
            page.get_by_text("数据中心", exact=True).first.click(timeout=6000)
            page.wait_for_timeout(1200)
            page.get_by_text("经营分析", exact=True).first.click(timeout=6000)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            print("导航告警：", type(exc).__name__)
        page.wait_for_timeout(12000)

        frame = None
        for fr in page.frames:
            if "business-analysis" in fr.url:
                frame = fr
        if frame is None:
            print("没找到经营分析 iframe，当前页面：", page.url)
            browser.close()
            return 1

        text = frame.inner_text("body")
        metrics = parse_metrics(text)
        print("淘宝闪购 KPI：", metrics)

        if args.save and metrics:
            db.init()
            today = date.today().isoformat()
            with db.connect() as conn:
                conn.execute(
                    """INSERT INTO daily_metrics (date, platform, shop, orders, gmv_cents, net_cents, avg_ticket_cents)
                       VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
                       ON CONFLICT(date, platform, shop) DO UPDATE SET
                         orders=excluded.orders, gmv_cents=excluded.gmv_cents,
                         net_cents=excluded.net_cents, avg_ticket_cents=excluded.avg_ticket_cents""",
                    (today, "eleme", "兵哥烧烤(顶社路店)",
                     int(metrics.get("orders", 0)),
                     int(round(float(metrics.get("gmv", 0)) * 100)),
                     int(round(float(metrics.get("revenue", 0)) * 100)),
                     int(round(float(metrics.get("gmv", 0)) * 100 / max(1, int(metrics.get("orders", 1)))))),
                )
                db.log_run(conn, "eleme", "metrics", today, datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                           "ok", 1, str(metrics))
            print("已写入 daily_metrics:", today)
        browser.close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

CDP_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"
OUT = Path(__file__).with_name("data") / "download-center"


def main() -> int:
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(CDP_URL, timeout=60000)
        page = [pg for ctx in browser.contexts for pg in ctx.pages if "melody.shop.ele.me" in pg.url][-1]

        try:
            page.get_by_text("数据中心", exact=True).first.click(timeout=6000)
            page.wait_for_timeout(1200)
            page.get_by_text("数据下载", exact=True).first.click(timeout=6000)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            print("nav warn:", type(exc).__name__)
        page.wait_for_timeout(10000)

        frame = None
        for fr in page.frames:
            if "download-center" in fr.url:
                frame = fr
        if frame is None:
            print("no download-center frame; frames:", [f.url[:80] for f in page.frames])
            browser.close()
            return 1

        print("frame:", frame.url)
        info = frame.evaluate(
            """() => {
                const pick = (sel) => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(sel)).map(e => ({
                    tag: e.tagName,
                    text: (e.innerText || '').trim().slice(0, 24),
                    type: e.type || '',
                    cls: (e.className || '').toString().slice(0, 50),
                    ph: e.placeholder || ''
                }));
                return {
                    buttons: pick('button').slice(0, 40),
                    tabs: pick('[role=tab], .ant-tabs-tab, .next-tabs-tab').slice(0, 30),
                    inputs: pick('input').slice(0, 20),
                    selects: pick('.next-select, .ant-select').slice(0, 20),
                    radios: pick('.next-radio-wrapper, .ant-radio-wrapper').slice(0, 20)
                };
            }"""
        )
        print(json.dumps(info, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)[:4000])

        shot = OUT / f"dc-{time.strftime('%H%M%S')}.png"
        frame.screenshot(path=str(shot)) if False else page.screenshot(path=str(shot), full_page=False)
        print("screenshot:", shot)
        (OUT / "page.txt").write_text(frame.inner_text("body"), encoding="utf-8")
        browser.close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

{"content": """"自动化淘宝闪购「数据中心 → 数据下载 → 订单下载」，导出指定日期的经营报表。

用法：
    python ele_export.py --date 2026-11-10
    python ele_export.py --date 2026-11-10 --fields 全选
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
import time
from datetime import date, datetime
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

CDP_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"
DOWNLOAD_DIR = Path.home() / "Downloads"

KEY_FIELDS = ["门店名称", "有效订单", "营业额及明细", "顾客实付总额", "单均实付", "差评订单数"]


def find_frame(page):
    for fr in page.frames:
        if "download-center" in fr.url:
            return fr
    return None


def set_dates(frame, day: str) -> None:
    starts = frame.locator("input[placeholder='开始日期']").first
    ends = frame.locator("input[placeholder='结束日期']").first
    for loc in (starts, ends):
        loc.click()
        loc.fill(day)
        frame.page.wait_for_timeout(300)
        frame.page.keyboard.press("Enter")
        frame.page.wait_for_timeout(400)
    frame.page.wait_for_timeout(800)


def select_fields(frame, page, mode: str) -> None:
    if mode == "全选":
        try:
            frame.get_by_text("全选", exact=True).first.click(timeout=5000)
            page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            print("全选点击失败")
        return
    for name in KEY_FIELDS:
        try:
            frame.get_by_text(name, exact=True).first.click(timeout=4000)
            page.wait_for_timeout(200)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            print("字段勾选失败:", name)


def wait_download(before: set[Path], timeout: int = 120) -> Path | None:
    deadline = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < deadline:
        now = {p for p in DOWNLOAD_DIR.glob("*") if p.is_file()}
        new = [p for p in now - before if p.suffix.lower() in (".xlsx", ".xls", ".csv", ".zip", ".txt")]
        if new:
            return max(new, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime)
        time.sleep(2)
    return None


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--date", default=date.today().isoformat())
    ap.add_argument("--fields", default="关键字段", choices=["关键字段", "全选"])
    args = ap.parse_args()

    before = {p for p in DOWNLOAD_DIR.glob("*") if p.is_file()}

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(CDP_URL, timeout=60000)
        page = [pg for ctx in browser.contexts for pg in ctx.pages if "melody.shop.ele.me" in pg.url][-1]

        try:
            page.get_by_text("数据中心", exact=True).first.click(timeout=6000)
            page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
            page.get_by_text("数据下载", exact=True).first.click(timeout=6000)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            print("导航告警:", type(exc).__name__)
        page.wait_for_timeout(9000)

        frame = find_frame(page)
        if frame is None:
            print("没有找到数据下载页面")
            browser.close()
            return 1

        # 订单下载 + 按天
        for label in ("订单下载", "按天"):
            try:
                frame.get_by_text(label, exact=True).first.click(timeout=5000)
                page.wait_for_timeout(600)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                print("点击失败:", label)

        set_dates(frame, args.date)
        print("日期:", args.date)
        select_fields(frame, page, args.fields)
        print("字段选择完成:", args.fields)

        try:
            frame.get_by_text("下载数据", exact=True).first.click(timeout=8000)
            print("已点击【下载数据】")
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            print("下载按钮点击失败:", type(exc).__name__)
            browser.close()
            return 1

        page.wait_for_timeout(6000)
        # 有些流程会先落“下载管理”，再点一次下载
        try:
            tab = frame.get_by_text("下载管理", exact=True).first
            tab.click(timeout=4000)
            page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
            rows = frame.inner_text("body")
            print("下载管理片段:", rows[:300].replace("\n", " | "))
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass

        path = wait_download(before, timeout=90)
        print("下载文件:", path)
        browser.close()

    return 0 if path else 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

{"content": """"解析淘宝闪购「数据下载 → 订单下载（按天）」导出的 xlsx，并写入 daily_metrics。

用法：
    python parse_ele_export.py                      # 自动扫描 ~/Downloads 里的“门店下载_*.xlsx”
    python parse_ele_export.py --file 路径.xlsx
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

import openpyxl

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
import db  # noqa: E402

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

DOWNLOADS = Path.home() / "Downloads"

COLUMNS = {
    "日期": "date",
    "门店编号": "shop_id",
    "有效订单": "orders",
    "营业额": "gmv",
    "商品销售额": "items_amount",
    "打包费": "packing",
    "商家应收配送费": "delivery",
    "索赔单": "claims",
    "其他营业额": "other",
    "顾客实付总额": "customer_paid",
    "单均实付": "avg_paid",
    "差评订单数": "bad_reviews",
}


def to_cents(value) -> int:
    if value is None or value == "":
        return 0
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return int(round(float(value) * 100))
    text = str(value).replace("¥", "").replace(",", "").strip()
    try:
        return int(round(float(text) * 100))
    except ValueError:
        return 0


def to_int(value) -> int:
    if value is None or value == "":
        return 0
    try:
        return int(float(str(value).strip()))
    except ValueError:
        return 0


def parse_file(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
    ws = wb["data"] if "data" in wb.sheetnames else wb.worksheets[0]
    rows = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    if not rows:
        return []
    header = [str(c).strip() if c is not None else "" for c in rows[0]]
    index = {COLUMNS[h]: i for i, h in enumerate(header) if h in COLUMNS}
    if "date" not in index or "orders" not in index:
        raise SystemExit(f"表头不符合预期：{header}")

    out = []
    for raw in rows[1:]:
        if not any(v not in (None, "") for v in raw):
            continue
        get = lambda key: raw[index[key]] if key in index else None  # noqa: E731
        day = str(get("date")).strip()[:10]
        if not re.match(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", day):
            continue
        out.append({
            "date": day,
            "platform": "eleme",
            "shop": "兵哥烧烤(顶社路店)",
            "orders": to_int(get("orders")),
            "gmv_cents": to_cents(get("gmv")),
            "net_cents": to_cents(get("customer_paid")),
            "avg_ticket_cents": to_cents(get("avg_paid")),
            "bad_reviews": to_int(get("bad_reviews")),
            "items_cents": to_cents(get("items_amount")),
            "packing_cents": to_cents(get("packing")),
            "delivery_cents": to_cents(get("delivery")),
        })
    return out


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--file")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    files = [Path(args.file)] if args.file else sorted(
        DOWNLOADS.glob("门店下载_*.xlsx"), key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True
    )
    if not files:

        with db.connect() as conn:

                )
            db.log_run(conn, "eleme", "export", r["date"],
                       datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"), "ok", len(rows), path.name)
        total += len(rows)
    print("写入 daily_metrics:", total, "行")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

{"content": """"在淘宝闪购数据下载页切换下载类型（门店/订单/商品/评价），可选生成并抓取文件。

用法：
    python ele_download.py --type 商品 --date 2026-11-10
    python ele_download.py --type 商品 --date 2026-11-10 --dry-run
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
import time
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

CDP_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"
EXPORT_DIR = Path(__file__).with_name("data") / "ele-exports"
DOWNLOADS = Path.home() / "Downloads"

CLICK_JS = """
(arg) => {
    const [text, cls] = arg;
    const pool = cls ? Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(cls)) : Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*'));
    const hit = pool.find(e => (e.textContent || '').trim() === text);
    if (!hit) return 'not-found';
    hit.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseover', {bubbles: true}));
    hit.click();
    return 'clicked:' + hit.tagName + '.' + (hit.className || '').toString().slice(0, 30);
}
"""


def click(frame, text: str, cls: str = "") -> str:
    try:
        return frame.evaluate(CLICK_JS, [text, cls])
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return f"error:{type(exc).__name__}"


def find_dc_frame(page):
    for fr in page.frames:
        if "download-center" in fr.url:
            return fr
    return None


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--type", default="商品", choices=["门店", "订单", "商品", "评价"])
    ap.add_argument("--date", default=date.today().isoformat())
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    EXPORT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(CDP_URL, timeout=60000)
        ctx = browser.contexts[0]
        page = [pg for pg in ctx.pages if "melody.shop.ele.me" in pg.url][-1]

        try:
            page.get_by_text("数据中心", exact=True).first.click(timeout=6000)
            page.wait_for_timeout(900)
            page.get_by_text("数据下载", exact=True).first.click(timeout=6000)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            print("导航告警:", type(exc).__name__)
        page.wait_for_timeout(9000)

        frame = find_dc_frame(page)
        if frame is None:
            print("没有数据下载页面")
            browser.close()
            return 1

        # 切到目标 tab（ant-tabs-tab 才是可点元素）
        label = f"{args.type}下载"
        print("切换标签:", label, "->", click(frame, label, ".ant-tabs-tab"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        head = frame.inner_text("body")[:200].replace("\n", " | ")
        print("页面:", head)

        if args.dry_run:
            browser.close()
            return 0

        # 日期
        cur = frame.evaluate(
            """() => {
                const s = document.querySelector("input[placeholder='开始日期']");
                const e = document.querySelector("input[placeholder='结束日期']");
                return [s ? s.value : "", e ? e.value : ""];
            }"""
        )
        print("当前日期:", cur)
        if not (cur and cur[0] == args.date and cur[1] == args.date):
            print("点“昨日”:", click(frame, "昨日", ".ant-tag, span, a, div"))
            page.wait_for_timeout(1500)

        # 全选字段
        print("全选:", click(frame, "全选", "label, span, div"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(800)

        before = {p.name for p in DOWNLOADS.glob("*")}
        print("下载数据:", click(frame, "下载数据", "button"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(5000)

        # 打开下载管理
        print("下载管理:", click(frame, "下载管理", ".ant-tabs-tab"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(4000)
        txt = frame.inner_text("body")
        idx = txt.find("文件名称")
        print("列表:", txt[idx:idx + 300].replace("\n", " | ") if idx >= 0 else txt[:200])

        if not args.dry_run:
            session = ctx.new_cdp_session(page)
            session.send("Browser.setDownloadBehavior",
                         {"behavior": "allow", "downloadPath": str(EXPORT_DIR.resolve()), "eventsEnabled": True})
            print("点击下载行:", click(frame, "下载", ".submit"))
            for _ in range(30):
                files = sorted(EXPORT_DIR.glob("*"), key=lambda x: x.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True)
                if files:
                    print("文件:", files[0], files[0].stat().st_size)
                    break
                time.sleep(1.5)
            else:
                new = [x for x in DOWNLOADS.glob("*") if x.name not in before]
                print("未落到导出目录；Downloads 新文件:", [x.name for x in new])

        browser.close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""在淘宝闪购数据下载页切换下载类型（门店/订单/商品/评价），生成并抓取导出文件。

用法：
    python ele_download.py --type 商品 --date 2026-11-10 --dry-run
    python ele_download.py --type 商品 --date 2026-11-10
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
import time
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

CDP_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"
EXPORT_DIR = Path(__file__).with_name("data") / "ele-exports"
DOWNLOADS = Path.home() / "Downloads"

CLICK_JS = """
(arg) => {
    const [text, cls] = arg;
    const pool = cls ? Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(cls)) : Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*'));
    const hit = pool.find(e => (e.textContent || '').trim() === text);
    if (!hit) return 'not-found';
    hit.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseover', {bubbles: true}));
    hit.click();
    return 'clicked:' + hit.tagName + '.' + (hit.className || '').toString().slice(0, 30);
}
"""


def click(frame, text: str, cls: str = "") -> str:
    try:
        return frame.evaluate(CLICK_JS, [text, cls])
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return f"error:{type(exc).__name__}"


def find_dc_frame(page):
    for fr in page.frames:
        if "download-center" in fr.url:
            return fr
    return None


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--type", default="商品", choices=["门店", "订单", "商品", "评价"])
    ap.add_argument("--date", default=date.today().isoformat())
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    EXPORT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(CDP_URL, timeout=60000)
        ctx = browser.contexts[0]
        page = [pg for pg in ctx.pages if "melody.shop.ele.me" in pg.url][-1]

        try:
            page.get_by_text("数据中心", exact=True).first.click(timeout=6000)
            page.wait_for_timeout(900)
            page.get_by_text("数据下载", exact=True).first.click(timeout=6000)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            print("导航告警:", type(exc).__name__)
        page.wait_for_timeout(9000)

        frame = find_dc_frame(page)
        if frame is None:
            print("没有数据下载页面")
            browser.close()
            return 1

        label = f"{args.type}下载"
        print("切换标签:", label, "->", click(frame, label, ".ant-tabs-tab"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        print("页面:", frame.inner_text("body")[:180].replace("\n", " | "))

        if args.dry_run:
            browser.close()
            return 0

        cur = frame.evaluate(
            """() => {
                const s = document.querySelector("input[placeholder='开始日期']");
                const e = document.querySelector("input[placeholder='结束日期']");
                return [s ? s.value : "", e ? e.value : ""];
            }"""
        )
        print("当前日期:", cur)
        if not (cur and cur[0] == args.date and cur[1] == args.date):
            print("点“昨日”:", click(frame, "昨日", "span, a, div"))
            page.wait_for_timeout(1500)

        print("全选:", click(frame, "全选", "label, span, div"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(800)

        before = {p.name for p in DOWNLOADS.glob("*")}
        print("下载数据:", click(frame, "下载数据", "button"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(5000)

        print("下载管理:", click(frame, "下载管理", ".ant-tabs-tab"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(4000)
        txt = frame.inner_text("body")
        idx = txt.find("文件名称")
        print("列表:", txt[idx:idx + 260].replace("\n", " | ") if idx >= 0 else txt[:200])

        session = ctx.new_cdp_session(page)
        session.send("Browser.setDownloadBehavior",
                     {"behavior": "allow", "downloadPath": str(EXPORT_DIR.resolve()), "eventsEnabled": True})
        print("点击下载:", click(frame, "下载", ".submit"))
        for _ in range(30):
            files = sorted(EXPORT_DIR.glob("*"), key=lambda x: x.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True)
            if files:
                print("文件:", files[0], files[0].stat().st_size)
                break
            time.sleep(1.5)
        else:
            new = [x for x in DOWNLOADS.glob("*") if x.name not in before]
            print("未落到导出目录；Downloads 新文件:", [x.name for x in new])

        browser.close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import sys, pathlib, time, openpyxl

EXPORT = pathlib.Path("data/ele-exports").resolve()
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9222", timeout=60000)
    ctx = b.contexts[0]
    pg = [x for x in ctx.pages if "melody.shop.ele.me" in x.url][-1]
    pg.goto("https://melody.shop.ele.me/app/shop/546266599/downloadCenter#app.shop.downloadCenter", wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=45000)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(9000)
    fr = [f for f in pg.frames if "download-center" in f.url][-1]
    off = pg.evaluate("""() => { const f = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('iframe')).find(x => x.src.includes('download-center')); const r = f.getBoundingClientRect(); return {x: r.x, y: r.y}; }""")
    def real_click(text):
        box = fr.evaluate("""(t) => {
            const n = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div,span,button,label')).find(e => (e.textContent||'').trim() === t);
            if (!n) return null;
            const r = n.getBoundingClientRect();
            return {x: r.x + r.width/2, y: r.y + r.height/2, w: r.width, h: r.height};
        }""", text)
        if not box or box["w"] == 0:
            return f"{text}: not-found"
