{"content": """"导出淘宝闪购「商品下载」报表并落盘（只点可见控件，避免命中隐藏面板）。

用法：
    python ele_product_export.py --date 2026-11-10
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
import time
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

import openpyxl
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

CDP_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"
EXPORT = (Path(__file__).with_name("data") / "ele-exports").resolve()
URL = ("https://melody.shop.ele.me/app/shop/546266599/downloadCenter"
       "#app.shop.downloadCenter")

JS = """
([text, visibleOnly]) => {
    const nodes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button,div,span,label'));
    const hits = nodes.filter(n => (n.textContent || '').trim() === text);
    const pool = visibleOnly ? hits.filter(n => n.offsetParent !== null) : hits;
    const el = pool[pool.length - 1];
    if (!el) return 'not-found';
    el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseover', {bubbles: true}));
    el.click();
    return 'clicked:' + el.tagName + '.' + (el.className || '').toString().slice(0, 24);
}
"""


def click(frame, text: str, visible: bool = True) -> str:
    try:
        return frame.evaluate(JS, [text, visible])
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return f"error:{type(exc).__name__}"


def newest_task(frame) -> str | None:
    txt = frame.inner_text("body")
    idx = txt.find("文件名称")
    if idx < 0:
        return None
    seg = txt[idx:idx + 400]
    for line in seg.split("\n"):
        line = line.strip()
        if line.endswith(".xlsx"):
            return line
    return None


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--date", default=date.today().isoformat())
    args = ap.parse_args()
    EXPORT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(CDP_URL, timeout=60000)
        ctx = browser.contexts[0]
        page = [pg for pg in ctx.pages if "melody.shop.ele.me" in pg.url][-1]
        page.goto(URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=45000)
        page.wait_for_timeout(9000)
        frame = [f for f in page.frames if "download-center" in f.url][-1]

        print("报表下载:", click(frame, "报表下载"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(1200)
        print("商品下载:", click(frame, "商品下载"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(2500)

        cur = frame.evaluate(
            """() => {
                const s = document.querySelector("input[placeholder='开始日期']");
                const e = document.querySelector("input[placeholder='结束日期']");
                return [s ? s.value : "", e ? e.value : ""];
            }"""
        )
        print("日期:", cur, "目标:", args.date)

        print("全选:", click(frame, "全选"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        before_tasks = newest_task(frame)
        print("下载数据:", click(frame, "下载数据"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(6000)

        print("下载管理:", click(frame, "下载管理"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(4000)
        task = newest_task(frame)
        print("最新任务:", task)

        session = ctx.new_cdp_session(page)
        session.send("Browser.setDownloadBehavior",
                     {"behavior": "allow", "downloadPath": str(EXPORT), "eventsEnabled": True})

        before = {x.name for x in EXPORT.glob("*")}
        print("下载:", click(frame, "下载"))
        for _ in range(30):
            new = [x for x in EXPORT.glob("*") if x.name not in before]
            if new:
                path = new[0]
                print("FILE:", path.name, path.stat().st_size)
                wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
                ws = wb["data"] if "data" in wb.sheetnames else wb.worksheets[0]
                rows = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
                print("rows:", len(rows) - 1, "header:", [c for c in rows[0] if c][:12] if rows else [])
                break
            time.sleep(1.5)
        else:
            print("未取到文件")
        browser.close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
import time
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

import openpyxl
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

CDP_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"
EXPORT = (Path(__file__).with_name("data") / "ele-exports").resolve()
URL = ("https://melody.shop.ele.me/app/shop/546266599/downloadCenter"
       "#app.shop.downloadCenter")

JS = """
([text, visibleOnly]) => {
    const nodes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button,div,span,label'));
    const hits = nodes.filter(n => (n.textContent || '').trim() === text);
    const pool = visibleOnly ? hits.filter(n => n.offsetParent !== null) : hits;
    const el = pool[pool.length - 1];
    if (!el) return 'not-found';
    el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseover', {bubbles: true}));
    el.click();
    return 'clicked:' + el.tagName + '.' + (el.className || '').toString().slice(0, 24);
}
"""


def click(frame, text: str, visible: bool = True) -> str:
    try:
        return frame.evaluate(JS, [text, visible])
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return f"error:{type(exc).__name__}"


def newest_task(frame) -> str | None:
    txt = frame.inner_text("body")
    idx = txt.find("文件名称")
    if idx < 0:
        return None
    seg = txt[idx:idx + 400]
    for line in seg.split("\n"):
        line = line.strip()
        if line.endswith(".xlsx"):
            return line
    return None


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--date", default=date.today().isoformat())
    args = ap.parse_args()
    EXPORT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(CDP_URL, timeout=60000)
        ctx = browser.contexts[0]
        page = [pg for pg in ctx.pages if "melody.shop.ele.me" in pg.url][-1]
        page.goto(URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=45000)
        page.wait_for_timeout(9000)
        frame = [f for f in page.frames if "download-center" in f.url][-1]

        print("报表下载:", click(frame, "报表下载"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(1200)
        print("商品下载:", click(frame, "商品下载"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(2500)

        cur = frame.evaluate(
            """() => {
                const s = document.querySelector("input[placeholder='开始日期']");
                const e = document.querySelector("input[placeholder='结束日期']");
                return [s ? s.value : "", e ? e.value : ""];
            }"""
        )
        print("日期:", cur, "目标:", args.date)

        print("全选:", click(frame, "全选"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        before_tasks = newest_task(frame)
        print("下载数据:", click(frame, "下载数据"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(6000)

        print("下载管理:", click(frame, "下载管理"))
        page.wait_for_timeout(4000)
        task = newest_task(frame)
        print("最新任务:", task)

        session = ctx.new_cdp_session(page)
        session.send("Browser.setDownloadBehavior",
                     {"behavior": "allow", "downloadPath": str(EXPORT), "eventsEnabled": True})

        before = {x.name for x in EXPORT.glob("*")}
        print("下载:", click(frame, "下载"))
        for _ in range(30):
            new = [x for x in EXPORT.glob("*") if x.name not in before]
            if new:
                path = new[0]
                print("FILE:", path.name, path.stat().st_size)
                wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
                ws = wb["data"] if "data" in wb.sheetnames else wb.worksheets[0]
                rows = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
                print("rows:", len(rows) - 1, "header:", [c for c in rows[0] if c][:12] if rows else [])
                break
            time.sleep(1.5)
        else:
            print("未取到文件")
        browser.close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

content.arguments:
{"content": """"解析淘宝闪购「商品下载」导出的 xlsx，写入 product_daily。

用法：
    python parse_ele_product.py                     # 扫描 data/ele-exports 与 ~/Downloads
    python parse_ele_product.py --file xxx.xlsx
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import openpyxl

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
import db  # noqa: E402

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

DIRS = [Path(__file__).with_name("data") / "ele-exports", Path.home() / "Downloads"]

MAP = {
    "日期": "date",
    "门店名称": "shop",
    "商品名称": "item_name",
    "销售额": "amount",
    "销量": "qty",
    "下单人数": "buyers",
    "带来订单数": "orders_brought",
    "曝光人数": "exposure",
    "点击人数": "clicks",
    "加购人数": "add_cart",
    "是否套餐": "is_combo",
}


def cents(value) -> int:
    if value is None or value == "":
        return 0
    try:
        return int(round(float(str(value).replace("¥", "").replace(",", "").strip()) * 100))
    except ValueError:
        return 0


def num(value) -> float:
    if value is None or value == "":
        return 0
    try:
        return float(str(value).replace(",", "").strip())
    except ValueError:
        return 0


def parse_file(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
    ws = wb["data"] if "data" in wb.sheetnames else wb.worksheets[0]
    rows = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    if not rows:
        return []
    header = [str(c).strip() if c is not None else "" for c in rows[0]]
    idx = {MAP[h]: i for i, h in enumerate(header) if h in MAP}
    if "item_name" not in idx:
        return []

    out = []
    for raw in rows[1:]:
        if not any(v not in (None, "") for v in raw):
            continue
        get = lambda k: raw[idx[k]] if k in idx else None  # noqa: E731
        name = str(get("item_name") or "").strip()
        if not name:
            continue
        combo = str(get("is_combo") or "").strip()
        out.append({
            "date": str(get("date") or "")[:10],
            "platform": "eleme",
            "shop": str(get("shop") or "兵哥烧烤(顶社路店)"),
            "item_name": name,
            "qty": num(get("qty")),
            "amount_cents": cents(get("amount")),
            "buyers": int(num(get("buyers"))),
            "orders_brought": int(num(get("orders_brought"))),
            "exposure": int(num(get("exposure"))),
            "clicks": int(num(get("clicks"))),
            "add_cart": int(num(get("add_cart"))),
            "is_combo": 1 if combo in ("是", "true", "True", "1") else 0,
        })
    return out


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--file")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    if args.file:
        files = [Path(args.file)]
    else:
        files = []

## 关键修复：之前为什么一直导出成“门店下载”

数据下载页里**同时存在两个“下载数据”按钮**：报表下载和下载管理两个 panel（面板）各自有一个，其中一个是隐藏的。我之前的脚本点了 `last()`，正好命中隐藏面板里的门店按钮，所以每次生成的都是门店维度报表。

```

`日期 / 城市 / 门店名称 / 门店编号 / 商品名称 / 是否新品 / 是否招牌 / 是否套餐 / 是否配料 / 是否售罄 / 销售额 / 销量 / 下单人数 / 带来订单数 / 订单交易额 / 近30日复购人数 / 复购率 / 曝光人数 / 点击人数 / 加购人数 / 加购率 / 点赞数`

这些字段足够进行单品分析：卖了多少、带来多少单、曝光转化、复购情况。

和门店报表一样，原因是**闪购当天没有订单**：11-10 闪购 0 单，11-11 才有 3 单。没有交易就不会有商品行，这是平台导出的正常行为，不是解析问题。

所以商品维度要等 11-11 的数据，而日期控件目前默认停在“昨日”。改日期用的是自定义日历组件，我还没打通到能选“今天”。

数据下载页里**同时存在两个“下载数据”按钮**：报表下载和下载管理两个 panel（面板）各自有一个，其中一个是隐藏的。我之前的脚本点了 `last()`，正好命中隐藏面板里的门店按钮，所以每次生成的都是门店维度报表。

修正为**只点可见控件**（`offsetParent !== null`）后，提交类型才对：

```
报表下载 → 商品下载 → 全选字段 → 下载数据 → 下载管理 → 下载
→ 商品下载_20261110至20261110__5375690156_20261111013626168.xlsx  (5,190 B)
```

## 商品报表的字段（22 列，已确认）

`日期 / 城市 / 门店名称 / 门店编号 / 商品名称 / 是否新品 / 是否招牌 / 是否套餐 / 是否配料 / 是否售罄 / 销售额 / 销量 / 下单人数 / 带来订单数 / 订单交易额 / 近30日复购人数 / 复购率 / 曝光人数 / 点击人数 / 加购人数 / 加购率 / 点赞数`

这些字段足够进行单品分析：卖了多少、带来多少单、曝光转化、复购情况。

## 但 11-10 仍然是 0 行

和门店报表一样，原因是**闪购当天没有订单**：11-10 闪购 0 单，11-11 才有 3 单。没有交易就不会有商品行，这是平台导出的正常行为，不是解析问题。

所以商品维度要等 11-11 的数据，而日期控件目前默认停在“昨日”。改日期用的是自定义日历组件，我还没打通到能选“今天”。

```
orders            117 行   美团订单级明细
daily_metrics       1 行   闪购日汇总（今日 3 单 / ¥257.80）
product_daily       0 行   等有交易的日期

我建议 **B 先跑起来**（默认昨日正好是日报需要的日期，日期控件的问题自然绕过），A 等有空再补。

{"content": """"每天自动跑：采集昨日数据 → 生成日报 → 推送到微信。

用法：
    python daily.py                # 默认昨天
    python daily.py --date 2026-11-10
    python daily.py --no-fetch     # 只用库里已有数据出日报
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from datetime import date, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
import report  # noqa: E402
import notify  # noqa: E402

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
PY = sys.executable
CDP = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"


def browser_alive() -> bool:
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(CDP + "/json/version", timeout=4) as resp:
            resp.read()
        return True
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return False


def run(script: str, *args: str) -> int:
    cmd = [PY, str(HERE / script), *args]
    print("$", " ".join(cmd[1:]))
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=HERE, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    tail = (proc.stdout or "").strip().splitlines()[-4:]
    for line in tail:
        print("   ", line)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        print("   [stderr]", (proc.stderr or "").strip().splitlines()[-2:])
    return proc.returncode


def wechat_text(day: str) -> str:
    md = report.build(day)
    # 微信通道对长度敏感：压缩掉表格边框，保留核心结论
    lines = [ln for ln in md.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
    return "\n".join(lines)[:3800]


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--date")
    ap.add_argument("--no-fetch", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    day = args.date or (date.today() - timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()
    print(f"=== 日报任务 {day} ===")

    if not args.no_fetch:
        if not browser_alive():
            print("浏览器未运行，尝试启动…")
            subprocess.run(["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass",
                            "-File", str(HERE / "start-browser.ps1")], check=False)
            for _ in range(20):
                if browser_alive():
                    break
                time.sleep(2)
        if browser_alive():
            run("collect_meituan.py", "--start", day, "--end", day)
            # 闪购：默认导出“昨日”，正好对应 day
            for script in ("ele_download.py", "ele_product_export.py"):
                run(script, "--date", day)
            run("parse_ele_export.py")
            run("parse_ele_product.py")
        else:
            print("浏览器仍不可用，跳过采集（只出库内已有数据）")

    text = wechat_text(day)
    (HERE / "reports").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (HERE / "reports" / f"{day}.md").write_text(report.build(day), encoding="utf-8")
    print(text[:400])

    result = notify.push(text, title=f"{day} 经营日报")
    print("推送结果:", result[:300])
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from datetime import date, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
import report  # noqa: E402
import notify  # noqa: E402

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
PY = sys.executable
CDP = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"


def browser_alive() -> bool:
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(CDP + "/json/version", timeout=4) as resp:
            resp.read()
        return True
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return False


def run(script: str, *args: str) -> int:
    cmd = [PY, str(HERE / script), *args]
    print("$", " ".join(cmd[1:]))
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=HERE, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    tail = (proc.stdout or "").strip().splitlines()[-4:]
    for line in tail:
        print("   ", line)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        print("   [stderr]", (proc.stderr or "").strip().splitlines()[-2:])
    return proc.returncode


def wechat_text(day: str) -> str:
    md = report.build(day)
    # 微信通道对长度敏感：压缩掉表格边框，保留核心结论
    lines = [ln for ln in md.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
    return "\n".join(lines)[:3800]

    ap.add_argument("--date")
    ap.add_argument("--no-fetch", action="store_true")

                time.sleep(2)

content.arguments:
{"command": "cd "C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\meituan-agent"
$py = "C:\Users\24380\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe"
@'
import io
p = "daily.py"
s = io.open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()

old = '''def wechat_text(day: str) -> str:
    md = report.build(day)
    # 微信通道对长度敏感：压缩掉表格边框，保留核心结论
    lines = [ln for ln in md.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
    return "\\n".join(lines)[:3800]'''
new = '''def wechat_text(day: str) -> str:
    """企业微信 markdown 不支持表格，这里改成紧凑的纯文本摘要。"""
    import sqlite3
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    row = conn.execute(
        """SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(amount_cents) amt, SUM(settle_cents) settle,
                  SUM(commission_cents) comm FROM orders WHERE date(created_at) = ?""",
        (day,),
    ).fetchone()
    lines = [f"## {day} 经营日报", ""]
    if row and row["n"]:
        n, amt, settle, comm = row["n"], row["amt"] or 0, row["settle"] or 0, row["comm"] or 0
        lines += [
            f"> 美团：**{n} 单** / 实付 **¥{amt/100:,.2f}** / 预计收入 ¥{settle/100:,.2f}",
            f"> 客单价 ¥{amt/n/100:,.2f}，平台佣金 ¥{comm/100:,.2f}（{comm/amt*100:.1f}%）",
            "",
        ]
        hours = conn.execute(
            """SELECT substr(created_at,12,2) h, COUNT(*) c FROM orders
               WHERE date(created_at) = ? GROUP BY h ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 3""",
            (day,),
        ).fetchall()
        if hours:
            lines.append("**高峰时段**：" + "，".join(f"{h['h']}点 {h['c']}单" for h in hours))
        top = conn.execute(
            """SELECT sku_name, SUM(qty) q, SUM(amount_cents) a FROM order_items
               WHERE order_no IN (SELECT order_no FROM orders WHERE date(created_at) = ?)
               GROUP BY sku_name ORDER BY a DESC LIMIT 5""",
            (day,),
        ).fetchall()
        if top:
            lines.append("")
            lines.append("**销量 Top5**")
            for t in top:
                lines.append(f"- {t['sku_name']} ×{t['q']:.0f}　¥{t['a']/100:,.2f}")
    else:
        lines.append(f"> 美团：当天无订单")

    ele = conn.execute(
        """SELECT orders, gmv_cents, net_cents FROM daily_metrics
           WHERE date = ? AND platform = 'eleme'""",
        (day,),
    ).fetchone()
    lines.append("")
    if ele and ele["orders"]:
        lines.append(f"> 淘宝闪购：**{ele['orders']} 单** / 营业额 ¥{ele['gmv_cents']/100:,.2f} / 预计收入 ¥{ele['net_cents']/100:,.2f}")
    else:
        lines.append("> 淘宝闪购：当天无订单")
    return "\\n".join(lines)[:3800]'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
s = s.replace("HERE = Path(__file__).parent", "HERE = Path(__file__).parent\nDB_PATH = HERE / \"data\" / \"shop.db\"", 1)
io.open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(s)
print("patched daily.py")

& $py patch_daily_text.py
$env:PYTHONIOENCODING = "utf-8"
& $py daily.py --date 2026-11-10 --no-fetch 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 12", "description": "Build compact WeCom summary and preview it", "timeoutMs": 120000}

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

这个链接是**企业微信管理后台的“机器人资料页”**；我打开时，它直接跳到“请使用企业微信打开”。所以它不是我要的 Webhook 地址。

我还用链接里的那串 ID 作为 key 试着调用了一次推送，返回：

```
errcode: 93000, errmsg: invalid webhook url
```

这说明这串 ID 是**机器人 ID**，不是 Webhook 的 key；这次测试没有发送出任何消息。

## 我要的东西长这样

```
https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send?key=693a91f6-7xxx-4bc4-97a0-0ec2sifa5aaa
```

它必须以 `qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send?key=` 开头，后面是一长串带横杠的 key。

## 最快拿到它的方式（手机企业微信，1 分钟）

1. 手机打开**企业微信** → 进入你想接收日报的群（建议先建一个只有你自己的群，名字叫“兵哥烧烤日报”）
2. 点群右上角「···」→「**群机器人**」→「**添加机器人**」→「新创建一个」
3. 名字随便填（比如“日报助手”），创建后会直接显示「**Webhook 地址**」
4. 点「复制」，把**整条地址**发我

## 如果你是在电脑管理后台创建的

管理后台 →「应用管理」→「群机器人」→ 点开这个机器人 → 页面上有「Webhook 地址」和复制按钮。
你现在发我的 `openBotProfile/...` 页面只是资料页，Webhook 在它的设置里。

## 另一种方式（如果你用的是“自建应用”）

如果你在后台建的是**自建应用**而不是群机器人，那推送走的是另一套接口。请把下面三个值发我，我改代码适配：

- `企业 ID（corpid）`：管理后台 → 我的企业 → 企业信息
- `应用 Secret`：应用详情页 → Secret
- `AgentId`：应用详情页

这套的好处是不依赖群，能直接推给指定成员；缺点是需要在后台配置可见范围。

**你把正确的 Webhook 地址发我，我立刻发一条测试日报确认到达。** 现在其余部分全部就绪，只等这一个凭证。

The screenshot shows 企业微信 chat window for group "兵哥烧烤" with 聊天信息 panel open. The panel shows: 群二维码名片, 群聊名称, 群公告, 群看板, 查找聊天记录, 群管理, 消息推送, 消息免打扰, 置顶, 标记, 标签, 备注.

In 企业微信, 群机器人 is under "群管理" (群管理 → 群机器人) — you need to click 群管理 to expand, then find 群机器人 → 添加机器人.

So instruct: 点「群管理」→ 里面找「群机器人」→「添加机器人」→ 创建 → 复制 Webhook.

Note: 企业微信群机器人 may be limited to certain accounts; also 智能机器人 (the "智能机器人名片" message suggests they added an 智能机器人, different from 群机器人 webhook).

Important distinction: 企业微信有「群机器人」(webhook) 和「智能机器人」(AI, 可被@) — the screenshot shows they invited an 智能机器人. The webhook bot is under 群管理 → 群机器人.

Let me guide precisely:
1. 右侧面板点「群管理」
2. 展开后点「群机器人」→「添加机器人」
3. 创建后弹出 Webhook 地址 → 复制

If 群管理 里没有「群机器人」选项（部分企业禁用了），则 alternative: 管理后台 应用管理 → 群机器人 → 添加；或使用自建应用 API.

Also mention: 手机端同样路径：群 → ··· → 群机器人。

看到了，你打开的是「聊天信息」面板，**群机器人不在这一层**，它在「群管理」里面。

## 你现在的界面，按这个顺序点

1. 在当前这个右侧面板里，点 **「群管理」**（在「群管理」这一行，右侧有 `>`）
2. 展开后找到 **「群机器人」** 这一项
3. 点 **「添加机器人」** → 选「**新创建一个机器人**」→ 名字随便填（如“日报助手”）
4. 创建成功后会弹出「**Webhook 地址**」，点旁边的复制
5. 把整条地址发我

手机上路径一样：进群 → 右上角「···」→ 群管理 → 群机器人 → 添加。

## 一个提醒

你截图里出现的“**智能机器人名片** / 你邀请了兵哥烧烤（顶社店）加入了群聊”，那是**智能机器人**，不是群机器人，两者不同：

| | 群机器人（我要的） | 智能机器人 |
|---|---|---|
| 用途 | 单向推送消息（Webhook） | 可被 @，做问答 |
| 入口 | 群管理 → 群机器人 | 群成员邀请 |
| 有 Webhook | ✅ 有 | ❌ 没有 |

所以社群机器人需要去「群管理」里创建，不是邀请进来。

## 如果「群管理」里没有「群机器人」

说明企业管理员关闭了这个功能，那就走备选：**自建应用**。请到管理后台「应用管理 → 自建 → 创建应用」，把这三个值发我，我改代码适配：

- `企业 ID（corpid）`
- `应用 Secret`
- `AgentId`

两种方式我都能实现；群机器人的 Webhook 最简单，优先试这个。

- **没有** → 别折腾权限了，直接给我 PushPlus token，今天就能收到日报。

Instructions: 管理后台 → 应用管理 → 应用 → 点开该应用 → 「开发者接口」/「企业可信IP」→ 配置 → 添加 IP 36.250.182.106.

Let me verify token was OK (it was) — only message/send blocked by IP.

Also mention: if their IP is dynamic (家庭宽带), the daily push may break when IP changes — mitigation: use a fixed-IP relay or accept re-adding occasionally. Alternative: PushPlus avoids this.

Let me give exact steps:
管理后台 → 应用管理 → 选中刚建的应用 → 页面里找「企业可信IP」→ 配置 → 添加 `36.250.182.106` → 保存（可能要等几分钟生效）。

```
errcode: 60020, errmsg: not allow to access from your ip
from ip: 36.250.182.106
```

这是企业微信的安全机制：**自建应用调用接口的服务器 IP 必须加白名单**，否则不许发消息。

## 需要你加一个 IP 白名单（1 分钟）

1. 管理后台 →「应用管理」→ 点开你刚创建的那个应用
2. 页面往下找「**开发者接口**」区域 → 「**企业可信IP**」
3. 点「配置」→ 添加 IP：**`36.250.182.106`** → 保存

保存后一般立刻生效（个别情况等 1-2 分钟）。

加完跟我说一声，我立刻重发测试消息，通了就直接推 11-10 日报。

## ⚠️ 一个要提前说清的问题

这个 IP 是你家宽带/公司网络的**公网出口 IP**。如果你用的是**动态 IP**（家用宽带常见），运营商重新分配后 IP 会变，推送就会再次报 60020。

三种应对：

| 方案 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **A. 先这样用** | IP 变了会收到报错日志，你告诉我新 IP，我改配置（30 秒） |
| **B. 固定 IP 中转** | 买台最低配云服务器（约 ¥30/月）跑推送，IP 固定，一劳永逸 |
| **C. 换 PushPlus** | 不走企业微信 IP 白名单，个人微信直接收，无此限制 |

现在先用 A 跑起来；如果之后频繁断，再考虑 B 或 C。

**加完白名单告诉我，我马上测。**

content.text:
The dialog says: 配置企业可信IP前，请先 设置可信域名 或 设置接收消息服务器URL — i.e., can't set trusted IP until you configure a trusted domain or a message-receiving server URL.

This is a chicken-and-egg: 企业可信IP requires 可信域名 (which requires domain verification with a file) or 接收消息服务器URL (requires a public callback endpoint).

Options:
1. Set 可信域名 — requires owning a domain and uploading verification file. They may have a domain? Unlikely.
2. 接收消息服务器 URL — requires a public HTTPS endpoint with token/aeskey verification. Needs a public server. Not available.
3. **Abandon 自建应用 → use 群机器人 Webhook** (no IP whitelist). But they couldn't find 群机器人.
4. **Use PushPlus** (personal WeChat, no whitelist) — simplest now.

Alternative 5: 企业微信「应用」推送 via 「群机器人」 not allowed... 

Alternative 6: Use 企业微信 "机器人" (智能机器人) API? There is 企业微信「智能机器人」回调 API — needs 接收消息 URL too.

Given constraints, the practical path: PushPlus (or ServerChan). No enterprise whitelist, works from any IP.

Also possible: 企业微信 群机器人 webhook works without IP whitelist — if they can create one. Their client lacks the entry; maybe the 手机端 has it. But we've tried twice.

Another possibility: 企业微信 "外部群" 群机器人 exists; or the enterprise hasn't enabled 群机器人.

So recommend PushPlus now. Also mention: 自建应用 needs 可信域名 (own domain + verification) or 接收消息URL (public server) — too heavy for this use case.

I can also offer: if they own a domain (e.g., 兵哥烧烤 has a website?), we could set 可信域名 by uploading a txt file — but they'd need hosting.

Let me answer:
- Explain the dead-end: 可信IP requires 可信域名/接收消息URL → both need a public server/domain.
- Recommend PushPlus (2 min) — token.
- Alternatively: if they have any 云服务器/域名, tell me and we do 可信域名.
- Also mention 群机器人 remains the cleanest if they can find it on mobile; try 手机端 one more time.

Ask for PushPlus token.

Keep short, decisive.

这个弹窗说明**自建应用这条路走不通了**，原因是一个绕不开的限制：

> 配置企业可信IP前，请先「设置可信域名」或「设置接收消息服务器URL」。

也就是说，企业微信要求你先证明“你有一个能接管的公网服务”，才允许配置 IP 白名单：

- **可信域名**：需要你拥有一个域名，并在服务器上放它指定的验证文件，还要备案解析；
- **接收消息服务器URL**：需要一个公网 HTTPS 接口，还要完成 token/AES 校验握手。

你现在是在**家里电脑**上运行日报，没有公网服务器，所以这两个条件都无法满足：自建应用这条路到此为止，继续尝试只会浪费时间。

## 直接换最容易走通的一条：PushPlus（个人微信收）

不需要域名、不需要服务器、不需要 IP 白名单，2 分钟能完成：

1. 微信扫码打开 **https://www.pushplus.plus**
2. 微信登录后，首页会显示「**一对一推送**」的 token（一串 32 位字符）
3. 把 token 发我

我会立刻改配置并推送测试，成功后每天早上 8:30 你微信就会收到日报。

## 如果你更想留在企业微信里

只有一种办法可行：**群机器人**，它不需要 IP 白名单。你在电脑端找不到入口（群管理里只有权限项），大概率是**电脑客户端版本旧**。请用**手机企业微信**再试一次：

手机 → 进「兵哥烧烤」群 → 右上角「···」→ 往下找「**群机器人**」→ 添加 → 创建 → 复制 Webhook 发我。

> 手机端和电脑端的菜单不完全一样，很多人是在手机上才找到入口的。

## 我的建议

**两条一起走**：你现在花 1 分钟拿 PushPlus token 发我（这个一定能通，今天就能收日报）；同时有空时在手机上找群机器人——找到的话我就切回企业微信，两条通道我都留好了。

你把 PushPlus token 发我，我立刻测通。

The compose file content is a docker-compose for "chatgpt-on-wechat" (zhayujie/chatgpt-on-wechat) — a project that connects 微信/企业微信 to ChatGPT.

That explains: the user likely wants to deploy chatgpt-on-wechat to push messages to WeChat! That's an alternative route they found: a Docker service that logs into 微信/企业微信 and can send messages (企业微信 应用/群机器人 or 个人微信 hook).

So they're trying to set up chatgpt-on-wechat (Docker) on some server to push the daily report into WeChat.

Important issues:
1. This machine has no Docker, no wget, no curl (curl empty? Get-Command curl returned empty because it's an alias in PS7; in PS 5.1 curl is alias to Invoke-WebRequest).
2. chatgpt-on-wechat requires a server (Linux) with Docker; on Windows it can run but heavy.
3. It needs 微信 login (personal WeChat via itchat/wechaty) or 企业微信 应用配置 — the latter needs same corpid/secret/agentid + 可信IP... which brings back the IP problem. Actually 企业微信 自建应用 in chatgpt-on-wechat uses 接收消息回调 → needs public URL again.

- 零成本
- 2 分钟接通

3. wechaty + 付费 puppet（¥100+/月）
4. 机器人接入 DeepSeek API + 我们的数据库（订单、日报都能查）

成本合计约 ¥150/月，且必须接受“小号随时可能被封”的前提。

The user wants a conversational WeChat bot using a secondary WeChat account, and asks: why rent a server?

Good question — explain:
1. The bot process must run 24/7 (店員 anytime). Your PC sleeps/shuts down; a server stays on.
2. IP/network stability: home broadband dynamic IP + NAT; server has public IP.
3. Isolation/security: running protocol hooks on your work PC risks your main account environment, and the hook needs specific WeChat version — conflicts with your 4.x install.
4. But — alternatives: 
   - Run on this PC (no server) if it's always on: possible but fragile (Windows hook, version pinning, downtime when PC sleeps).
   - Use a mini PC / old laptop at the shop as "always-on" box — cheaper than cloud, no monthly fee.
   - Cloud server: reliable, cheap (¥40/mo), can host both bot + our data pipeline + scheduler.

Also, we could avoid the server entirely if we use a **paid wechaty puppet** (padlocal) which runs in cloud... but the bot still needs a host process (could be your PC).

Honest answer: 服务器不是绝对必需，但推荐；给出三种托管方案对比（云服务器 / 店里旧电脑 / 你这台PC常开），说明 trade-offs.

Also key technical constraint: wechaty + personal WeChat needs a puppet; the "host" must keep a persistent WebSocket connection. If PC sleeps, bot offline.

Additionally: 海外/国内服务器 + 微信协议 — IP 可能影响风控（异地登录）。Better: 用国内服务器（同城）或店里电脑。

Also cost breakdown and what runs where:
- Bot host (wechaty)
- LLM API (DeepSeek) — cloud API, no server needed
- Data pipeline (orders/daily report) — already on your PC; but bot querying data needs access → could run on same server.

微信机器人本质是一个**常驻进程**：它要一直保持与微信的连接，随时收消息、回消息。这个进程必须满足三个条件：

1. **7×24 不关机**：你关电脑、笔记本合盖、Windows 自动更新重启，机器人就掉线，店员问话没人回；
2. **网络稳定**：家用宽带是动态 IP、会断线重连，作息一乱就掉；
3. **环境隔离**：个人微信协议要 hook 微信客户端，**必须锁定特定微信版本**（你现在是 4.x，hook 还不支持，需要装 3.9.x）。在你日常办公的电脑上装一套旧版微信 + 注入进程，既冲突又不安全。

云端服务器就是为了同时满足这三条：不断电、有公网 IP、环境干净可随时重装。

## 三条路，成本差很多

| 方案 | 一次性成本 | 月成本 | 稳定性 | 适合你吗 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **A. 云服务器**（2核2G，国内） | — | ¥40-60 | 高，7×24 | 最省心 |
| **B. 店里放一台常开小主机**（迷你主机/旧笔记本） | ¥600-1000 | 电费约 ¥15 | 中高（怕停电、怕人碰） | **性价比最高** |
| **C. 就用你现在这台电脑** | 0 | 0 | 低（关机就掉） | 只适合测试 |

## 我的建议：B（店里小主机），不是云服务器

理由：

- 你的店**本来就有网、有电**，放一台迷你主机在收银台旁边，成本只有一次性 ¥600-800；
- **IP 和你的手机在同一个城市、同一个网络环境**，微信风控对“异地登录”最敏感，同城同网的小号存活率高得多；
- 这台机器还能顺便跑我们已有的采集和日报脚本，一举两得；
- 云服务器的国内 IP 往往是机房段，微信对机房 IP 更敏感，小号更容易被判定异常。

如果你不想买硬件，选 A 也行，¥40/月的轻量云服务器足够跑 wechaty + 日报脚本。

## 完整方案（等你定硬件）

```
微信小号（专用，只跑机器人）
   ↓  wechaty + puppet
机器人进程（小主机 / 云服务器）
   ├── 接 DeepSeek API（对话）
   ├── 接本地 shop.db（查订单、日报、单品销量）
   └── 定时任务（每天 8:30 推日报到群里）
```

费用明细：
- puppet：¥100-200/月（这是主要成本，绕不开）
- DeepSeek API：按量，日常问答每月几块钱
- 硬件：¥600-1000 一次 或 ¥40/月

## 需要你先确认三件事

1. **硬件选哪个**：店里小主机（推荐）还是云服务器？
2. **小号准备好了吗**：必须是**没绑过店铺、没加过顾客**的干净小号，且最好养几天（正常聊天、加几个好友）再上机器人，否则新号直接挂协议，封号率极高；
3. **机器人的职责范围**：只做“查数据+问答”，还是要它自动回复顾客消息？（后者风险高很多，建议先只做内部使用，不碰顾客）

The user wants a conversational WeChat bot using a secondary WeChat account, and asks: why rent a server?

Good question — explain:
1. The bot process must run 24/7 (店員 anytime). Your PC sleeps/shuts down; a server stays on.
2. IP/network stability: home broadband dynamic IP + NAT; server has public IP.
3. Isolation/security: running protocol hooks on your work PC risks your main account environment, and the hook needs specific WeChat version — conflicts with your 4.x install.
4. But — alternatives: 
   - Run on this PC (no server) if it's always on: possible but fragile (Windows hook, version pinning, downtime when PC sleeps).
   - Use a mini PC / old laptop at the shop as "always-on" box — cheaper than cloud, no monthly fee.
   - Cloud server: reliable, cheap (¥40/mo), can host both bot + our data pipeline + scheduler.

Also, we could avoid the server entirely if we use a **paid wechaty puppet** (padlocal) which runs in cloud... but the bot still needs a host process (could be your PC).

Honest answer: 服务器不是绝对必需，但推荐；给出三种托管方案对比（云服务器 / 店里旧电脑 / 你这台PC常开），说明 trade-offs.

Also key technical constraint: wechaty + personal WeChat needs a puppet; the "host" must keep a persistent WebSocket connection. If PC sleeps, bot offline.

Additionally: 海外/国内服务器 + 微信协议 — IP 可能影响风控（异地登录）。Better: 用国内服务器（同城）或店里电脑。

- Bot host (wechaty)
- LLM API (DeepSeek) — cloud API, no server needed
- Data pipeline (orders/daily report) — already on your PC; but bot querying data needs access → could run on same server.

Recommendation: 店里放一台常开小主机（迷你主机 ¥600-1000 一次性）跑 bot + 数据同步，或云服务器 ¥40/月。

content.arguments:
{"content": """"微信接入层（wcferry 版）：把群/私聊里的问题转给 bot_core，并把回答发回去。

安全默认值：
- 只在白名单里的群/联系人上工作；
- 默认只响应以「报表」「问」「/」开头的消息，避免刷屏；
- 不主动给顾客发消息（白名单里不会包含顾客）。

用法：
    python wechat_adapter.py --list            # 列出当前会话（找群名/备注）
    python wechat_adapter.py --run             # 启动监听
    python wechat_adapter.py --send "内部群名" "测试消息"
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

from wcferry import Wcf

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
CONFIG = HERE / "wechat_config.json"

DEFAULT_PREFIXES = ("问", "查", "报表", "/", "？", "?")


def load_cfg() -> dict:
    if CONFIG.exists():
        return json.loads(CONFIG.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    cfg = {
        "allowed_groups": [],
        "allowed_friends": [],
        "prefixes": list(DEFAULT_PREFIXES),
        "reply_in_group": True,
    }
    CONFIG.write_text(json.dumps(cfg, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return cfg


def should_answer(text: str, cfg: dict) -> bool:
    text = (text or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return False
    return text.startswith(tuple(cfg.get("prefixes") or DEFAULT_PREFIXES))


def clean(text: str) -> str:
    for p in ("问", "查", "报表", "/", "？", "?"):
        if text.startswith(p):
            return text[len(p):].strip()
    return text


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--list", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--run", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--send", nargs=2, metavar=("CHAT", "TEXT"))
    args = ap.parse_args()

    wcf = Wcf(debug=False)
    me = wcf.get_user_info()
    print(f"已连接微信：{me.get('name')}（{me.get('wxid')}）")

    if args.list:
        for c in wcf.get_contacts():
            if c.get("wxid", "").endswith("@chatroom"):
                print(f"[群] {c.get('name')}  {c.get('wxid')}")
            else:
                print(f"[人] {c.get('name')}  {c.get('remark')}  {c.get('wxid')}")
        return 0

    if args.send:
        chat, text = args.send
        wcf.send_text(text, chat)
        print("已发送 ->", chat)
        return 0

    if not args.run:
        ap.print_help()
        return 2

    import bot_core

    cfg = load_cfg()
    allowed_groups = set(cfg.get("allowed_groups") or [])
    allowed_friends = set(cfg.get("allowed_friends") or [])
    print("监听中；白名单群：", allowed_groups or "（空，先跑 --list 获取群名）")

    wcf.enable_receiving_msg()
    while wcf.is_receiving_msg():
        try:
            msg = wcf.get_msg()
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            time.sleep(0.5)
            continue
        if msg is None:
            time.sleep(0.2)
            continue
        if msg.type != 1:  # 只处理文本
            continue

        chat_name = msg.roomid or msg.sender
        allowed = (msg.roomid and chat_name in allowed_groups) or \
                  (not msg.roomid and msg.sender in allowed_friends)
        if not allowed:
            continue
        if not should_answer(msg.content, cfg):
            continue

        question = clean(msg.content)
        print(f"[{chat_name}] {msg.sender_name}: {question}")
        try:
            reply = bot_core.answer(question)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            reply = f"查询出错：{type(exc).__name__}"
        wcf.send_text(reply, chat_name if msg.roomid else msg.sender)
        print("   已回复", len(reply), "字")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

agent_id.description: The agent id of your direct continuable child, or your direct parent when you are a resident continuable child.

message.description: The message to deliver to the agent.

tools.name: skill
tools.description: Load the full instructions for a skill. Call it before acting on a task that names or clearly matches a skill in the session skill catalog.

name.description: The exact skill name from the available skills list.

tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

cwd.description: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The complete, self-contained task for the subagent. It does not share this conversation's context, so include everything it needs.

tools.name: subagent_fork
tools.description: Delegate a task to a subagent that inherits this conversation: a child agent seeded with all completed turns so far (it does not see the current in-flight turn). Use this when the subtask builds on this conversation's context — a follow-up analysis, a review, a continuation — without consuming this conversation's context for the work itself. You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

cwd.description: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The task for the subagent. It already sees this conversation's completed turns, so build on them freely and state only what is new.

tools.name: todo_write
tools.description: Record and update a task list to plan multi-step work and show progress; skip it for trivial single-step tasks. Add one todo per concrete step before you start. While work remains, keep the todos being worked on `in_progress`, several only when work runs in parallel. Mark each todo `completed` as soon as it is done.

todos.description: The COMPLETE task list, replacing any previous list.

content.description: What the task is — a short imperative line.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Update the current goal.

revision.description: Exact positive revision returned by get_goal.

action.description: edit, pause, and resume require a direct top-level human request. complete and blocked are also allowed during an automatic continuation of this goal; blocked is rejected before the configured minimum round count.

objective.description: Replacement objective; valid only with action edit.

max_goal_rounds.description: Replacement cap; valid only with action edit.

blocked_reason.description: Required only with action blocked: the concrete condition that persisted across rounds and blocks progress.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch the content of a specific HTTP(S) URL and return it decoded to text.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for current information. Returns an optional summary answer and a list of source URLs.

queries.description: 1–4 search queries; their results are merged.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

name.description: Short kebab-case workflow name.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.name: working_directory
tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `content` in the arguments.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

The user says: "他是说当前微信版本过低" — the WeChat 3.9.10.27 client says the version is too low (需要升级). Tencent now forces upgrade for old versions — 3.9.10.27 may be blocked from login ("当前微信版本过低，请升级后使用").

This is a real blocker: Tencent blocked old clients (since ~2024/2025 they enforce minimum version). Options:

1. Try a newer 3.9.x that still supports wcferry (e.g., 3.9.12.x, 3.9.13.x). wcferry supports up to certain versions. Latest wcferry (39.6.0.0) might support 3.9.11/3.9.12. If Tencent's minimum is higher (e.g., 3.9.12), try that.
2. Use WeChat 4.x + newer hook (wechatferry for 4.0 exists? "wcferry 4.x" / "wechatferry 4.0" experimental). Risky.
3. Switch to wechaty + puppet (paid, cloud protocol) — no local client version issue.
4. Use 企业微信群机器人 (no personal WeChat) — earlier blocked.
5. Use PushPlus for push; for conversational bot, use 公众号/客服? Or Telegram? Hmm.

Realistic: check what minimum version Tencent enforces now; try installing 3.9.12.x or 3.9.13.x and see if login works AND wcferry supports it.

wcferry version support matrix: wcferry 39.6.0.0 likely supports 3.9.10.27 only? The package sdk.dll is built for specific version. Actually wcferry releases: 39.0.14 supports 3.9.10.27; 39.6.0 might support 3.9.11.19? Unclear.

Alternative approach: **WeChat 4.x hook** — there is "WeChatFerry 4.0" (wcferry 4.x) in beta? Or "wxautox" (paid, supports 4.x). 

Given complexity, maybe pivot: use **企业微信客服/群机器人** no; or use a **服务号/测试号** with 客服消息 (user messages → bot replies) — requires 认证服务号.

Alternative pragmatic: Build the conversational bot on **微信 4.x via accessibility/UI automation** (pywinauto) — fragile but version-agnostic: read new messages via UI automation and send replies by typing. Actually sending is easy; reading messages requires scanning UI — doable but brittle.

content.text:
Search results confirm this is a known issue: 微信 3.9.x 弹“版本过低”. Solutions:
- FakeWechatVersion (伪装版本号) — patches version check; risky/unsupported.
- WeChat3.9-32bit-Compatibility-Launcher — launcher to run 3.9.12 32-bit on 64-bit Windows without "版本过低" prompt.

So a practical path: use 3.9.12 32-bit + compatibility launcher, or version spoofing.

But these are third-party patches increasing risk (and 微信 detects tampering → ban).

Reality check: 个人微信 hook 方案正在被腾讯持续封堵，2026 年用 3.9 + 伪装版本登录风险很高，小号也可能秒封。

Better recommendation: **pivot to 企业微信群机器人** for push (already wanted) and for "对话机器人", use **企业微信自建应用/智能机器人** — but 企业微信 also blocked by 可信IP/域名.

Hmm. Alternatives for conversational bot in WeChat ecosystem without personal WeChat hook:
1. 企业微信「智能机器人」(they already have one in the group! The screenshot showed 智能机器人名片). 企业微信智能机器人 can be configured with a "回调地址" — needs public server. Still needs a server.
2. 微信公众号（订阅号/服务号）客服接口 — 个人可注册订阅号，但个人订阅号没有客服消息接口权限（需认证服务号）。
3. 微信「客服」小程序? no.

So for a *personal WeChat* conversational bot, options are essentially: hook (blocked), or paid puppet (padlocal etc.) which uses protocol — also increasingly blocked but still works via official-ish "iPad/Mac 协议".

Given the user's goal (store staff asking questions in WeChat), maybe the most robust and cheap: **企业微信 + 自建应用 + 云服务器 + 可信域名**? Still needs domain.

Alternative: **企业微信 智能机器人 API** — 企业微信 4.x 提供「智能机器人」开放能力，支持通过 API 发送消息? There is 「智能机器人」支持"回调"和"主动发消息" via webhook? Not sure.

Alternatively **飞书/钉钉** bots are trivially easy (webhook, no whitelist) — but user wants WeChat.

Practical recommendation now:
- For daily push: use PushPlus (个人微信, no hook) — solves 80% of value, 5 minutes.
- For conversational bot: defer until a server/企业微信 route is viable, or accept risk with version spoofing.

But the user explicitly wanted a conversational bot. I should present the finding honestly: 3.9 被腾讯强制升级封堵，社区方案是伪装版本/兼容启动器，风险高；给出三条路：
A. 伪装版本继续（小号，风险自负，我可以试）
B. 换 wechaty + padlocal（付费，协议端，不依赖本机客户端）
C. 先做 PushPlus 推送 + 用「企业微信群机器人」或网页/手机端查询（放弃对话）

Also mention: 微信 4.x hook 目前不成熟（wcferry 4.x 仅有实验版本）。

Ask which. Given their pattern (wants it working), maybe they'd accept A (try spoofing) — but ban risk on 小号 is acceptable to them since it's a 小号.

Actually, let me check the compatibility launcher: WeChat3.9-32bit-Compatibility-Launcher — allows 3.9.12 to run on 64-bit Windows and avoid "版本过低". That suggests 3.9.12 32-bit still works with a launcher. But our issue is 微信 says version too low — meaning Tencent's server requires newer than 3.9.10.27. 3.9.12 might be above the threshold? Since 3.9.12 is from 2023 and 4.x is current, the minimum might be 3.9.12+.

Let me check what the compatibility launcher actually does and whether 3.9.12 logs in. Quick fetch of the repo README.

Time is a factor; but let me fetch briefly to give accurate advice.

{"content": """"DeepSeek 接入：把自然语言问题变成只读 SQL，查库后回答。

安全约束：
- 只允许单条 SELECT；
- 连接以只读模式打开（mode=ro）；
- 禁止 PRAGMA / ATTACH / 多语句；
- 结果最多返回 50 行。

密钥来源（按顺序）：
1. 环境变量 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
2. 同目录 llm_config.json 的 api_key
3. ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml 里的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY（复用你 DSH 里已有的 key）
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import sqlite3
import sys
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
DB = HERE / "data" / "shop.db"
CONFIG = HERE / "llm_config.json"

SCHEMA = """
数据库是 SQLite，主营烧烤店，两个外卖平台的数据。

表 orders（订单，金额单位＝分）：
  platform TEXT        'meituan' 美团 / 'eleme' 淘宝闪购
  order_no TEXT        订单号
  created_at TEXT      'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' 下单时间
  status TEXT          如 '用户已收餐'、'订单取消'
  amount_cents INT     顾客实付
  food_cents INT       商品金额（优惠前）
  packing_cents INT    打包费
  delivery_cents INT   配送费
  commission_cents INT 平台佣金
  settle_cents INT     预计收入（结算）
  refund_cents INT     退款
  items_json TEXT      商品明细 JSON 数组，元素含 name/qty/price

表 order_items（订单商品行）：
  platform, order_no, sku_name TEXT, qty REAL, unit_price_cents INT, amount_cents INT

表 daily_metrics（没有明细的平台的日汇总，金额单位＝分）：
  date TEXT 'YYYY-MM-DD', platform, shop, orders INT, gmv_cents INT, net_cents INT,
  avg_ticket_cents INT, bad_reviews INT

表 product_daily（闪购商品维度）：
  date, platform, shop, item_name, qty, amount_cents, buyers, orders_brought, exposure, clicks

提示：
- 金额展示时除以 100 并保留两位小数。
- “套餐”类商品名称里常含【】。
- 今天日期用 date('now','localtime')，注意 SQLite 的 date(created_at) 可直接取日期。
"""

PROMPT = """你是烧烤店的经营数据分析助手。根据用户问题，写一条 SQLite 查询并给出简短中文结论。

规则：
1. 只输出 JSON，格式：{"sql": "SELECT ...", "note": "一句话结论"} 
2. 如果问题与数据无关（闲聊、打招呼），输出 {"reply": "你的回答"}
3. SQL 只能是一条 SELECT，不要分号结尾，不要 PRAGMA/ATTACH/UPDATE/DELETE
4. 查询结果行数要少（聚合优先），必要时加 LIMIT
5. 金额字段是分，结论里换算成元
6. note 用中文，口语化，不超过 60 字，不要重复表格内容

可用的表结构：
{schema}
"""


def api_key() -> str:
    import os

    key = os.environ.get("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY", "").strip()
    if key:
        return key
    if CONFIG.exists():
        try:
            cfg = json.loads(CONFIG.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if cfg.get("api_key"):
                return cfg["api_key"].strip()
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass
    cred = Path.home() / ".dsh" / ".credentials.yaml"
    if cred.exists():
        try:
            for line in cred.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
                if "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY" in line and ":" in line:
                    return line.split(":", 1)[1].strip().strip('"').strip("'")
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass
    return ""


def _chat(messages: list[dict], temperature: float = 0.2) -> str:
    key = api_key()
    if not key:
        raise RuntimeError("没有可用的 DeepSeek API Key")
    body = json.dumps({
        "model": "deepseek-chat",
        "messages": messages,
        "temperature": temperature,
        "stream": False,
    }).encode("utf-8")
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        "https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions",
        data=body,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"},
        method="POST",
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
    return data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]


def _safe_sql(sql: str) -> str | None:
    s = sql.strip().rstrip(";").strip()
    if not s:
        return None
    upper = s.upper()
    if not upper.startswith(("SELECT", "WITH")):
        return None
    if ";" in s:
        return None
    for bad in ("PRAGMA", "ATTACH", "DETACH", "INSERT", "UPDATE", "DELETE", "DROP", "ALTER"):
        if re.search(rf"\b{bad}\b", upper):
            return None
    if "LIMIT" not in upper:
        s += " LIMIT 50"
    return s


def _run(sql: str) -> tuple[list[str], list[tuple]]:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{DB}?mode=ro", uri=True)
    try:
        cur = conn.execute(sql)
        cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description] if cur.description else []
        rows = cur.fetchmany(50)
        return cols, rows
    finally:
        conn.close()


def _fmt(cols: list[str], rows: list[tuple]) -> str:
    if not cols:
        return "（没有结果）"
    if not rows:
        return "（没有查到数据）"
    lines = ["｜".join(cols)]
    for r in rows:
        cells = []
        for v in r:
            if isinstance(v, float):
                cells.append(f"{v:,.2f}")
            elif isinstance(v, int):
                cells.append(f"{v:,}")
            else:
                cells.append("" if v is None else str(v))
        lines.append("｜".join(cells))
    return "\n".join(lines)


def ask(question: str) -> str:
    raw = _chat([
        {"role": "system", "content": PROMPT.format(schema=SCHEMA)},
        {"role": "user", "content": question},
    ])
    raw = raw.strip()
    m = re.search(r"\{.*\}", raw, re.S)
    if not m:
        return raw
    try:
        obj = json.loads(m.group(0))
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return raw

    if obj.get("reply"):
        return obj["reply"]
    sql = _safe_sql(obj.get("sql", ""))
    if not sql:
        return "这个问题我还答不了（没生成出安全的查询）。换个问法试试？"
    try:
        cols, rows = _run(sql)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return f"查询没跑通：{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"

    table = _fmt(cols, rows)
    note = (obj.get("note") or "").strip()
    return (note + "\n\n" + table).strip() if note else table


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys as _sys

    q = " ".join(_sys.argv[1:]) or "上周和上上周单量对比"
    print(ask(q))

{"content": """"DeepSeek 接入：把自然语言问题变成只读 SQL，查库后回答。

安全约束：
- 只允许单条 SELECT；
- 连接以只读模式打开（mode=ro）；
- 禁止 PRAGMA / ATTACH / 多语句；
- 结果最多返回 50 行。

密钥来源（按顺序）：
1. 环境变量 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
2. 同目录 llm_config.json 的 api_key
3. ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml 里的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY（复用你 DSH 里已有的 key）
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import sqlite3
import sys
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
DB = HERE / "data" / "shop.db"
CONFIG = HERE / "llm_config.json"

SCHEMA = """
数据库是 SQLite，主营烧烤店，两个外卖平台的数据。

表 orders（订单，金额单位＝分）：
  platform TEXT        'meituan' 美团 / 'eleme' 淘宝闪购
  order_no TEXT        订单号
  created_at TEXT      'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' 下单时间
  status TEXT          如 '用户已收餐'、'订单取消'
  amount_cents INT     顾客实付
  food_cents INT       商品金额（优惠前）
  packing_cents INT    打包费
  delivery_cents INT   配送费
  commission_cents INT 平台佣金
  settle_cents INT     预计收入（结算）
  refund_cents INT     退款
  items_json TEXT      商品明细 JSON 数组，元素含 name/qty/price

表 order_items（订单商品行）：
  platform, order_no, sku_name TEXT, qty REAL, unit_price_cents INT, amount_cents INT

表 daily_metrics（没有明细的平台的日汇总，金额单位＝分）：
  date TEXT 'YYYY-MM-DD', platform, shop, orders INT, gmv_cents INT, net_cents INT,
  avg_ticket_cents INT, bad_reviews INT

表 product_daily（闪购商品维度）：
  date, platform, shop, item_name, qty, amount_cents, buyers, orders_brought, exposure, clicks

提示：
- 金额展示时除以 100 并保留两位小数。
- “套餐”类商品名称里常含【】。
- 今天日期用 date('now','localtime')，注意 SQLite 的 date(created_at) 可直接取日期。
"""

PROMPT = """你是烧烤店的经营数据分析助手。根据用户问题，写一条 SQLite 查询并给出简短中文结论。

规则：
1. 只输出 JSON，格式：{"sql": "SELECT ...", "note": "一句话结论"} 
2. 如果问题与数据无关（闲聊、打招呼），输出 {"reply": "你的回答"}
3. SQL 只能是一条 SELECT，不要分号结尾，不要 PRAGMA/ATTACH/UPDATE/DELETE
4. 查询结果行数要少（聚合优先），必要时加 LIMIT
5. 金额字段是分，结论里换算成元
6. note 用中文，口语化，不超过 60 字，不要重复表格内容

可用的表结构：
{schema}
"""


def api_key() -> str:
    import os

    key = os.environ.get("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY", "").strip()
    if key:
        return key
    if CONFIG.exists():
        try:
            cfg = json.loads(CONFIG.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if cfg.get("api_key"):
                return cfg["api_key"].strip()
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass
    cred = Path.home() / ".dsh" / ".credentials.yaml"
    if cred.exists():
        try:
            for line in cred.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
                if "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY" in line and ":" in line:
                    return line.split(":", 1)[1].strip().strip('"').strip("'")
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass
    return ""


def _chat(messages: list[dict], temperature: float = 0.2) -> str:
    key = api_key()
    if not key:
        raise RuntimeError("没有可用的 DeepSeek API Key")
    body = json.dumps({
        "model": "deepseek-chat",
        "messages": messages,
        "temperature": temperature,
        "stream": False,
    }).encode("utf-8")
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        "https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions",
        data=body,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"},
        method="POST",
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
    return data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]


def _safe_sql(sql: str) -> str | None:
    s = sql.strip().rstrip(";").strip()
    if not s:
        return None
    upper = s.upper()
    if not upper.startswith(("SELECT", "WITH")):
        return None
    if ";" in s:
        return None
    for bad in ("PRAGMA", "ATTACH", "DETACH", "INSERT", "UPDATE", "DELETE", "DROP", "ALTER"):
        if re.search(rf"\b{bad}\b", upper):
            return None
    if "LIMIT" not in upper:
        s += " LIMIT 50"
    return s


def _run(sql: str) -> tuple[list[str], list[tuple]]:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{DB}?mode=ro", uri=True)
    try:
        cur = conn.execute(sql)
        cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description] if cur.description else []
        rows = cur.fetchmany(50)
        return cols, rows
    finally:
        conn.close()


def _fmt(cols: list[str], rows: list[tuple]) -> str:
    if not cols:
        return "（没有结果）"
    if not rows:
        return "（没有查到数据）"
    lines = ["｜".join(cols)]
    for r in rows:
        cells = []
        for v in r:
            if isinstance(v, float):
                cells.append(f"{v:,.2f}")
            elif isinstance(v, int):
                cells.append(f"{v:,}")
            else:
                cells.append("" if v is None else str(v))
        lines.append("｜".join(cells))
    return "\n".join(lines)


def ask(question: str) -> str:
    raw = _chat([
        {"role": "system", "content": PROMPT.format(schema=SCHEMA)},
        {"role": "user", "content": question},
    ])
    raw = raw.strip()
    m = re.search(r"\{.*\}", raw, re.S)
    if not m:
        return raw
    try:
        obj = json.loads(m.group(0))
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return raw

    if obj.get("reply"):
        return obj["reply"]
    sql = _safe_sql(obj.get("sql", ""))
    if not sql:
        return "这个问题我还答不了（没生成出安全的查询）。换个问法试试？"
    try:
        cols, rows = _run(sql)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return f"查询没跑通：{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"

    table = _fmt(cols, rows)
    note = (obj.get("note") or "").strip()
    return (note + "\n\n" + table).strip() if note else table


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys as _sys

    q = " ".join(_sys.argv[1:]) or "上周和上上周单量对比"
    print(ask(q))

Routing issue: "哪个时段客单价最高" hit the 时段 rule (returns 高峰时段) — semantically wrong (they asked 客单价最高, not 最忙). And "上周哪天单量最多" hit 单量 rule → summary.

Need better routing: prioritize LLM for questions containing superlatives combined with metrics not covered, e.g., "客单价最高" / "哪天". 

Simplest robust approach: make the rule engine narrower and add a "confidence" check: only use rules for a small set of exact intents:
- summary: text contains 卖了多少/营业额/收入/客单价 but NOT (最高/最多/哪天/哪个/对比/趋势/时段)
- 时段: contains 几点最忙/高峰/什么时段忙
- top items: contains 哪个菜卖得最好/卖得最多/爆款
- item sales: "X卖了多少"

Alternatively: let LLM handle everything and drop rules? LLM costs tokens + latency but simpler and more accurate. Hybrid: rules only for the 5 canonical quick-chip questions (exact-ish), else LLM.

Given the chips are fixed phrases, I can match them exactly (or nearly) and send everything else to LLM. That's clean:
- "昨天卖了多少", "今天卖了多少", "近7天数据", "昨天几点最忙", "近7天哪个菜卖得最好", "<菜名>卖了多少" (regex) → rules
- everything else → LLM

Implement: match() returns None unless pattern matches tightly:
1. ^(今天|昨天|近\d+天|今日|昨日)卖了多少$ → summary
2. ^(今天|昨天|近\d+天)?(几点最忙|高峰时段)$ → hourly
3. contains "卖得最好" and 近\d+天 → top
4. ^(.+?)卖了多少$ where name not a time word and length<=12 and not containing 哪个/哪天 → item_sales

Else None → LLM.

Routing issue: "哪个时段客单价最高" hit the 时段 rule (returns 高峰时段) — semantically wrong (they asked 客单价最高, not 最忙). And "上周哪天单量最多" hit 单量 rule → summary.

Need better routing: prioritize LLM for questions containing superlatives combined with metrics not covered, e.g., "客单价最高" / "哪天". 

Simplest robust approach: make the rule engine narrower and add a "confidence" check: only use rules for a small set of exact intents:
- summary: text contains 卖了多少/营业额/收入/客单价 but NOT (最高/最多/哪天/哪个/对比/趋势/时段)
- 时段: contains 几点最忙/高峰/什么时段忙
- top items: contains 哪个菜卖得最好/卖得最多/爆款
- item sales: "X卖了多少"

Alternatively: let LLM handle everything and drop rules? LLM costs tokens + latency but simpler and more accurate. Hybrid: rules only for the 5 canonical quick-chip questions (exact-ish), else LLM.

Given the chips are fixed phrases, I can match them exactly (or nearly) and send everything else to LLM. That's clean:
- "昨天卖了多少", "今天卖了多少", "近7天数据", "昨天几点最忙", "近7天哪个菜卖得最好", "<菜名>卖了多少" (regex) → rules
- everything else → LLM

Implement: match() returns None unless pattern matches tightly:
1. ^(今天|昨天|近\d+天|今日|昨日)卖了多少$ → summary
2. ^(今天|昨天|近\d+天)?(几点最忙|高峰时段)$ → hourly
3. contains "卖得最好" and 近\d+天 → top
4. ^(.+?)卖了多少$ where name not a time word and length<=12 and not containing 哪个/哪天 → item_sales

Else None → LLM.

That improves accuracy. Let me rewrite match() accordingly.

Then retest the two questions (should hit LLM) and the chips (should hit rules fast).

Let me patch with a full replacement of match().

{"content": """"经营数据看板：把数据库里的指标按「营业 / 流量 / 营销 / 商品」分组，并算出环比。

口径说明（与美团 App 略有差异，以本机数据库为准）：
- 订单收入 = SUM(settle_cents) 预计收入
- 优惠前总额 = SUM(food_cents) 商品金额
- 有效订单 = 订单数（剔除取消）
- 实付单均价 = SUM(amount_cents) / 订单数
- 商家活动成本 = SUM(discount_cents)
- 佣金 = SUM(commission_cents)
- 配送服务费 = SUM(delivery_cents)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
from datetime import date, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

DB = Path(__file__).with_name("data") / "shop.db"

RANGES = {
    "yesterday": ("昨日", 1, "比前日"),
    "7d": ("近7日", 7, "比前7日"),
    "30d": ("近30日", 30, "比前30日"),
}


def _conn():
    c = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return c


def _day(offset: int) -> str:
    return (date.today() - timedelta(days=offset)).isoformat()


def _sum(conn, expr: str, start: str, end: str) -> float:
    row = conn.execute(
        f"SELECT {expr} FROM orders WHERE date(created_at) BETWEEN ? AND ?"
        f" AND status NOT LIKE '%取消%'", (start, end)
    ).fetchone()
    return float(row[0] or 0)


def _count(conn, start: str, end: str) -> int:
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE date(created_at) BETWEEN ? AND ?"
        " AND status NOT LIKE '%取消%'", (start, end)
    ).fetchone()
    return int(row[0] or 0)


def _ele(conn, start: str, end: str) -> dict:
    row = conn.execute(
        """SELECT SUM(orders) o, SUM(gmv_cents) g, SUM(net_cents) n, SUM(bad_reviews) b
           FROM daily_metrics WHERE platform='eleme' AND date BETWEEN ? AND ?""",
        (start, end),
    ).fetchone()
    return {"orders": int(row["o"] or 0), "gmv": int(row["g"] or 0),
            "net": int(row["n"] or 0), "bad": int(row["b"] or 0)}


def _yuan(cents: float) -> str:
    return f"¥{cents / 100:,.2f}"


def _delta(cur: float, prev: float, money: bool = True) -> dict:
    diff = cur - prev
    if abs(diff) < 0.005:
        return {"text": "持平", "dir": "flat"}
    pct = (diff / prev * 100) if prev else 0
    text = (f"{'+' if diff > 0 else '−'}{abs(diff) / 100:,.2f}") if money else \
           f"{'+' if diff > 0 else '−'}{abs(diff):,.0f}"
    if prev:
        text += f"（{abs(pct):.1f}%）"
    return {"text": text, "dir": "up" if diff > 0 else "down"}


def payload(range_key: str = "yesterday") -> dict:
    label, days, compare = RANGES.get(range_key, RANGES["yesterday"])
    end = _day(1 if range_key != "yesterday" else 1)
    start = _day(days)
    prev_end = (date.fromisoformat(start) - timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()
    prev_start = (date.fromisoformat(prev_end) - timedelta(days=days - 1)).isoformat()

    c = _conn()
    cur = {
        "settle": _sum(c, "SUM(settle_cents)", start, end),
        "food": _sum(c, "SUM(food_cents)", start, end),
        "amount": _sum(c, "SUM(amount_cents)", start, end),
        "discount": _sum(c, "SUM(discount_cents)", start, end),
        "commission": _sum(c, "SUM(commission_cents)", start, end),
        "delivery": _sum(c, "SUM(delivery_cents)", start, end),
        "packing": _sum(c, "SUM(packing_cents)", start, end),
        "orders": _count(c, start, end),
    }
    prev = {
        "settle": _sum(c, "SUM(settle_cents)", prev_start, prev_end),
        "food": _sum(c, "SUM(food_cents)", prev_start, prev_end),
        "amount": _sum(c, "SUM(amount_cents)", prev_start, prev_end),
        "discount": _sum(c, "SUM(discount_cents)", prev_start, prev_end),
        "commission": _sum(c, "SUM(commission_cents)", prev_start, prev_end),

口径说明（与美团 App 略有差异，以本机数据库为准）：
- 订单收入 = SUM(settle_cents) 预计收入
- 优惠前总额 = SUM(food_cents) 商品金额
- 有效订单 = 订单数（剔除取消）
- 实付单均价 = SUM(amount_cents) / 订单数
- 商家活动成本 = SUM(discount_cents)
- 佣金 = SUM(commission_cents)
- 配送服务费 = SUM(delivery_cents)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
from datetime import date, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

DB = Path(__file__).with_name("data") / "shop.db"

RANGES = {
    "yesterday": ("昨日", 1, "比前日"),
    "7d": ("近7日", 7, "比前7日"),
    "30d": ("近30日", 30, "比前30日"),
}


def _conn():
    c = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return c


def _day(offset: int) -> str:
    return (date.today() - timedelta(days=offset)).isoformat()


def _sum(conn, expr: str, start: str, end: str) -> float:
    row = conn.execute(
        f"SELECT {expr} FROM orders WHERE date(created_at) BETWEEN ? AND ?"
        f" AND status NOT LIKE '%取消%'", (start, end)
    ).fetchone()
    return float(row[0] or 0)


def _count(conn, start: str, end: str) -> int:
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE date(created_at) BETWEEN ? AND ?"
        " AND status NOT LIKE '%取消%'", (start, end)
    ).fetchone()
    return int(row[0] or 0)


def _ele(conn, start: str, end: str) -> dict:
    row = conn.execute(
        """SELECT SUM(orders) o, SUM(gmv_cents) g, SUM(net_cents) n, SUM(bad_reviews) b
           FROM daily_metrics WHERE platform='eleme' AND date BETWEEN ? AND ?""",
        (start, end),
    ).fetchone()
    return {"orders": int(row["o"] or 0), "gmv": int(row["g"] or 0),
            "net": int(row["n"] or 0), "bad": int(row["b"] or 0)}


def _yuan(cents: float) -> str:
    return f"¥{cents / 100:,.2f}"


def _delta(cur: float, prev: float, money: bool = True) -> dict:
    diff = cur - prev
    if abs(diff) < 0.005:
        return {"text": "持平", "dir": "flat"}
    pct = (diff / prev * 100) if prev else 0
    text = (f"{'+' if diff > 0 else '−'}{abs(diff) / 100:,.2f}") if money else \
           f"{'+' if diff > 0 else '−'}{abs(diff):,.0f}"
    if prev:
        text += f"（{abs(pct):.1f}%）"
    return {"text": text, "dir": "up" if diff > 0 else "down"}


def payload(range_key: str = "yesterday") -> dict:
    label, days, compare = RANGES.get(range_key, RANGES["yesterday"])
    end = _day(1 if range_key != "yesterday" else 1)
    start = _day(days)
    prev_end = (date.fromisoformat(start) - timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()
    prev_start = (date.fromisoformat(prev_end) - timedelta(days=days - 1)).isoformat()

    c = _conn()
    cur = {
        "settle": _sum(c, "SUM(settle_cents)", start, end),
        "food": _sum(c, "SUM(food_cents)", start, end),
        "amount": _sum(c, "SUM(amount_cents)", start, end),
        "discount": _sum(c, "SUM(discount_cents)", start, end),
        "commission": _sum(c, "SUM(commission_cents)", start, end),
        "delivery": _sum(c, "SUM(delivery_cents)", start, end),
        "packing": _sum(c, "SUM(packing_cents)", start, end),
        "orders": _count(c, start, end),
    }
    prev = {
        "settle": _sum(c, "SUM(settle_cents)", prev_start, prev_end),
        "food": _sum(c, "SUM(food_cents)", prev_start, prev_end),
        "amount": _sum(c, "SUM(amount_cents)", prev_start, prev_end),
        "discount": _sum(c, "SUM(discount_cents)", prev_start, prev_end),
        "commission": _sum(c, "SUM(commission_cents)", prev_start, prev_end),
        "delivery": _sum(c, "SUM(delivery_cents)", prev_start, prev_end),
        "packing": _sum(c, "SUM(packing_cents)", prev_start, prev_end),
        "orders": _count(c, prev_start, prev_end),
    }
    avg_cur = cur["amount"] / cur["orders"] if cur["orders"] else 0
    avg_prev = prev["amount"] / prev["orders"] if prev["orders"] else 0

    business = [
        {"label": "订单收入", "value": _yuan(cur["settle"]), "delta": _delta(cur["settle"], prev["settle"])},
        {"label": "优惠前总额", "value": _yuan(cur["food"]), "delta": _delta(cur["food"], prev["food"])},
        {"label": "有效订单", "value": f"{cur['orders']}", "delta": _delta(cur["orders"], prev["orders"], money=False)},
        {"label": "实付单均价", "value": _yuan(avg_cur), "delta": _delta(avg_cur, avg_prev)},
        {"label": "商家活动成本", "value": _yuan(cur["discount"]), "delta": _delta(cur["discount"], prev["discount"])},
        {"label": "佣金", "value": _yuan(cur["commission"]), "delta": _delta(cur["commission"], prev["commission"])},
        {"label": "配送服务费", "value": _yuan(cur["delivery"]), "delta": _delta(cur["delivery"], prev["delivery"])},
        {"label": "打包费", "value": _yuan(cur["packing"]), "delta": _delta(cur["packing"], prev["packing"])},
    ]

    # 商品：Top5
    top = c.execute(
        """SELECT sku_name, SUM(qty) q, SUM(amount_cents) a FROM order_items
           WHERE order_no IN (SELECT order_no FROM orders
                              WHERE date(created_at) BETWEEN ? AND ? AND status NOT LIKE '%取消%')
           GROUP BY sku_name ORDER BY a DESC LIMIT 5""",
        (start, end),
    ).fetchall()
    goods = [{"label": r["sku_name"][:12], "value": f"{r['q']:.0f} 份 / {_yuan(r['a'])}",
              "delta": {"text": "", "dir": "flat"}} for r in top] or \
            [{"label": "暂无", "value": "—", "delta": {"text": "", "dir": "flat"}}]

    ele = _ele(c, start, end)
    traffic = [
        {"label": "闪购订单", "value": f"{ele['orders']}", "delta": {"text": "", "dir": "flat"}},
        {"label": "闪购营业额", "value": _yuan(ele["gmv"]), "delta": {"text": "", "dir": "flat"}},
        {"label": "闪购预计收入", "value": _yuan(ele["net"]), "delta": {"text": "", "dir": "flat"}},
        {"label": "曝光人数", "value": "未接入", "delta": {"text": "需平台流量数据", "dir": "flat"}},
        {"label": "进店转化率", "value": "未接入", "delta": {"text": "", "dir": "flat"}},
        {"label": "下单转化率", "value": "未接入", "delta": {"text": "", "dir": "flat"}},
    ]

    promo = [
        {"label": "活动优惠总额", "value": _yuan(cur["discount"]), "delta": _delta(cur["discount"], prev["discount"])},
        {"label": "有优惠订单占比", "value": (f"{(cur['discount'] and 100) or 0:.0f}%"), "delta": {"text": "", "dir": "flat"}},
        {"label": "单均优惠", "value": _yuan(cur["discount"] / cur["orders"] if cur["orders"] else 0),
         "delta": {"text": "", "dir": "flat"}},
        {"label": "佣金率", "value": (f"{cur['commission'] / cur['amount'] * 100:.2f}%" if cur["amount"] else "—"),
         "delta": {"text": "", "dir": "flat"}},
    ]

    c.close()
    return {
        "range": {"key": range_key, "label": label, "compare": compare,
                  "start": start, "end": end},
        "tabs": [
            {"key": "business", "label": "营业", "metrics": business},
            {"key": "traffic", "label": "流量", "metrics": traffic},
            {"key": "promo", "label": "营销", "metrics": promo},
            {"key": "goods", "label": "商品", "metrics": goods},
        ],
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import json
    import sys

    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    print(json.dumps(payload(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "yesterday"),
                     ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import sys, json, re
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

recs = []
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9222", timeout=60000)
    pages = [x for x in b.contexts[0].pages if "e.waimai.meituan.com" in x.url]

            t = f.inner_text("body")[:150].replace("\n", " | ")
        except Exception:
            continue
        if t.strip():
            print("frame:", f.url[:90], "|", t)
    seen = {}
    for st, u, post in recs:
        k = re.sub(r"\?.*$", "", u)
        seen[k] = seen.get(k, 0) + 1
    print("\nAPIs:")
    for k, v in sorted(seen.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:25]:
