| 菜品 | 成本 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 碳烤蚂蚱串 | ¥1.50 | 与「碳烤犸蚱串」同价 |
| 餐盒 | ¥0.50 | 打包盒单价，你确认下 |
| 加多宝 | ¥2.50 | 330ml 罐装进货价，你确认下 |

**这三个数是我估的**，如果不对告诉我实际成本，我改。

## 补完之后

| 平台 | 匹配率 | 食材成本 | 毛利率 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 美团 | **91%** | ¥2,253 | 34.9% |
| 闪购 | **92%** | ¥970 | 12.0% |
| 汇总 | — | ¥3,223（占收入 46.8%） | 28.3% |

**真菜品的成本已经 100% 覆盖**，剩下 9% 匹配不上的全是备注行：

```
微辣 / 中辣 / 不辣 / 特辣        数量 209
不要葱花芝麻                      数量 8
纯碳烤，非油炸                    数量 6
```

这些本来就不该有成本（是口味选项和备注），匹配不上是正确的。

## 一个提醒：闪购毛利率只有 12%

对比一下：

| | 美团 | 闪购 |
|---|---|---|
| 毛利率 | 34.9% | **12.0%** |
| 食材成本率 | 45.8% | 49.3% |
| 推广成本率 | 3.6% | **10.1%** |
| 刷单成本率 | 15.7% | **28.7%** |

闪购的推广和刷单两项加起来占了收入的近 40%，这是毛利率被压到 12% 的主因。

**如果闪购继续这样，基本是在给平台和刷手打工。**

要不要我做一件事：把「刷单 + 推广」合并成一个「获客成本」指标，看看两个平台每单实际花多少钱买来一单？这个数字对决定要不要继续投闪购很有用。

## 一个提醒：闪购毛利率只有 12%

对比一下：

| | 美团 | 闪购 |
|---|---|---|
| 毛利率 | 34.9% | **12.0%** |
| 食材成本率 | 45.8% | 49.3% |
| 推广成本率 | 3.6% | **10.1%** |
| 刷单成本率 | 15.7% | **28.7%** |

闪购的推广和刷单两项加起来占了收入的近 40%，这是毛利率被压到 12% 的主因。

**如果闪购继续这样，基本是在给平台和刷手打工。**

要不要我做一件事：把「刷单 + 推广」合并成一个「获客成本」指标，看看两个平台每单实际花多少钱买来一单？这个数字对决定要不要继续投闪购很有用。

fn = '''

STOCK_KEYS = ("备货", "准备多少", "预估", "预测", "进多少", "要多少", "备多少")


def try_stock_forecast(text: str) -> str | None:
    """备货预估：按近 7 天销量算日均，给建议备货量（不经过大模型，口径稳定）。"""
    if not any(k in text for k in STOCK_KEYS):
        return None

    c = conn()
    menu_names = [r[0] for r in c.execute("SELECT name FROM menu_cost")]
    # 从问题里挑出提到的菜品
    picked = []
    for name in menu_names:
        core = name
        for w in ("碳烤", "炭烤", "烤", "小串", "串", "（", "）"):
            core = core.replace(w, "")
        if not core or len(core) < 2:
            continue
        if core in text or name in text:
            picked.append((name, core))
    # 去重（同一 core 只留一次）
    seen, items = set(), []
    for name, core in picked:
        if core in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(core)
        items.append((name, core))
    if not items:
        c.close()

对话条数: 3
最后一条:
 助手
【备货参考】按近 7 天销量估算（含美团+闪购）

两个问题都修好了。

## 为什么会这样

**问题 1：「（没有查到数据）」**

你问的是备货预估，这类问题走了 DeepSeek 那条路。DeepSeek 生成的 SQL 用 `platform='闪购'` 这种中文值去查，但数据库里存的是 `eleme`，条件永远匹配不上，所以查出来是空的。

**问题 2：「请求失败：TypeError: Failed to fetch」**

tools.description: Ask a subagent to stop its current work. This call returns without waiting for it to stop. You can continue a local direct child's conversation later with send_message. External executions stop permanently and cannot receive follow-ups. Subagents it started will keep running.

agent_id.description: The id of an agent created under you: your direct child or a deeper descendant.

tools.description: Request cancellation of a running background job.

reason.description: Optional short reason, recorded in the log and forwarded to the job.

tools.description: List your background jobs (running and finished) with their ids, kinds, and statuses.

tools.description: Read a background job: output since the previous read for stream jobs, or the result of a finished final-output job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

wait.description: Block until the job finishes or the timeout expires; a timed-out wait leaves the job running. Defaults to false.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait in milliseconds with wait: true. Defaults to and is capped by configuration.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List subagents you started, with their ids, labels, and status. running means it is working; inactive means it is not currently working. You will be notified when a subagent finishes; there is no need to keep checking its status. Use send_message to continue the conversation.

scope.description: children (default) lists direct children, which accept send_message in any status. descendants lists the whole tree below you with each entry's parent session id and depth; entries deeper than 1 accept only interrupt_agent.

tools.description: Get absolute paths to bundled Python and library directories, plus bundled Python distribution versions. Node.js and pnpm paths are included when the payload provides them. Python includes numpy, pandas, python-docx, python-pptx, openpyxl, Pillow, lxml, and XlsxWriter. Use these libraries for Office files unless the user or workspace instructions select another environment. When Node.js and pnpm paths are returned, run pnpm with that Node executable and pnpm script path. This does not change PATH or package-manager settings.

tools.name: present
tools.description: Declare existing files as final deliverables for the user. Use it when the user needs a separate file, especially Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks; prefer your final response when that suffices. The user opens the current files; their contents are not copied.

files.description: Usually the 1-2 most important deliverables; at most 4 per call.

path.description: Path of an existing regular file. Relative paths use the Session working directory.

description.description: Brief description for the user.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

Local times that do not exist in the zone are skipped; repeated local times fire once, at the earlier instant. After downtime, a recurring reminder delivers only its latest missed occurrence. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

title.description: Concise task name in the user's language, at most 120 characters. Name only the core action and subject; keep essential target identifiers such as PR numbers and branch names. Do not include execution frequency (e.g. daily, hourly), scheduled dates/times, time zones, task status, or configuration and execution details (e.g. read-only mode, profile-tag filters), even when embedded in the requested or existing title. Do not append parenthetical notes. Put scheduling information in the timing parameters and execution instructions in prompt.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekly.description: On the given weekdays at a local time.

The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

tools.name: subagent_fork

Use this when the subtask builds on this conversation's context — a follow-up analysis, a review, a continuation — without consuming this conversation's context for the work itself. You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

name.description: Short kebab-case workflow name.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

content.text:
IP 变了，系统已经自动跟上。

## 新地址

```
http://192.168.1.21:8000
```

（原来是 `192.168.5.57`，现在换到了 `192.168.1.x` 网段）

## 验证结果

```
当前 IP     192.168.1.21（WLAN）
服务状态    8000 监听中 ✅
二维码地址  http://192.168.1.21:8000 ✅
页面显示    已同步更新
```

之前加的「IP 变了自动更新」功能生效了——**页面顶部的二维码和文字都是实时生成的**，不用我手动改。

## 你需要做的

**手机重新扫一下顶部的二维码**，或者直接输入 `192.168.1.21:8000`。

旧的书签/收藏会失效，因为地址变了。

## 如果手机还是打不开

先确认手机连的是**同一个 WiFi**（现在电脑在 WLAN 上，网段 192.168.1.x）。

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import sys, re
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9222", timeout=60000)
    pg = [x for x in b.contexts[0].pages if "e.waimai.meituan.com" in x.url][-1]
    pg.goto("https://e.waimai.meituan.com/", wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=45000)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(7000)
    box = pg.evaluate("""() => { const el=document.querySelector('#顾客管理'); if(!el) return null; const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(); return {x:r.x+r.width/2,y:r.y+r.height/2}; }""")
    print("顾客管理:", box)
    pg.mouse.move(box["x"], box["y"]); pg.wait_for_timeout(600); pg.mouse.click(box["x"], box["y"]); pg.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    item = pg.evaluate("""() => { const n=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*')).filter(e=>e.children.length===0 && (e.textContent||'').trim()==='顾客评价'); if(!n.length) return null; const r=n[n.length-1].getBoundingClientRect(); return {x:r.x+r.width/2,y:r.y+r.height/2}; }""")
    print("顾客评价:", item)
    if item:
        pg.mouse.click(item["x"], item["y"]); pg.wait_for_timeout(12000)
    print("url:", pg.url[:110])
    for f in pg.frames:
        try: t = f.inner_text("body")
        except Exception: continue
        if "评价" in t and len(t) > 60:
            print("frame:", f.url[:90], "len", len(t))
            print("   ", re.sub(r"\s+", " | ", t)[:500])
    b.close()
'@ | Set-Content scripts/probe_reviews_mt.py -Encoding utf8

## 一、两边评价模块的实际情况

**闪购**（`melody-comment.faas.ele.me`）

```
顾客评价 | 评价详情 | 评价治理 | 评价有礼 | 评价置顶(0/3) | 回复模板
综合评分 4.9（领先 98% 同行）
近 60 天好评率 100%，5 分钟回复率 100%
```

好消息：闪购**自带「回复模板」功能**，说明平台本身支持模板化回复。

**美团**（`waimaieapp.meituan.com/h5/frontweb/comment`）

进入「顾客评价」后，默认打开的是**评分详情页**（商品质量分、服务体验分这些），评价列表还需要再点一层。这个页面结构比闪购复杂，需要再翻。

## 二、我建议的做法：先做「草稿」，再放开全自动

自动回复是**直接对顾客说话**，发出去就收不回。所以我想分两步：

**第一步：生成草稿（安全）**
- 每天 5:30（美团 5 点更新后）+ 每隔 2 小时（闪购实时）
- 抓未回复的评价
- 参考历史回复内容，生成一条回复草稿
- **显示在网页上，你点「发送」才发**

**第二步：确认稳定后改成自动**
- 加一个开关，勾上就自动发
- 差评单独处理（可以先只做自动草稿，人工确认）

## 三、需要你定三件事

**1. 回复内容从哪来？**

| 方案 | 效果 |
|---|---|
| A. 学习历史回复，套用类似话术 | 稳，像你自己写的 |
| B. DeepSeek 根据评价内容现写 | 灵活，但可能不像你的风格 |
| C. 模板库 + 关键词匹配（好评/差评/口味/配送） | 最可控 |

我倾向 **A + C 结合**：先按评价内容匹配历史相似回复，没有相似的再用 DeepSeek 写。

**2. 差评要不要自动回？**

好评自动回很安全（感谢+欢迎再来），差评涉及道歉、补偿承诺，写错会有麻烦。

建议：**好评自动，差评只生成草稿等你确认**。

**3. 回复要多长、什么语气？**

比如现在是这种风格吗：
> 感谢老板的支持！下次再来给你多放点辣～

还是更正式一些？

## 四、我能立刻做的

如果你同意上面的方向，我接下来会：

1. 翻出两个平台的**未回复评价列表**和**回复接口/操作路径**
2. 建立 `reviews` 表，把历史评价和回复都存下来（做训练素材）
3. 做一个「评价」页：未回复列表 + 生成的回复 + 一键发送
4. 接进定时任务

## 一个问题

**你的店现在有多少条未回复评价？**（大概数量，比如“最近 10 条都没回”）

这个数字决定我要不要做分页和批量处理——如果只有几条，简单做就行。

---

先确认这三件事，我再动手。你倾向哪个方案？

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9222", timeout=60000)
    pg = [x for x in b.contexts[0].pages if "waimaieapp.meituan.com/h5/frontweb/comment" in x.url or "e.waimai.meituan.com" in x.url][-1]
    print("url:", pg.url[:100])
    for f in pg.frames:
        if "frontweb/comment" not in f.url: continue
        print("frame:", f.url[:100])
        items = f.evaluate("""() => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div,span,a,li,button'))
            .map(e => { const r=e.getBoundingClientRect(); const t=(e.innerText||'').replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim();
                        return {t, y:Math.round(r.y), w:Math.round(r.width), h:Math.round(r.height)}; })
            .filter(o => o.t && o.t.length <= 10 && o.w > 0 && o.h > 0 && o.y > 100 && o.y < 260)""")
        seen = set()
        for o in items:
            if o["t"] in seen: continue
            seen.add(o["t"])
            print(f"   y={o['y']:>4} {o['t']}")
    b.close()

## 现在就能用：评价回复生成器

地址：**http://192.168.1.21:8000/reply**

用法：把顾客评价粘贴进去，再选星级，点击「生成回复」，复制即可。

实测效果（4 星评价「味道很好，分量足，就是配送慢了一点」）：

```
感谢您对口味和分量的认可。配送速度未能让您满意，我们深表歉意，
会与配送方沟通改进。欢迎您再次光临，期待为您提供更好的用餐体验。
```

符合你的要求：
- ✅ 正式、礼貌、不油腻
- ✅ 提到顾客夸的具体点（口味、分量）
- ✅ 对没夸的点（配送）致歉，但不编造
- ✅ 40~80 字，一段话
- ✅ 不用表情符号和网络用语

## 但「全自动」还差一步，需要坦白说明

我尝试自动抓取评价列表时，遇到了具体技术障碍：

**美团的评价列表**
- 菜单进入后默认打开的是「评分详情」页，其中展示商品质量分等数据。
- 点击「评价详情」后，路由确实变成了 `#/CommentList`，但页面内容是空的。
- 直接访问这个路由会返回 404，因为必须带完整 token 从外壳进入。

**闪购的评价列表**
- 点击「评价详情」标签后，视图没有切换，页面仍然停留在评分概览。

两个平台都采用**子应用嵌套**结构，和我之前遇到「订单查询」的情况一样：**页面能点开，但内容渲染不出来**。

## 下一步计划（需要你同意我再动手）

要打通全自动，得换思路——**从接口层入手**：

1. 抓包找出「评价列表」接口（和之前订单查询一样，是 `invoke` 类通用接口）
2. 用接口直接拿未回复评价，绕开页面渲染
3. 找到「提交回复」接口
4. 每天 5:30（美团更新后）+ 每 2 小时（闪购实时）跑一次
5. 好评自动回复，差评只生成草稿

**预计需要几轮尝试**，因为这类接口通常带签名（和闪购订单查询类似，可能还要 ksid）。

## 想先确认

在投入接口逆向之前，我想确认：

**你希望「自动回复」是全自动发出，还是生成草稿后你点一下确认？**

- 全自动：省事，但万一措辞不合适，已经发给顾客了
- 草稿确认：每条多点一次，但安全

我建议**先草稿确认跑一周**，看看回复质量稳定了再放开全自动。

你怎么看？确认后我就开始做接口这部分。

So Meituan comment API requires signed request (mtgsig) — hard to forge, but we can **intercept the page's own requests** by triggering UI actions (the app signs them).

So the path: drive the UI to make the app call the API, then capture responses. That means we need the list page to render... which is the blocker.

Alternative: call in page context a fetch with the app's own signature helper if exposed... unlikely.

Given the difficulty, this feature is genuinely hard: both platforms use signed APIs behind sub-apps that don't render in automation.

1. 已交付：评价回复生成器 /reply（可用，正式语气）。
2. 自动化受阻的真实原因（具体证据）：
   - 美团评价列表 app frame (`userComment_gw`) 渲染为空（len=0），接口 `/gw/customer/comment/list` 返回 605「非法入参」= 需要签名，不能直接调。

4. 可行替代：
   a. 半自动：你从 App 复制评价 → 粘到 /reply 生成 → 复制回 App（10 秒/条）
   b. 我继续找入口（体验中心/其他子应用），但不确定

我把能试的都试了，结论需要如实说明：**全自动回复这两家平台目前做不到**，原因很具体。

## 已交付（现在就能用）

**评价回复生成器**：http://192.168.1.21:8000/reply

粘贴评价 → 选星级 → 生成 → 复制。实测输出：

```
感谢您对口味和分量的认可。配送速度未能让您满意，我们深表歉意，
会与配送方沟通改进。欢迎您再次光临，期待为您提供更好的用餐体验。
```

正式、不油腻、贴合评价内容，符合你的要求。

## 为什么自动回复卡住了

**美团**

评价列表那个子应用（`frontend/ffw/userComment_gw`）在自动化环境里**渲染为空**：

```
frame [1] userComment_gw  len=0    ← 有框架，没内容
frame [2] ScoreDetailPage len=320  ← 只有评分详情能出来
```

想绕开页面直接调接口，被签名拦住：

```
POST /gw/customer/comment/list
→ {"code":605,"message":"非法入参"}
```

这是美团的**反爬签名**（mtgsig），请求必须由页面自己的 JS 生成，外部拼接不出来。

**闪购**

评价列表在 `melody-comment` 子应用里，点「评价详情」标签后视图不切换（和无头/有头无关，两种情况都试过）。

这和之前的「订单查询」不一样——订单查询只是无头被拒，换成有窗口就好了；**评价是渲染 + 签名双障碍**。

## 三条可行路线

**A. 半自动（今天就能用，推荐先这样）**

你在美团/饿了么 App 里看到新评价，复制文字 → 打开 `/reply` 粘贴 → 生成 → 复制回 App 发送。

一条约 10 秒。评价一天也就几条，成本可接受。

**B. 我继续找入口**

美团可能还有别的评价入口（比如「体验中心」下的子页面、或者老版评价管理页）。但我已经试了 5 个入口都没通，**不保证能找到**。

**C. 走官方开放接口**

美团/饿了么都有开放平台（需要企业资质申请，审核 1-2 周）。通过后能拿到评价列表和回复接口，才是真正的全自动。这个我能帮你写对接代码，但资质得你去申请。

## 我的建议

**先用 A**，同时我花点时间试 B（30 分钟内给你结论）。如果 B 走不通，再考虑 C。

你要我现在去试 B 吗？还是先用 A 过渡，把精力放在别的功能上？

tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

name.description: Short kebab-case workflow name.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.name: working_directory
tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `content` in the arguments.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

Hostname access timed out (LINK doesn't resolve). So IP is the only way — and it keeps changing.

Solution: make IP static. Options:
1. Router DHCP reservation (user must do in router admin).
2. Set static IP on the adapter (needs admin; may conflict).
3. Use a dynamic DNS / local hostname via mDNS (Windows doesn't advertise by default).

Best actionable: advise router DHCP binding; meanwhile give new URL + QR.

Also I can add a small convenience: a Windows shortcut/BAT that prints current URL and regenerates QR — but user needs phone.

Alternatively: use a fixed port-forwarding trick? no.

Let me also check whether the IP changes when WiFi reconnects — likely DHCP. Setting a static IP requires admin; the user might do it.

Let me provide:
- New URL
- QR image (present)
- Explain why it changed (DHCP)
- How to fix permanently: router 绑定 / 或者我给你一个设置静态 IP 的命令（需管理员）

Let me present QR and answer.

问题查到了：**不是服务挂了，是 IP 又变了**。

## 新地址

```
http://192.168.1.15:8000
```

## 当前状态

```
服务     8000 端口监听中 ✅
首页     200，长度 17,790 字节，正常 ✅
健康检查 ok ✅
二维码   http://192.168.1.15:8000（自动更新了）
```

你的手机打不开，是因为收藏/书签里还是昨天的 `192.168.1.21`，那个地址已经失效了。

## IP 变动记录

| 时间 | IP |
|---|---|
| 11-12 下午 | 192.168.5.57 |
| 11-12 晚上 | 192.168.1.21 |
| **11-13 现在** | **192.168.1.15** |

一天变了三次，这是路由器 DHCP 随机分配的结果。

## 怎么彻底解决

**方法一：路由器里固定 IP（推荐，一次搞定）**

进入路由器管理页面（通常是 `192.168.1.1`），找到「DHCP 静态地址分配 / 地址保留」，把电脑的 MAC 地址绑定成固定 IP（比如 192.168.1.50）。

**方法二：电脑设静态 IP（需要管理员权限）**

我可以给你命令，但需要你以管理员身份执行一次。

**方法三：每次变了我给你新地址（现在这样）**

反正页面顶部的二维码是实时生成的，你**重新扫一次**就能用新地址。

## 临时办法

现在最省事：**打开手机浏览器，手动输入 `192.168.1.15:8000`**，然后加到收藏。

或者扫这个新生成的码：

![新地址二维码](C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\meituan-agent\data\screenshots\qr_dashboard.png)

---

要我帮你把 IP 固定下来吗？如果选方法二，我可以写好命令（需要你以管理员身份粘贴一次）。

Q: 设静态 IP 后，WiFi 变了 IP 会变吗？

A: 
- 静态 IP 是绑在「无线网卡」上的，与 WiFi 名称无关。同一路由器下重连、重启都不会变。
- 但如果你换了**另一个 WiFi**（比如去店里/别人家/手机热点），那个网络的网段可能不是 192.168.1.x，静态 IP 会导致**连不上网**（需要手动改）。
- 而 DHCP 保留（方法一）只对该路由器有效，适配器保持自动，换网络不受影响。

推荐：如果家里这个 WiFi 是长期用的 → 静态 IP 没问题；如果经常带电脑出去 → 用方法一。

Static:

```
netsh interface ip set address name="WLAN" static 192.168.1.50 255.255.255.0 192.168.1.1
netsh interface ip set dns name="WLAN" static 192.168.1.1
```
Rollback:
```
netsh interface ip set address name="WLAN" dhcp
netsh interface ip set dns name="WLAN" dhcp
```

Warn: 选一个没被占用的 IP（如 .50），执行前确认.

先回答你的问题：**要看你换的是哪种“WiFi 变化”**。

## 静态 IP 的行为

| 情况 | 静态 IP 会不会变 |
|---|---|
| 同一 WiFi 断开重连 | **不会变** ✅ |
| 路由器重启 | **不会变** ✅ |
| 电脑重启 | **不会变** ✅ |
| **换到另一个 WiFi**（换路由器、手机热点、去店里） | **会出问题** ⚠️ |

关键点：静态 IP 是**绑在无线网卡上的**，不是绑在 WiFi 名称上。如果新网络的网段不是 `192.168.1.x`，由于 IP 不匹配，电脑会**上不了网**，需要手动改回去。

而方法一（路由器里做 DHCP 绑定）是绑在路由器上的，电脑保持自动获取，换网络时自动适配，更省心。

## 所以建议

- **电脑基本不出门、一直连家里这个 WiFi** → 静态 IP 合适
- **电脑会带出去** → 用方法一（路由器绑定）更安全

## 具体命令（当前网络信息）

```
网卡    WLAN
当前 IP 192.168.1.15
网关    192.168.1.1
子网掩码 255.255.255.0（/24）
MAC     28-A0-6B-4E-39-0A（路由器绑定时用这个）
```

**设静态 IP**（管理员 PowerShell，选个没人用的地址，比如 .50）：

```powershell
netsh interface ip set address name="WLAN" static 192.168.1.50 255.255.255.0 192.168.1.1
netsh interface ip set dns name="WLAN" static 192.168.1.1
```

**如果发现上不了网，用这个恢复自动获取**：

```powershell
netsh interface ip set address name="WLAN" dhcp
netsh interface ip set dns name="WLAN" dhcp
```

## 执行后你会得到

```
固定地址：http://192.168.1.50:8000
```

以后不管重启多少次都不变，手机收藏一次就够。页面上的二维码也会自动显示这个新地址。

## 桌面已有「打开看板.bat」

双击它会：

```
1. 自动读取当前局域网 IP
2. 打印地址，例如：http://192.168.1.15:8000
3. 自动复制到剪贴板

```

而且它会顺便检查服务是否在运行；未运行时会自动启动，无需手动操作。

## 手机怎么拿到新地址

三种方式，任选：

| 方式 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| **扫码**（最省事） | 电脑上打开看板，手机扫页面顶部的二维码 |
| **发微信** | 双击桌面脚本 → 地址已复制 → 粘贴到微信「文件传输助手」 |
| **手动输** | 双击脚本看窗口里的地址，手机上照着输 |

二维码是**实时生成**的，所以电脑上刷新页面后，二维码就是最新的。

## 现在的完整状态

| 项 | 状态 |
|---|---|
| 网页服务 | ✅ 运行中（8000 端口） |
| 自动恢复（10 分钟检查） | ✅ |
| 桌面启动器 | ✅ 已放桌面 |
| 二维码 | ✅ 实时跟随 IP |

## 一个小建议

如果你嫌 IP 变来变去麻烦，还有个折中办法：**只在路由器里改一次 DHCP 租期**（比如从 2 小时改成 7 天），这样 IP 不会频繁变，但换网络也不受影响。

大多数路由器在「LAN 设置 / DHCP 设置」里，改完重启路由器生效。

User sent a natural-language fake-order record: "前天闪购50反25两单，50反28三单。美团50反25一单，50反28一单。"

Our bot only parses simple "日期 平台 刷单 金额" patterns; this sentence has 档位+返现+单数 format → not matched → fell to DeepSeek (which may have replied something but didn't write DB).

Need to implement a parser for this format:
- "50反25两单" = 档位金额50、返现25、两单

def _tier_of2(price: int, rebate: int) -> str:

        return "A"
    if rebate == 28:
        return "B" if price >= 50 else "D"
    if rebate == 23:
        return "C"
    return "A"


def run_intent(obj: dict) -> str | None:
    """执行 DeepSeek 解析出来的结构化指令。"""
    import json as _json
    import sqlite3 as _sq
    import db as _db
    from datetime import datetime as _dt

    action = obj.get("action")
    if action not in ("record_fake", "record_fake_total", "record_ad"):
        return None

    day = obj.get("date")
    if not day:
        return None
    now = _dt.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    conn = _sq.connect(_db.DB_PATH)

    if action == "record_fake":
        entries = obj.get("entries") or []
        if not entries:
            conn.close()
            return None
        conn.execute(
            """CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fake_orders (
                 date TEXT NOT NULL, platform TEXT NOT NULL, channel TEXT NOT NULL,
                 codes TEXT, count INTEGER, raw TEXT, fetched_at TEXT,
                 PRIMARY KEY (date, platform, channel))"""
        )
        grouped: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
        for e in entries:
            plat = e.get("platform")
            if plat not in ("meituan", "eleme"):
                continue
            tier = _tier_of2(int(e.get("price") or 0), int(e.get("rebate") or 0))
            cnt = int(e.get("count") or 0)
            if cnt <= 0:
                continue
            grouped.setdefault(plat, {})
            grouped[plat][tier] = grouped[plat].get(tier, 0) + cnt
        lines = []
        for plat, codes in grouped.items():
            total = sum(codes.values())
            conn.execute(
                """INSERT INTO fake_orders (date, platform, channel, codes, count, raw, fetched_at)
                   VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
                   ON CONFLICT(date, platform, channel) DO UPDATE SET
                     codes=excluded.codes, count=excluded.count,
                     raw=excluded.raw, fetched_at=excluded.fetched_at""",
                (day, plat, "手动录入", _json.dumps(codes, ensure_ascii=False), total, "", now),
            )
            detail = "、".join(f"{k}×{v}" for k, v in sorted(codes.items()))
            lines.append(f"{'闪购' if plat == 'eleme' else '美团'} {total} 单（{detail}）")

        conn.close()
        if not lines:
            return None
        return f"已记录 {day} 刷单：" + "；".join(lines) + "\\n利润页的「刷单成本」会按档位重新计算。"

        cents = int(round(float(obj.get("amount") or 0) * 100))

            return None
        for p in (["meituan", "eleme"] if plat == "both" else [plat]):
            _db.set_fake_cost(day, p, cents // (2 if plat == "both" else 1))
        conn.close()
        return f"已记录 {day} 刷单成本 ¥{cents / 100:,.2f}"

    if action == "record_ad":
        plat = obj.get("platform")
        product = obj.get("product") or "推广"
        cents = int(round(float(obj.get("amount") or 0) * 100))
        conn.close()
        if plat not in ("meituan", "eleme") or cents <= 0:
            return None
        _db.set_ad_spend(day, plat, product, cents)
        return f"已记录 {day} {'美团' if plat == 'meituan' else '闪购'} {product} ¥{cents / 100:,.2f}"

    conn.close()
    return None

'''


**② 只说总额**

```
昨天美团刷单300块
→ 已记录 2026-11-12 美团 刷单成本 ¥300.00
```

**③ 推广花费**

```
今天闪购涨单宝花了12.5
→ 已记录 2026-11-13 闪购 涨单宝 ¥12.50
```

**④ 普通提问**（照常走查数）

```
昨天卖了多少
→ 【昨天】共 15 单，顾客实付 ¥842.25，预计收入 ¥622.14，客单价 ¥56.15
```

| 你说的 | 系统理解 |
|---|---|
| 「两单」「一单」「3单」 | 中文数字、阿拉伯数字都行 |
| 「50反25」「45反28」 | 档位金额 + 返现，自动归到 A/B/C/D |

解析这一步现在**每次都要调 DeepSeek**（约 1 秒）。如果只是查询，会多花一次调用。

Key inconsistencies:
- 11-11: ele_daily 9 单 / 401.07 收入, but ele_orders (订单查询) 15 单 / 692.85 实付.
- 11-12: ele_daily 7 单 / 284.72 收入, but ele_orders 9 单 / 401.00.

So two issues:
1. 单数不一致: ele_daily says 9/7, query says 15/9.
2. 收入 (revenue) from 经营分析 may be for different date boundaries or incomplete.

Wait: ele_daily 11-12 (7 单, 497.30 营业额) vs 订单 9 单 401 实付. 营业额 497 vs 实付 401 — plausible.

For 11-11: 营业额 659.80 vs 实付 692.85 — 实付 > 营业额? That suggests 营业额 for 11-11 is understated (maybe 经营分析 collected at a time before day end, or the daily snapshot captured partial day).

Indeed ele_daily 11-11 was written by ele_metrics (今日实时 KPI) at some point during the day (e.g., 15:00), not full day. That's the bug: 今日 KPI captured mid-day then never updated after day end.

Similarly 11-12 wrote 7 单/284.72.

Fix: after day ends, refresh ele_daily for yesterday/today from 经营分析 with full-day data (ele_period2 '昨日' or 自定义 date). Since 经营分析 has 昨日 tab, we can re-fetch for yesterday daily.

Better: compute ele_daily from ele_orders (query API) — we have per-order paid amounts; and 营业额 can come from 经营分析 custom date.

Simplest robust: ele_daily.revenue = sum(mt-like settle)? We don't have settle per order from query... customerPaidInfo is 顾客实付, not 收入.

Alternative: use 经营分析「自定义」for that date (ele_custom) to get 收入/营业额/单数 — authoritative.

Plan: run ele_custom for 11-11 and 11-12 to refresh ele_daily, then compare with orders.

ele_custom requires headed browser (works). Let me run for those two dates.

Then verify counts match orders (15/9).

- 11-11: 收入 595.94, 营业额 1,023.50, 14 单 (was 401.07 / 659.80 / 9 单)
- 11-12: 收入 339.30, 营业额 599.20, 9 单 (was 284.72 / 497.30 / 7 单)

So the bug confirmed: ele_daily was written from 今日实时 KPI mid-day and never refreshed after the day completed. Now corrected via 自定义.

Root cause: ele_metrics writes today's KPI (running total at that moment) into ele_daily. Since the daily job runs 8:30 and refresh every 30 min, the LAST write of the day happens ~23:59 (incomplete) and never re-corrected.

Fix: 
1. In ele_period2 (runs 8:30 daily) — it writes 昨日 to ele_daily, but earlier we saw it failing to parse ({}). Need to make it reliable: use ele_custom approach (自定义) for yesterday instead.
2. Simplest: in daily.py, replace `ele_period2.py` with `ele_custom.py --date <yesterday>` (自定义 path proven), and keep period tabs as backup.
3. Also refresh: still keep today's KPI, but daily job overwrites yesterday correctly.

Let me implement: daily.py → run ele_custom.py --date yesterday --skip-flow? We also want flow; ele_flow gives yesterday flow. So --skip-flow ok.

Also fix ele_daily now for 11-11/11-12 (done by ele_custom already).

Then verify profit for 前天/昨日 changes.

Let me patch daily.py and verify data.

content.text:
你说得对，**闪购 11 号和 12 号的收入确实错了**，已经修正。

## 错在哪

系统之前把「**今日实时 KPI**」的快照当成了当天最终数据。

具体是这样：

```
11-11 下午采集时：9 单 / 收入 401.07
11-11 全天结束：  14 单 / 收入 595.94   ← 真实值
11-12 下午采集时：7 单 / 收入 284.72
11-12 全天结束：  9 单 / 收入 339.30    ← 真实值
```

因为**每日任务在 8:30 跑，抓的是「昨日」，但昨日数据是在当天中途写入的**，收盘后没人再校正。

## 修正后的数据

| 日期 | 单数（修正前 → 修正后） | 收入（修正前 → 修正后） |
|---|---|---|
| 11-11 | 9 → **14** | ¥401.07 → **¥595.94** |
| 11-12 | 7 → **9** | ¥284.72 → **¥339.30** |

营业额也跟着修正：

| 日期 | 营业额 |
|---|---|
| 11-11 | ¥659.80 → **¥1,023.50** |
| 11-12 | ¥497.30 → **¥599.20** |

## 修正后的利润

| 区间 | 收入 | 单数 | 毛利 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 前天 11-11 | ¥595.94 | 14 | **¥128.88** |
| 昨日 11-12 | ¥339.30 | 9 | **¥147.33** |
| 近7日 | ¥2,502.40 | 64 | **¥444.78** |

**11-11 之前显示亏 ¥66，实际是赚 ¥129** —— 这和你说的“数据有问题”对上了。

## 根因修复

改了每日任务的采集方式：

```
原来：抓「今日实时 KPI」 → 中途快照，收盘后不更新
现在：抓「自定义日期 → 昨天」 → 完整一天的数据
```

`ele_custom.py` 用「自定义日期」选择器，拿到的就是**当天完整的结算数据**，不受采集时刻影响。

明早 8:30 起，昨日数据会自动是完整的。

## 一个提醒

**今天（11-13）的数据仍是实时值**，因为你还在营业，收入会继续涨。这是正常的——今天的数据要等明天 8:30 才会定稿。

要不要我把「今天的数据标注为实时、昨日及以前标注为已结算」也做进页面？这样你一眼能看出哪些数字还会变。

我们是每半小时抓一次数据，再近30日旁边添加一个刷新建，点击刷新时就主动抓一次数据

User wants: add a "刷新" (refresh) button next to 近30日 that triggers an immediate data collection.

Implementation:
1. Backend: POST /api/refresh → runs collectors in background (refresh.py or a subset), returns immediately with "started"; and /api/refresh/status to poll.
2. Frontend: button next to range chips; on click, call API, show "采集中…", poll status, then reload dashboard.

Concern: running full collectors takes ~2-4 minutes and needs browser (CDP). Should run async in a thread, with a lock to prevent concurrent runs.

Which collectors? A quick refresh: collect_meituan(today), mt_flow, mt_promo, ad_spend, ele_query(days=2), ele_metrics, ele_flow, ele_promo, ele_combo(optional). Keep ~2 min.

Implement in web_app: a module-level flag + thread running refresh.py via subprocess. Better: call refresh.py as subprocess (it handles browser start).

But refresh.py starts browser if not running — the browser may be offscreen running; fine.

Let me implement:
- /api/refresh (GET or POST) → if already running, return {running: true}; else start thread that runs `python refresh.py`, returns {started: true}.
- /api/refresh/status → {running, last_result, finished_at}.
- UI: button with spinner text; poll every 3s until done, then loadDash().

Let me code.

import io
p = "web_app.py"
s = io.open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()

# 后台刷新状态与执行
helper = '''

_refresh_state = {"running": False, "started_at": None, "finished_at": None,
                  "ok": None, "log": ""}
_refresh_lock = threading.Lock()


def _run_refresh() -> None:
    import subprocess
    py = sys.executable
    script = str(Path(__file__).with_name("refresh.py"))
    _refresh_state.update(running=True, ok=None, log="")
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run([py, script], cwd=str(Path(__file__).parent),
                              capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8",
                              errors="replace", timeout=1800)
        tail = (proc.stdout or "").strip().splitlines()[-6:]
        _refresh_state.update(ok=(proc.returncode == 0), log="\\n".join(tail))
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        _refresh_state.update(ok=False, log=f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
    finally:
        _refresh_state.update(running=False,
                              finished_at=datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S"))

'''
s = s.replace("class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):", helper + "class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):", 1)

# 路由
s = s.replace('''        if path == "/api/qr":''','''        if path == "/api/refresh":
            with _refresh_lock:
                if _refresh_state["running"]:
                    self._json({"running": True, "msg": "已在采集中"})
                    return
                _refresh_state.update(running=True, ok=None, log="",
                                      started_at=datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S"))
                threading.Thread(target=_run_refresh, daemon=True).start()
            self._json({"started": True, "msg": "已开始采集，约 1-3 分钟"})
            return

        if path == "/api/refresh/status":
            self._json(_refresh_state)
            return

        if path == "/api/qr":''')
io.open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(s)
print("后端刷新接口已加")

User wants: add a "刷新" (refresh) button next to 近30日 that triggers an immediate data collection.

Implementation:
1. Backend: POST /api/refresh → runs collectors in background (refresh.py or a subset), returns immediately with "started"; and /api/refresh/status to poll.
2. Frontend: button next to range chips; on click, call API, show "采集中…", poll status, then reload dashboard.

Concern: running full collectors takes ~2-4 minutes and needs browser (CDP). Should run async in a thread, with a lock to prevent concurrent runs.

Which collectors? A quick refresh: collect_meituan(today), mt_flow, mt_promo, ad_spend, ele_query(days=2), ele_metrics, ele_flow, ele_promo, ele_combo(optional). Keep ~2 min.

Implement in web_app: a module-level flag + thread running refresh.py via subprocess. Better: call refresh.py as subprocess (it handles browser start).

But refresh.py starts browser if not running — the browser may be offscreen running; fine.

Let me implement:
- /api/refresh (GET or POST) → if already running, return {running: true}; else start thread that runs `python refresh.py`, returns {started: true}.
- /api/refresh/status → {running, last_result, finished_at}.
- UI: button with spinner text; poll every 3s until done, then loadDash().

User: 刷新 shouldn't be a range option; clicking refresh while on 今日 should stay on 今日, just update data. Same for 近7日/近30日.

Current implementation: button is a .range div inside #ranges. Clicking it may trigger the range click handler (which sets state.range = el.dataset.k = undefined). Since the handler is bound to all '#ranges .range:not(.date-range)' — includes .refresh → clicking refresh sets state.range=undefined → dashboard falls back to yesterday.

Fix: 
1. Exclude .refresh from range handler (`:not(.refresh)`).
2. Better: move the refresh button out of #ranges row into its own place — e.g., right of tabs or in header. But user said "近30日旁边添加" earlier; now says it shouldn't be an option. Keeping position but making it visually distinct (icon button) is fine.

Also after refresh completes, we call loadDash() which uses current state.range — good, as long as state wasn't clobbered.

Let me:
- Change selector to `#ranges .range:not(.date-range):not(.refresh)`.
- Ensure clicking refresh doesn't change state.range.
- Style refresh as a distinct pill (maybe smaller, icon only ↻) to not look like an option.

Also verify: click 今日 → click 刷新 → after completion stays 今日.

Let me implement and test (fast: mock by checking state after click; actual refresh takes 3.5 min but state check immediate).

import sys; sys.path.insert(0, ".")
import dashboard as d, sqlite3
c = sqlite3.connect("data/shop.db"); c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
menu = d._menu_map(c)
DAY = "2026-11-13"
print(f"=== {DAY} 食材成本明细 ===\n")

def dump(platform):
    print(f"--- {'美团' if platform=='meituan' else '闪购'} ---")
    print(f"{'商品':<18}{'销量':>7}{'单位':>4}{'折份':>7}{'成本/份':>8}{'小计':>8}")
    total = 0.0
    miss = []
    if platform == "meituan":
        rows = c.execute("""SELECT sku_name, parent_name, SUM(qty) q FROM order_items
                            WHERE is_combo_parent=0 AND order_no IN
                              (SELECT order_no FROM orders WHERE date(created_at)=? AND status NOT LIKE '%取消%')
                            GROUP BY sku_name, (parent_name IS NOT NULL)""", (DAY,)).fetchall()
        for r in rows:
            served = d._servings_per_unit(r["sku_name"]) or 1
            portions = (r["q"]/served) if r["parent_name"] else r["q"]
            unit = d._cost_of(r["sku_name"], menu)
            sub = (unit or 0) * portions / 100
            total += sub
            if unit is None: miss.append(r["sku_name"]); continue
            print(f"{r['sku_name'][:17]:<18}{r['q']:>7.0f}{'份' if r['parent_name'] else '串':>4}{portions:>7.1f}{unit/100:>8.2f}{sub:>8.2f}")

昨天（11-13）的食材成本分两部分算，我把明细列出来。

## 公式

```
食材成本 = Σ（每样菜的「份数」 × 菜单里的「成本/份」）
```

summary.text:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Build a local web dashboard + conversational Q&A for the BBQ shop 兵哥烧烤, aggregating data from 美团 (Meituan) merchant backend and 闪购 (Ele.me/Taobao Shangou) merchant backend; data stored locally, never uploaded.
- User requests in order (all completed unless noted):
  - “接DeepSeek” → LLM-backed Q&A.
  - “按APP的公式” → Meituan App-aligned 营业 numbers.
  - “闪购的数据怎么没有” → add Ele.me data.
  - “推广和流量都抓但是推广和流量两个平台要分开”.
  - “商品这个界面能不能通过'订单管理'的'全部订单'这里抓取，而且要把套餐里的每一个单品销量提取出来，商品这个界面按销量排序”.
  - “套餐可以去掉，不用单独列在最后。营业近7日和近30日的数据是一样的，近30日的数据有问题”.
  - “每个数据都再加一个今日，前天，昨日的上周同期数据”.
  - “可以把同期数据也显示出来么，继续攻「自定义日期」”.
  - “闪购的今日数据也存成每日快照，并且打通它的自定义日期”.
  - “现在出来美团和闪购，再加一个汇总的列表就是把美团和闪购的数据加起来”.
  - “精度够用了，现在抓闪购推广”.
  - “网页服务开机自启，电脑启动的时候，每半小时后台自动抓取，闪购的套餐拆解从订单管理，订单查询这边入手，每一天的都要去统计”.
  - “闪购的套餐内计算时，酱油筋小串*10，鸡脚筋*8，牛油*10，多春鱼*5，牙签肉*20，鸡肉*30，烤腊肠*10，烤牛肉*30，烤鸭肠*30，烤玉米粒*10，后续录入的数据都要这么计算”.
  - “是B我算错了” (confirmed 11-10 美团 晓晓 = B).
  - “15元是10串的售价，10串的成本是5元”.
  - “闪购内的套餐是一份，碳烤蒜薹成本0.5，芝香肉串成本1，爆炒钉螺成本10，炒白螺成本7，烤犸蚱串1.5成本1.5”.
  - “利润这一栏再加上推广成本，美团的推广成本在【门店推广】，点金推广+涨单宝，查看，闪购的在【店铺推广】，推广魔方里查看，只需要记录昨天和今天这两天的就行。”
  - “A先加上，B也要去做”.
  - “可以试试消费记录看看”.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Windows 11; PowerShell 5.1/pwsh; DSH harness session.
- Playwright 1.65 driving installed Edge via CDP `http://127.0.0.1:9222` with dedicated profile `edge-profile`; headless `--headless=new` in `-Silent` mode; never handles passwords.
- SQLite `data/shop.db`; money in cents.
- Meituan: SPA shell `e.waimai.meituan.com` + cross-origin iframes on `waimaieapp.meituan.com`; unsigned order API `/gw/api/unified/r/order/list/page/history` called via in-page `fetch`; flow API `/gw/bizdata/flow/single/overview/tab?...&durationType={1|2|3|5}` (1=昨日, 2=近7日, 3=近30日, 5=今日); promo APIs `/ad/v4/homepage/account/info`, `/bff/ad/poi/v1/cpc/data/query/rt|his`.
- Ele.me: shell `melody.shop.ele.me` shopId `546266599`; stats sub-app `melody-stats-next.ele.me/new/#/single/business-analysis` (antd range picker with `td[title="YYYY-MM-DD"]`); downloads at `downloadCenter` (门店/订单/商品/评价下载, 商品下载 has 粒度=套餐子品); promo sub-app `r.ele.me/doujin-isv-manage/index.html?__path__=...` (paths: `elePcHome/index`, `accountPc/accountIndex`).
- WeChat push abandoned (`channel=file` only).

## Files and Code
- Project root: `C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\meituan-agent\`
- `web_app.py` — stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer on `0.0.0.0:8000`; routes `/`, `/api/dashboard?range=&platform=&sort=`, `/api/ask?q=`, `/api/report`, `/api/health`. UI: platform chips 美团/闪购/汇总; range row **选日期(日期input) / 今日 / 昨日 / 前天 / 近7日 / 近30日**; module tabs 营业 流量 推广 营销 商品 时间 刷单 利润; `.ranges` and `.tabs` horizontally scrollable; `localStorage.dashDate` remembers custom date; `renderTimeline(j)` draws dual timelines filtered by `state.platform`.
- `dashboard.py` — payload builder. Key pieces: `RANGES` dict (today/before/yesterday/7d/30d), `DAY_RANGES`, `date:YYYY-MM-DD` custom range support, `_delta()` (money values in cents; returns `text/prev`), `_meituan()`, `_eleme()`, `_all()`, `_merge_metrics()`, `_merge_goods()`, `_goods_rows()`, `_goods_metric()` (shows only 份), `_servings_per_unit()` (pack table → 10 if contains 串 → 1), `_goods_text()`, `_food_cost()`, `_profit_stats()`, `_profit_combined()`, `_fake_manual()`, `_fake_combined()`, `_time_stats()`, `_time_stats_ele()`, `_timeline()`, `_timeline_eleme()`, `_ad_cost()`, `_has_override()`, `_rebate_map()`, `_menu_map()`, `_cost_of()`.
- `collect_meituan.py` — paginated order pull, expands combos (`subDetails`), allocates combo revenue to children by à-la-carte weight; `order_items(is_combo_parent, parent_name)`.
- `mt_flow.py` (periods 5/1/2/3 + `mt_flow_daily`), `mt_promo.py` (today + `mt_promo_daily`), `ele_metrics.py` (today KPI + `ele_daily`), `ele_period2.py`, `ele_flow.py` (流量+商品, `ele_flow_daily`), `ele_promo.py`, `ele_combo.py` (套餐子品 + pack multipliers), `ele_custom.py` (custom date backfill, multi-day with `--sleep`, `ensure_module()`, month paging), `import_ele_combo.py`, `import_ele_orders.py` (parses `商品信息` into `ele_order_items`), `import_fake_orders.py`, `import_menu_costs.py`, `ad_spend.py`, `audit.py`, `refresh.py`, `daily.py`, `report.py`, `notify.py`, `llm.py`, `db.py`, `bot_core.py`.
- `ele_combo_pack.json`: `[["酱油筋",10],["鸡脚筋",8],["牛油",10],["多春鱼",5],["牙签肉",20],["鸡肉",30],["腊肠",10],["牛肉小串",30],["鸭肠",30],["玉米",10]]`.
- `fake_overrides.json`: `cells {"2026-11-05|meituan|小蚕":"2A+3C"}`, `declared {11-02:6, 11-03:6, 11-05:8}`, `rebate {"A":25,"B":28,"C":23,"D":28}`.
- `config.json`: `channel=file`, `food_cost_rate=0.35`.
- PowerShell: `start-browser.ps1`, `start_web.ps1`, `run_daily.ps1`, `watch_web.ps1`.
- `README.md` (comprehensive doc), `docs/启动浏览器.md`, `scripts/dev/` (320 scratch scripts).

## Errors and Fixes
- PS scripts mis-parsed Chinese → saved UTF-8 **with BOM**.
- Headless multi-URL → only one URL allowed.
- Leftover Singleton locks → delete before launch.
- CDP timeouts after many connects → kill `msedge.exe` procs matching `edge-profile` and restart.
- Ele.me tab clicks: use Playwright native `get_by_text().click()` (not JS `.click()`) to trigger React.
- Ele.me combo export downloaded wrong row → click the `span` “下载” inside the `tr` whose text contains `商品下载_`.
- Goods/expense double counting: `ele_goods` was queried without `period` filter (summed yesterday+7d+30d) → added `WHERE period = ?`.
- Combo tier codes stored cumulatively → stored per-channel `counts`; totals then matched user's sheet.
- 汇总 毛利 < sum of platforms: rebate in yuan subtracted from cents → `gross = settle - food_cost - rebate*100`.
- Duplicate `dashboard.py` function definitions (`_profit_stats`, `_food_cost`, `_fake_combined`, `_profit_combined`) caused shadowing/NameErrors → deleted duplicates, re-added missing ones.
- `ad_spend` 汇总 showed ¥0.00 when no data → shows 未采集.
- `ele_metrics` empty KPI overwrote today row with zeros → guard added.
- Excel lock file `~$刷单统计.xlsx` → skip names starting with `~$`.

## Pending Jobs
- Ele.me 推广昨日 spend: 消费记录 page now reachable in frame `r.ele.me/doujin-isv-manage/index.html?__path__=accountPc/accountIndex` and its text already contains daily rows (`2026-11-12 推广消费 -26.08`, `2026-11-11 -67.70`, `2026-11-10 -63.75`, `2026-11-09 -47.33`, `2026-11-08 -19.13`) — parser not yet written.
- Optionally sync the 5 newly added costs back into `兵哥烧烤价格.xlsx`.
- Optional: net profit including 平台佣金/配送费.
- Optional: delete/cancel command for manually entered fake/ad costs.

## Current Work
- Just opened Ele.me 消费记录 via the doujin account page and dumped its text, which shows per-day `推广消费` amounts (see Pending Jobs). 美团 消费记录 parsing is already implemented in `ad_spend.py` (product `推广消费合计`) and wired into `refresh.py`/`daily.py`.

## Next Step
- Add Ele.me 消费记录 parsing to `ad_spend.py`: locate the doujin frame with `__path__=accountPc/accountIndex`, regex `(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})[^|]*推广消费[^0-9-]*-([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)`, save as `platform='eleme', product='推广消费合计'`, then verify 利润页 yesterday shows 闪购推广 cost and rerun `audit.py`.

## Critical Context
- Dashboard URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`; LAN IP now **192.168.5.57** (changed from 192.168.1.21). Firewall rule for 8000 still not created (needs admin).
- Scheduled tasks: `DSH-Shangpu-Web` (logon), `DSH-Shangpu-WebWatch` (every 10 min, restarts service if 8000 down, log `logs/web_watch.log`), `DSH-Shangpu-Refresh30` (every 30 min), `DSH-Shangpu-Daily` (08:30).
- Latest verified numbers (near7日, 11-05~11-11): 汇总 收入 ¥6,883.45 / 食材 ¥3,188.00 (46.3%) / 推广 ¥177.82 / 刷单 ¥1,335.00 / 毛利 ¥2,182.63 (31.7%); 美团 收入 ¥4,915.22, 毛利 ¥1,890.96; 闪购 收入 ¥1,968.23, 食材 ¥934.74, 毛利 ¥469.49.
- 闪购 daily (11-08..11-11): 8/17/16/9 单; 营业额 549.60/1,028.35/1,123.50/659.80; 食材 151.03/239.62/288.13/255.96; 返现 184/162/218/0.
- 刷单 totals: 美团 30 单 (A×18 B×2 C×3 D×7, 返现 ¥771), 闪购 21 单 (A×8 B×13, ¥564), 汇总 51 单 / 30.0% of orders / ¥1,335; all-days rebate ¥2,152.
- 商品 units rule (final): 单点 = 串 → 份 = 串 / 每份串数; 套餐 = 份 directly; display **only 份**; 汇总 sums 份.
- 利润 formula: `毛利 = 预计收入 − 食材成本 − 推广成本 − 刷单返现`; 推广 prefers `product='推广消费合计'`, else sums all rows.
- Menu costs imported: 89 items + 5 added (碳烤蒜薹 0.5, 芝香肉串 1, 爆炒钉螺 10, 炒白螺 7, 碳烤犸蚱串 1.5) = 93 rows; unmatched now only 备注 rows (`不要葱花芝麻…`, `纯碳烤，非油炸`, `更多`, `进店爽吃`).
- Chat commands: `11-10 美团 刷单 300`, `昨天 闪购 刷单成本 120`, `昨天 美团 涨单宝 12`, `昨天 闪购 推广 30.5`; stored in `fake_cost_override` / `ad_spend`.
- 美团 消费记录 daily totals: 11-09 ¥73.44, 11-10 ¥55.40, 11-11 ¥48.98, 11-12 ¥38.15.
- 美团 商品 from `e.waimai.meituan.com` menu item `#门店推广`; Ele.me 推广 home shows 今日总消耗 only; 推广魔方 click returns to shell (unreachable).
- User preferences: step-by-step delivery, honest gaps over placeholders, numbers must match platform backends, concise Chinese replies with tables/screenshots.

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode
tools.description: Use only in plan mode. Present your plan for the user's review and, on approval, leave plan mode. The user may approve (carry out the plan from your next step) or keep planning — their feedback comes back in the tool result; revise and present again.

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

tools.name: interrupt_agent
tools.description: Ask a subagent to stop its current work. This call returns without waiting for it to stop. You can continue a local direct child's conversation later with send_message. External executions stop permanently and cannot receive follow-ups. Subagents it started will keep running.

agent_id.description: The id of an agent created under you: your direct child or a deeper descendant.

tools.name: job_kill
tools.description: Request cancellation of a running background job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

reason.description: Optional short reason, recorded in the log and forwarded to the job.

tools.name: job_list
tools.description: List your background jobs (running and finished) with their ids, kinds, and statuses.

tools.name: job_output
tools.description: Read a background job: output since the previous read for stream jobs, or the result of a finished final-output job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

wait.description: Block until the job finishes or the timeout expires; a timed-out wait leaves the job running. Defaults to false.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait in milliseconds with wait: true. Defaults to and is capped by configuration.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List subagents you started, with their ids, labels, and status. running means it is working; inactive means it is not currently working. You will be notified when a subagent finishes; there is no need to keep checking its status. Use send_message to continue the conversation.

tools.name: load_workspace_dependencies
tools.description: Get absolute paths to bundled Python and library directories, plus bundled Python distribution versions. Node.js and pnpm paths are included when the payload provides them. Python includes numpy, pandas, python-docx, python-pptx, openpyxl, Pillow, lxml, and XlsxWriter. description.description: Brief description for the user.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a reminder in the current session that delivers prompt when it becomes due. Supply exactly one timing parameter: after_seconds, at, every_seconds, daily, weekly, or cron. Local times that do not exist in the zone are skipped; repeated local times fire once, at the earlier instant. After downtime, a recurring reminder delivers only its latest missed occurrence. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

Do not include execution frequency (e.g. daily, hourly), scheduled dates/times, time zones, task status, or configuration and execution details (e.g. read-only mode, profile-tag filters), even when embedded in the requested or existing title. Do not append parenthetical notes. Put scheduling information in the timing parameters and execution instructions in prompt.

weekly.description: On the given weekdays at a local time.

tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

tools.name: subagent_fork
tools.description: Delegate a task to a subagent that inherits this conversation: a child agent seeded with all completed turns so far (it does not see the current in-flight turn). Use this when the subtask builds on this conversation's context — a follow-up analysis, a review, a continuation — without consuming this conversation's context for the work itself. You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

cwd.description: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent.

prompt.description: The task for the subagent. It already sees this conversation's completed turns, so build on them freely and state only what is new.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

name.description: Short kebab-case workflow name.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

"""按任意日期区间采集淘宝闪购经营分析（营业/流量），支持多日连跑。

设计要点（避免触发人机验证）：
- 两天之间随机间隔（默认 20~35 秒），不连发
- 每天校验页面「已选时间」确实是目标日期，不对就重试（最多 3 次）
- 连续失败 3 天即中止，不硬撞风控
- 日历弹层每天重新打开，不依赖上一次的状态

用法：
    python ele_custom.py --date 2026-11-09
    python ele_custom.py --start 2026-11-01 --end 2026-11-10 --sleep 25
    python ele_custom.py --start ... --end ... --skip-flow      # 只补营业
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import random
import re
import sqlite3
import sys
import time
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
from ele_flow import parse_flow  # noqa: E402
from ele_period2 import parse as parse_business  # noqa: E402

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
DB = HERE / "data" / "shop.db"
CDP = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"
HOME = "https://melody.shop.ele.me/app/shop/546266599/#app.shop.dashboard"


def ensure_tables() -> None:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    conn.execute(
        """CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ele_daily (
             date TEXT PRIMARY KEY, revenue_cents INTEGER, gmv_cents INTEGER, cost_cents INTEGER,
             orders INTEGER, avg_paid_cents INTEGER, fetched_at TEXT)"""
    )
    conn.execute(
        """CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ele_flow_daily (
             date TEXT PRIMARY KEY, expose_uv INTEGER, visit_uv INTEGER, order_uv INTEGER,
             visit_rate REAL, order_rate REAL, fetched_at TEXT)"""
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()


def frame_offset(frame, page) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """该 iframe 在主页面的位置（把 frame 内坐标换算成鼠标坐标）。"""
    try:
        el = page.evaluate(
            """() => {
                const f = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('iframe'))
                    .find(x => (x.src || '').includes('business-analysis'));
                if (!f) return null;
                const r = f.getBoundingClientRect();
                return {x: r.x, y: r.y};
            }"""
        )
        if el:
            return float(el["x"]), float(el["y"])
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001

```

```

给采集流程加了**自动补抓**：

```
每次采集时检查：闪购汇总的单数 < 订单明细的单数？
```

{"content": """"用「订单查询」接口的数据重建闪购每日汇总（实时、无需等经营分析定稿）。

口径（与平台一致，已核对）：
  营业额   = Σ 商品折后总价
  预计收入 = Σ 预计收入
  单数     = 订单条数
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
DB = HERE / "data" / "shop.db"


def main() -> int:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute(
        """CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ele_daily (
             date TEXT PRIMARY KEY, revenue_cents INTEGER, gmv_cents INTEGER, cost_cents INTEGER,
             orders INTEGER, avg_paid_cents INTEGER, fetched_at TEXT)"""
    )
    now = datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")

    rows = conn.execute(
        """SELECT date,
                  COUNT(*) AS n,
                  SUM(gmv_cents) AS gmv,
                  SUM(income_cents) AS income,
                  SUM(amount_cents) AS paid
           FROM ele_orders
           WHERE gmv_cents IS NOT NULL AND income_cents IS NOT NULL
             AND status NOT IN ('CANCELED', 'CANCELLED')
           GROUP BY date"""
    ).fetchall()

    updated = 0
    for r in rows:
        day = r["date"]
        n = r["n"] or 0
        if not day or n == 0:
            continue
        gmv = r["gmv"] or 0
        income = r["income"] or 0
        paid = r["paid"] or 0
        avg = int(round(paid / n)) if n else 0
        conn.execute(
            """INSERT INTO ele_daily (date, revenue_cents, gmv_cents, cost_cents, orders,
                                     avg_paid_cents, fetched_at)
               VALUES (?,?,?,NULL,?,?,?)
               ON CONFLICT(date) DO UPDATE SET
                 revenue_cents=excluded.revenue_cents,
                 gmv_cents=excluded.gmv_cents,
                 orders=excluded.orders,
                 avg_paid_cents=excluded.avg_paid_cents,
                 fetched_at=excluded.fetched_at""",
            (day, income, gmv, n, avg, now),
        )
        updated += 1
        print(f"  {day}  {n} 单  营业额 {gmv/100:,.2f}  预计收入 {income/100:,.2f}")

    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    print(f"闪购日汇总已更新 {updated} 天（来源：订单明细）")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

你这个方法**完全可行**，而且比等平台定稿更准、更快。已经实现了。

## 验证：订单接口算出来的和平台完全一致

拿 11-12 对比（那天平台已定稿）：

| 口径 | 订单接口算 | 经营分析 |
|---|---|---|
| 营业额 | ¥599.20 | ¥599.20 ✅ |
| 预计收入 | ¥339.30 | ¥339.30 ✅ |
| 单数 | 9 | 9 ✅ |

**分毫不差**，说明口径对。

## 字段来源

你说的那个问号里面的拆解，我按这个取：

```
营业额   = 「商品折后总价」（feeGroup 里第一项）
预计收入 = 「预计收入」total
```

例如一个订单：

```
商品折后总价  59.60
商家补贴     -19.60
平台补贴      -9.00
顾客实付      31.00
预计收入      30.54   ← 取这个
```

## 修好后的 11-13 闪购

| 项目 | 修正前（快照） | 修正后（接口算） |
|---|---|---|
| 单数 | 5 单 | **17 单** |
| 营业额 | ¥412.90 | **¥1,490.15** |
| 预计收入 | ¥254.72 | **¥934.60** |

**收入差了 3.7 倍**，这就是你说的“数据有问题”。

## 汇总页现在

| 平台 | 收入 | 食材成本 |
|---|---|---|
| 美团 | ¥772.30 | ¥377.43（匹配 91%） |
| 闪购 | **¥934.60** | ¥376.44（匹配 92%） |
| 合计 | **¥1,706.90** | ¥753.87（占 44.2%） |

食材成本率从 73.4% 降到 **44.2%**，回到正常区间了。

## 顺带修的一个显示问题

之前闪购食材成本写着「仅套餐部分（缺当日单品明细）」，其实明细是有的（223 条），判断逻辑写错了。现在正常显示「匹配 92% 销量」。

## 现在的采集链

```
ele_query.py            → 逐单抓：商品明细 + 营业额 + 预计收入
ele_daily_from_orders.py → 按日汇总，写入 ele_daily
```

这两个已经接进：
- 每 30 分钟自动采集
- 每天 8:30 日报
- 你点「↻ 刷新」

**以后闪购数据不用等平台定稿了**，订单接口一抓就能算出来。

tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

   实付单均价: ¥48.37

找到原因了，是**闪购的「支出」算成了负数**，把汇总带偏了。

## 问题

闪购昨日（11-14）的支出显示 **−¥775.44**，但实际应该是正的。

原因是：我昨天改成“用订单接口重建日汇总”时，**支出这一列写成了空值**，而页面在读到空值时会走一个错误的兜底公式，算出来就成了负数。

## 修正后

| 平台 | 支出（修正前 → 修正后） |
|---|---|
| 闪购 | −¥775.44 → **¥682.11** |
| 汇总 | −¥160.60 → **¥1,296.95** |

## 核对：闪购支出是这么来的

```
营业额  ¥1,658.95
预计收入 ¥976.84
支出 = 1,658.95 − 976.84 = ¥682.11 ✅
```

包括：平台佣金 + 商家补贴 + 配送费 + 其他扣款。

## 汇总页昨日（11-14）现在的全套数字

| 指标 | 数值 |
|---|---|
| 订单收入 | ¥1,895.60 |
| 优惠前总额 | ¥3,200.05 |
| **补贴及支出** | **¥1,296.95** ✅ |
| 有效订单 | 46 单 |
| 实付单均价 | ¥48.37 |

平台拆分：
- **美团**：收入 ¥918.76，补贴及支出 ¥614.84（活动补贴 406.10 + 佣金 95.54 + 配送 113.20）
- **闪购**：收入 ¥976.84，支出 ¥682.11

## 加了双保险

1. **数据层**：重建日汇总时，支出 = 营业额 − 预计收入，直接写正值
2. **页面层**：如果读到的支出是空值、负数或大于营业额，自动按 `营业额 − 收入` 重算

所以以后不会再出现负数了。

## 一个观察

闪购昨天的**支出率 41%**（682 / 1659），比美团的 40%（615 / 1541）略高。

但闪购的**收入率只有 59%**（977 / 1659），美团是 60%（919 / 1541）——基本持平。

真正拉开差距的是**单量**：闪购 24 单，美团 22 单，但闪购客单价 ¥40.70 比美团 ¥56.74 低了近 30%。
