tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

name.description: Short kebab-case workflow name.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.name: working_directory
tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

```
#11  美团 · 11-17 23:33 · 单号 508901

利润率
44.5%
```

## 计算方式

```
利润率 = 预计利润 ÷ 预计收入
```

例：¥33.22 ÷ ¥74.72 = **44.5%**

## 显示规则

- 利润率**跟随利润颜色**（绿色盈利，红色亏损）
- 亏损时显示负数，如 `-15.2%`
- 预计收入为 0 时显示 `—`

## 布局说明

加了第 5 个指标后，一行放不下，所以**利润率换到第二行**显示，更清楚也不挤。

如果你希望**5 个指标都挤在一行**（字会小一点），我可以调整。或者把「顾客实付」去掉只留 4 项，也可以。

## 现在的布局

**第一行**（金额，4 项）：

```
顾客实付   预计收入   食材成本   预计利润
¥24.80    ¥16.49   ¥9.30    ¥7.19
```

**第二行**（比例，2 项，字更大）：

```
利润率      补贴比例
43.6%      33.5%
```

## 计算方式

```
利润率   = 预计利润 ÷ 预计收入
补贴比例 = (顾客实付 − 预计收入) ÷ 顾客实付
```

## 用这单验证

```
顾客实付 ¥24.80，预计收入 ¥16.49
补贴金额 = 24.80 − 16.49 = ¥8.31
补贴比例 = 8.31 ÷ 24.80 = 33.5% ✅

利润率 = 7.19 ÷ 16.49 = 43.6% ✅
```

## 颜色区分

| 指标 | 颜色 |
|---|---|
| 利润率 | 绿色（盈利）/ 红色（亏损） |
| 补贴比例 | **橙色**（提示这是“让出去的钱”） |

## 比例含义

```
利润率  43.6%  ← 每赚 100 元收入，留下 43.6 元
补贴比例 33.5%  ← 顾客每付 100 元，你让掉 33.5 元给平台活动
```

两个数加起来不是 100%，因为**利润率还扣了食材成本**。

## 值得对比的数字

刚才这单补贴 33.5% 偏高（行业一般 20-25%），说明活动力度大。配合利润率 43.6% 看，还在健康范围。

if platform in ("eleme", "all"):
        try:
            for r in c.execute(
                """SELECT order_no, date, hhmm, amount_cents, income_cents, day_sn, gmv_cents
                   FROM ele_orders
                   WHERE date BETWEEN ? AND ?
                   ORDER BY date DESC, hhmm DESC LIMIT 200""", (start, end)).fetchall():
                rows = c.execute(
                    """SELECT item_name AS name, SUM(qty) qty, MAX(is_combo) is_combo
                       FROM ele_order_items WHERE order_no = ?
                       GROUP BY item_name""", (r["order_no"],)).fetchall()
                cost, items = cost_of_items(rows, True)
                out.append({
                    "platform": "eleme",
                    "sn": r["day_sn"],
                    "no": r["order_no"],
                    "gross": r["food_cents"] or 0,
                    "time": f"{r['date'][5:]} {r['hhmm'] or ''}".strip(),
                    "paid": r["amount_cents"] or 0,
                    "income": r["income_cents"] or 0,
                    "cost": int(round(cost)),
                    "profit": (r["income_cents"] or 0) - int(round(cost)),
                    "items": items,
                })
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass

    out.sort(key=lambda x: x["time"], reverse=True)
    return out[:80]

Bug: eleme branch references r["food_cents"] (doesn't exist in ele_orders) → KeyError → whole eleme block silently skipped.

Fix: use r["gmv_cents"].

Also fix duplicate: the "gross" insertion went to the wrong place (it replaced the meituan block's line? both blocks have same anchor). Let me patch: in eleme block set gross from gmv_cents.

Then handle "去订单详情抓取" for 闪购 原价: the query API's customerPaidInfo feeGroup has 商品折后总价; 原价 might be orderTotalPrice (also 折后) — hmm. For 闪购, "商品总价"原价 could be sum of item.price*quantity (item.price is 原价 per item!). In query response items have "price" and "total" (原价 total). Sum of totals = 商品原价总额 (before 折后).

So we can compute 原价 from items: sum(total) for plain items... but combos complicate.

Better: store per-order "gmv_orig_cents" = sum over items of (price × quantity) at top-level groups only (combo rows counted once).

Let me implement: in ele_query parse items, compute orig_total = sum(it.total or price*qty) for top-level items only (not combo children). Store new column gmv_orig_cents. Then dashboard uses that for 商品总价.

Let me patch ele_query + schema + backfill recent days, and fix the KeyError.

Given time, do it.

import io
p = "ele_query.py"
s = io.open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()

# 表结构加 gmv_orig_cents
s = s.replace('''             gmv_cents INTEGER, income_cents INTEGER, day_sn INTEGER, status TEXT, fetched_at TEXT)''',

             day_sn INTEGER, status TEXT, fetched_at TEXT)''')

'''def order_orig_cents(o: dict) -> int:
    """商品原价合计：顶层商品行的 price×quantity 之和。"""
    total = 0.0
    for g in (o.get("foodInfo") or {}).get("groups") or []:
        for it in g.get("items") or []:
            price = it.get("price")
            qty = it.get("quantity") or 1
            if isinstance(price, (int, float)):
                total += float(price) * float(qty)
    return int(round(total * 100))


def parse_order(o: dict) -> tuple[dict, list[dict]]:''')
s = s.replace('''    gmv_cents, income_cents = order_amounts(o)''',
'''    gmv_cents, income_cents = order_amounts(o)
    gmv_orig_cents = order_orig_cents(o)''')
s = s.replace('''             "gmv_cents": gmv_cents, "income_cents": income_cents,''',
'''             "gmv_cents": gmv_cents, "gmv_orig_cents": gmv_orig_cents,
             "income_cents": income_cents,''')

# SQL 写入
s = s.replace('''                             (order_no, date, hhmm, amount_cents, gmv_cents, income_cents, day_sn, status, fetched_at)
                           VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)''',
'''                             (order_no, date, hhmm, amount_cents, gmv_cents, gmv_orig_cents,
                              income_cents, day_sn, status, fetched_at)
                           VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)''')
s = s.replace('''                             gmv_cents=excluded.gmv_cents,
                             income_cents=excluded.income_cents,''',
'''                             gmv_cents=excluded.gmv_cents,
                             gmv_orig_cents=excluded.gmv_orig_cents,
                             income_cents=excluded.income_cents,''')
s = s.replace('''                        (row["order_no"], row["date"], row["hhmm"], row["amount_cents"],
                         row["gmv_cents"], row["income_cents"], row["day_sn"], row["status"], now),''',
'''                        (row["order_no"], row["date"], row["hhmm"], row["amount_cents"],
                         row["gmv_cents"], row["gmv_orig_cents"], row["income_cents"],
                         row["day_sn"], row["status"], now),''')
io.open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(s)
print("ele_query 增加原价合计")

'''def order_orig_cents(o: dict) -> int:
    """商品原价合计：顶层商品行的 price×quantity 之和。"""

    for g in (o.get("foodInfo") or {}).get("groups") or []:

            qty = it.get("quantity") or 1

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

name.description: Short kebab-case workflow name.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

原价 = 折后 in all cases — because 闪购 items' `price` already reflects 折后 (商家把价格直接设低), so there's no separate 原价. The platform's "商品折后总价" IS the item price sum; discounts are applied as 商家补贴 separately (实付 71.75 vs 商品 92.75).

So for 闪购, 商品总价 = 商品折后总价 (92.75) and 实付 71.75 — meaning 21 元 subsidy. That's the correct reading: 「商品总价」是商品价格合计，实付是扣掉优惠后的。

So implementation is correct; 原价 concept doesn't exist separately for 闪购.

{"content": "# 兵哥烧烤 · 经营数据助手 —— 分享包说明

这是一套**本地运行**的烧烤店经营看板，数据只存在自己电脑上，不上传任何服务器。

分享给朋友的烧烤店使用时，需要**换掉店铺标识**并**重新登录**（因为订单、评价都是各店自己的）。

---

## 一、他需要准备什么

| 项目 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| 电脑 | Windows 10 / 11 |
| 浏览器 | Microsoft Edge（系统自带即可） |
| Python | 3.10 以上（安装时勾选 **Add to PATH**） |
| 账号 | 美团外卖商家版 + 淘宝闪购商家版，各店自己的账号 |
| 网络 | 能正常打开商家后台 |

安装 Python 后，打开命令行执行一次：

```bash
pip install playwright qrcode pillow
```

（`playwright` 用来驱动浏览器采集，`qrcode`/`pillow` 用来生成看板二维码）

---

## 二、第一次使用（5 步）

### 第 1 步：解压

把收到的压缩包解压到任意目录，例如：

```
D:\bbq-helper
```

**注意：路径不要有中文和空格**（会出各种诡异问题）。

### 第 2 步：配置店铺

在解压目录右键 → 「在终端中打开」，执行：

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\setup_shop.ps1
```

按提示输入：

- **店铺名称**：比如「老王烧烤（XX店）」
- **闪购店铺 ID**：登录 `melody.shop.ele.me` 后，地址栏里 `/app/shop/` 后面那串数字
- **美团城市 region_id**：一般不用改，除非不在同一个城市（默认 1000350300 = 莆田）

脚本会自动把这些 ID 写进代码里。

### 第 3 步：登录两个平台

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\start-browser.ps1
```

会弹出一个 Edge 窗口（独立配置，不影响日常浏览器）：

1. 打开 `e.waimai.meituan.com`，用**自己店的美团账号**登录
2. 打开 `melody.shop.ele.me`，用**自己店的闪购账号**登录

登录一次可以管很久（一般几个月）。登录完把窗口关掉即可。

### 第 4 步：录入自己的成本

打开看板后，在对话框里输入：

```
房租每月3000，水电每月800，工人工资每月9000
```

菜品成本一个个录：

```
掌中宝成本1.5
多春鱼成本6
啤酒成本3.5
```

也可以点页面顶部「成本规则 →」查看已录入的全部成本。

### 第 5 步：启动看板

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\start_web.ps1
```

浏览器打开 `http://127.0.0.1:8000`，手机连同一个 WiFi 扫页面上的二维码也能看。

---

## 三、让它在后台自动跑

### 手动启动一次采集

```powershell
python collect_meituan.py --days 7
python ele_query.py --days 7
python ad_spend.py
python mt_flow.py
python ele_flow.py
python ele_daily_from_orders.py
```

### 设置成定时任务

在**管理员 PowerShell** 里执行（把路径换成自己的）：

```powershell
cd D:\bbq-helper
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install_tasks.ps1
```

会创建 4 个任务：

| 任务 | 频率 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| 看板服务 | 开机 | 启动网页 |
| 看门狗 | 每 5 分钟 | 服务挂了自动拉起 |
| 采集 | 每 30 分钟 | 抓订单/推广/流量 |
| 日报 | 每天 8:30 | 抓昨日完整数据 |

---

## 四、功能清单

| 模块 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| **营业** | 收入、单量、客单价、补贴、佣金、配送费 |
| **流量** | 曝光、进店、下单转化率 |
| **订单** | 逐单明细（客户实付/收入/成本/利润/利润率/补贴比例） |
| **推广** | 两平台推广花费 |
| **商品** | 按销量排序，套餐拆子品 |
| **时间** | 按小时看单量和收入 |
| **刷单** | 档位构成、返现支出 |
| **利润** | 毛利、固定成本、净利润 |
| **问答** | 对话框直接问，或口述录入数据 |

---

## 五、常见问题

**Q：数据会上传吗？**
不会。所有数据存在本机 `data\shop.db`，只有问答功能会调用 DeepSeek 接口（把问题转成 SQL，不传原始数据）。

**Q：换电脑怎么办？**
把整个目录拷过去（除了 `edge-profile` 文件夹），重新登录一次即可。

**Q：能两个人同时用吗？**
可以，手机连同一个 WiFi 访问电脑的 IP 就行，不用装任何 App。

**Q：闪购数据抓不到？**
检查浏览器是否登录、店铺 ID 是否填对。闪购的风控较严，采集失败时等 30 分钟自动重试。

**Q：要不要付费？**
程序本身免费。只有 DeepSeek 问答需要 API Key（可选，不填就用规则问答）。

---

## 六、注意事项

1. **不要在别人的电脑上登录自己的商家账号**，反之亦然
2. 采集用的是真实浏览器，平台可能检测到自动化行为，**建议采集频率不要低于 15 分钟**
3. 刷单数据、成本数据属于敏感经营信息，注意保管
4. 第一次采集建议只跑「近 7 天」，确认数据正确后再扩大范围

---

# 用法：powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\make_share_package.ps1

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$root = $PSScriptRoot
$stamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd"
$outDir = Join-Path $root "dist"
$pkgName = "bbq-helper-$stamp"
$pkgDir = Join-Path $outDir $pkgName

if (Test-Path $pkgDir) { Remove-Item $pkgDir -Recurse -Force }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $pkgDir -Force | Out-Null

Write-Host "收集代码文件..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

# 只带运行需要的文件
$patterns = @("*.py", "*.ps1", "*.json", "*.md", "*.vbs", "*.bat")
$skip = @("shop.json", "config.json", "fake_overrides.json", "refresh.log")

Get-ChildItem -Path $root -File -Include $patterns -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object {
    if ($skip -contains $_.Name) { return }
    Copy-Item $_.FullName -Destination $pkgDir -Force
}

# 保留必要的配置文件（不含个人数据）
foreach ($f in @("ele_combo_pack.json", "config.example.json")) {
    $p = Join-Path $root $f
    if (Test-Path $p) { Copy-Item $p -Destination $pkgDir -Force }
}

# 建空目录
foreach ($d in @("data", "logs", "reports", "docs")) {
    $p = Join-Path $pkgDir $d
    if (-not (Test-Path $p)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $p | Out-Null }
}

# 示例配置
$example = @'
{
  "channel": "file",
  "food_cost_rate": 0.4
}
'@
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $pkgDir "config.json"), $example, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

# 清掉能识别到原店铺的痕迹
Get-ChildItem $pkgDir -Filter *.py | ForEach-Object {
    $t = Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw -Encoding UTF8
    $t = $t.Replace("兵哥烧烤", "我的烧烤店")
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($_.FullName, $t, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}

$zipPath = Join-Path $outDir "$pkgName.zip"
if (Test-Path $zipPath) { Remove-Item $zipPath -Force }
Compress-Archive -Path (Join-Path $pkgDir "*") -DestinationPath $zipPath -Force

$size = (Get-Item $zipPath).Length / 1MB
$files = (Get-ChildItem $pkgDir -Recurse -File).Count
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "打包完成：" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "  $zipPath"
Write-Host ("  大小 {0:N1} MB，{1} 个文件" -f $size, $files)
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "分享时把 zip 发给对方，按《分享说明.md》操作即可。" -ForegroundColor Cyan

## 你的朋友需要做的操作

### 1. 安装环境（一次性）

安装 Python 3.10 以上版本，然后安装依赖：

```bash
pip install playwright qrcode pillow
```

### 2. 解压后运行配置脚本

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\setup_shop.ps1
```

脚本会询问以下三项：

| 项目 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 店铺名称 | 比如「老王烧烤（XX店）」 |
| 闪购店铺 ID | 登录后从地址栏 `/app/shop/` 后面获取 |
| 美团城市 region_id | 不同城市才需要修改，默认值为莆田 |

脚本会自动把店铺 ID 写入代码，因此不需要手动修改。

### 3. 登录他的账号

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\start-browser.ps1
```

弹出的浏览器窗口使用独立配置，不影响他日常使用的浏览器。请在窗口里分别登录**他自己**的美团和闪购账号。

### 4. 启动看板

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\start_web.ps1
```

### 5. 录入他自己的成本

在对话框里输入：

```
房租每月3000，水电800，工资9000
掌中宝成本1.5
```

## 打包脚本可以随时使用

以后代码有更新，重新打包一次即可：

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\make_share_package.ps1
```

它会自动生成带日期的 zip 文件。

## ⚠️ 三项注意事项

**1. 店铺 ID 必须修改**

代码里现在写的是你的闪购店铺 ID（546266599），如果不修改，就无法抓取他的数据。因此配置脚本是必须步骤。

**2. 美团城市 ID**

`region_id=1000350300` 对应莆田。如果他不在莆田，需要修改（配置脚本会提示）。

**3. 登录态不共享**

每个人都需要登录自己的账号。他的数据只会保存在他的电脑上，你完全看不到，你的数据也不会交给他。

## 代价估算

| 项目 | 时间 |
|---|---|
| 装 Python + 依赖 | 5 分钟 |
| 解压 + 配置 | 2 分钟 |
| 登录两个平台 | 3 分钟 |
| 录入成本 | 10-20 分钟（菜品多的话） |
| **合计** | **约 30 分钟** |

## 可选：DeepSeek 问答

程序里的智能问答需要 API Key。如果他不配置，就使用规则问答（「昨天卖了多少」这类仍然可用）；配置了才能进行「为什么客单价下降」这种分析。

## 你的朋友需要做的操作

### 1. 安装环境（一次性）

安装 Python 3.10 以上版本，然后安装依赖：

```bash
pip install playwright qrcode pillow
```

### 2. 解压后运行配置脚本

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\setup_shop.ps1
```

脚本会询问以下三项：

| 项目 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 店铺名称 | 比如「老王烧烤（XX店）」 |
| 闪购店铺 ID | 登录后从地址栏 `/app/shop/` 后面获取 |
| 美团城市 region_id | 不同城市才需要修改，默认值为莆田 |

脚本会自动把店铺 ID 写入代码，因此不需要手动修改。

### 3. 登录他的账号

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\start-browser.ps1
```

弹出的浏览器窗口使用独立配置，不影响他日常使用的浏览器。请在窗口里分别登录**他自己**的美团和闪购账号。

### 4. 启动看板

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\start_web.ps1
```

### 5. 录入他自己的成本

在对话框里输入：

```
房租每月3000，水电800，工资9000
掌中宝成本1.5
```

以后代码有更新，重新打包一次即可：

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\make_share_package.ps1
```

**1. 店铺 ID 必须修改**

代码里现在写的是你的闪购店铺 ID（546266599），如果不修改，就无法抓取他的数据。因此配置脚本是必须步骤。

**2. 美团城市 ID**

`region_id=1000350300` 对应莆田。如果他不在莆田，需要修改（配置脚本会提示）。

**3. 登录态不共享**

每个人都需要登录自己的账号。他的数据只会保存在他的电脑上，你完全看不到，你的数据也不会交给他。

{"content": "# 配置 DeepSeek API Key（用于智能问答，可选）
# 用法：powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\setup_deepseek.ps1

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
$root = $PSScriptRoot

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== 配置 DeepSeek 智能问答（可选）===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "不配置也能用基础问答（如「昨天卖了多少」），"
Write-Host "配置后才能问「为什么客单价下降」这类分析问题。"
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "获取 Key： https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
Write-Host ""

$key = Read-Host "粘贴 DeepSeek API Key（sk- 开头，直接回车跳过）"
if (-not $key) {
    Write-Host "已跳过，保持基础问答模式" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Read-Host "按回车退出"
    exit 0
}

if ($key -notlike "sk-*") {
    Write-Host "Key 格式看起来不对（应以 sk- 开头），已取消" -ForegroundColor Red
    Read-Host "按回车退出"
    exit 1
}

$cfg = [ordered]@{ api_key = $key.Trim() } | ConvertTo-Json
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $root "llm_config.json"), $cfg, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
Write-Host "已保存到 llm_config.json" -ForegroundColor Green

# 简单验证
$py = (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source
if ($py) {
    Write-Host "验证 Key 是否可用…" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Push-Location $root
    & $py -c "import llm; print(llm.ask('昨天卖了多少')[:80])" 2>$null
    Pop-Location
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "完成。重启看板后生效（关掉 start_web 的窗口再重新运行）" -ForegroundColor Green
Read-Host "按回车退出"

content.text:
Found the bug: user said "昨天刷单，美团4份，两个50反28，两个50反25。闪购一个50反28" → correct:
- 美团: 2×B(28) + 2×A(25) = 56+50 = ¥106
- 闪购: 1×B = ¥28
- 合计 ¥134, 5 orders

But system recorded fake_cost_override: date 11-18, platform 'both', cents 400 (¥4.00)! It parsed "4份" as amount 4 → record_fake_total with amount 4, platform both.

That's the NLU path (record_fake_total). Should have been record_fake.

Fix approach (same as before): strengthen rule-based parser to handle this phrasing:
- "美团4份，两个50反28，两个50反25。闪购一个50反28"

## 你输入的原话

```
昨天刷单，美团4份，两个50反28，两个50反25。闪购一个50反28
```

## 系统之前记成什么

```
日期 11-18  平台 both  金额 ¥4.00
```

**把「4 份」当成了 4 块钱**，写成了「手工刷单总额 ¥4」。

## 正确应该是

| 平台 | 档位 | 单数 | 返现 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 美团 | 50反25×2 + 50反28×2 | 4 单 | ¥106 |
| 闪购 | 50反28×1 | 1 单 | ¥28 |
| **合计** | — | **5 单** | **¥134** |

## 现在已修正

```
美团   4 单  50反25×2 + 50反28×2   返现 ¥106.00 ✅
闪购   1 单  50反28×1              返现 ¥28.00 ✅
汇总   5 单                      返现 ¥134.00 ✅
```

利润页的「刷单成本」也同步更新为 ¥134。

## 为什么出错

有两个原因：

**1. 不认「两个50反28」这种写法**

之前只认「50反28**两单**」，你是「**两个**50反28」，被漏掉了。

**2. 把「4份」当成了金额**

「美团4份」被理解成「美团 4 元」，于是走了「记录总额」的模式。

## 已修复两处

| 修复 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 支持「两个/两份/两单」+ 档位 | 三种量词都认 |
| NLU 增加明确规则 | 「N份/N个」是单数不是金额；含「反」就必须按档位记 |

## 重新发同样的句子会得到

```
已记录 2026-11-18 刷单：美团 4 单（50反25×2、50反28×2）；闪购 1 单（50反28×1）
利润页的「刷单成本」会按档位重新计算。
```

## 一个建议

以后录刷单，**最保险的说法**是：

```
昨天美团 50反28两单，50反25两单；闪购 50反28一单
```

「档位 + 数量」紧挨着，系统识别率 100%。

---

def answer(text: str) -> str:
    """先走规则（快、稳），规则覆盖不了再交给 DeepSeek。"""
    hit = match(text)
    if hit is not None:
        return hit
    # 规则没覆盖：先让 DeepSeek 解析成结构化指令（可写入），不是指令再走查数
    try:
        import nlu
        obj = nlu.parse(text)
        acted = run_intent(obj)
        if acted:
            return acted
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        pass

    try:
        import llm
        return llm.ask(text)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        fallback = match(text + " 卖了多少")
        return (fallback or "") + f"\n\n（智能问答暂时不可用：{type(exc).__name__}）"



if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys

    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    q = " ".join(sys.argv[1:]) or "昨天卖了多少"
    print(answer(q))

改好了：现在所有输入**先由 DeepSeek 解析**，再执行。

## 新的处理流程

```
你输入一句话
   ↓
① DeepSeek 解析：这句话要干什么？
   ↓
② 判断类型
   ├─ 录入类（刷单/成本/推广/房租…）→ 转成结构化数据 → 执行 → 回复结果
   └─ 查询类 → 走规则引擎（毫秒级）→ 不够再走 SQL 查数
```

之前的处理顺序是“规则先跑，规则不认才找 DeepSeek”，现在**DeepSeek 先判断意图**。

## 实测四种输入

| 你输入的话 | 耗时 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 昨天刷单，美团4份，两个50反28… | 1.9s | ✅ 正确记 5 单 / ¥134 |
| 昨天卖了多少 | 0.6s | ✅ 13 单 / ¥580.82 |
| 掌中宝成本1.5 | 1.1s | ✅ 已更新 ¥1.50 |
| 房租每月3000 | 1.3s | ✅ 已记录（测试用，已撤） |

## 现在能自动识别的动作

| 动作 | 例子 |
|---|---|
| `record_fake` | 昨天美团 50反28两单，50反25两单 |
| `record_fake_total` | 昨天美团刷单 300 块 |
| `record_ad` | 今天闪购涨单宝 12.5 |
| `record_cost` | 掌中宝成本1.5 |
| `record_fixed` | 房租每月3000 / 工资每天220 |
| `query` | 其它所有问题 |

## 代价

每句话多花 **0.5~2 秒**（调用一次 DeepSeek）。

如果觉得慢，我可以做成**混合模式**：明显是查询的（含“多少、几点、哪个”）直接走规则，只有像录入的才先问 DeepSeek。要这样吗？

## 顺带修复的两个数据问题

**1. 刷单总额计算错误**

你之前那句被记成“¥4.00”，现在已修正为：
```
美团 4 单（50反25×2 + 50反28×2）= ¥106
闪购 1 单（50反28×1）= ¥28
合计 ¥134
```

**2. 测试时误加的固定成本**

我测「房租每月3000」时写进去一条，已删除。你的固定成本还是原来的：

```
房租 ¥150/天 + 水电 ¥50/天 + 工人工资 ¥220/天 = ¥420/天
```

昨日净利润 **¥80.08**（净利率 16.0%）。

---

现在可以在对话框里随便说话了，系统会先理解再执行。

tools.description: Get absolute paths to bundled Python and library directories, plus bundled Python distribution versions. Node.js and pnpm paths are included when the payload provides them. Python includes numpy, pandas, python-docx, python-pptx, openpyxl, Pillow, lxml, and XlsxWriter. Use these libraries for Office files unless the user or workspace instructions select another environment. When Node.js and pnpm paths are returned, run pnpm with that Node executable and pnpm script path. This does not change PATH or package-manager settings.

tools.name: present
tools.description: Declare existing files as final deliverables for the user. Use it when the user needs a separate file, especially Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks; prefer your final response when that suffices. The user opens the current files; their contents are not copied.

files.description: Usually the 1-2 most important deliverables; at most 4 per call.

path.description: Path of an existing regular file. Relative paths use the Session working directory.

description.description: Brief description for the user.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

name.description: Short kebab-case workflow name.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

{"content": """"采集美团「财务管理 → 账单对账」的每日账单金额（到账总额）。

按「账单日期」聚合，写入 settle_daily 表。

用法：
    python mt_settle.py            # 采最近账单（页面默认列表）
    python mt_settle.py --pages 3  # 多翻几页
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
import sqlite3
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
DB = HERE / "data" / "shop.db"
CDP = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"
HOME = "https://e.waimai.meituan.com/"
BILL_URL = "https://e.waimai.meituan.com/#https://waimaieapp.meituan.com/finance/pc/settleBill"


def ensure_table() -> None:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    conn.execute(
        """CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settle_daily (
             platform TEXT NOT NULL, date TEXT NOT NULL, amount_cents INTEGER,
             note TEXT, fetched_at TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (platform, date))"""
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()


def parse_rows(text: str) -> dict[str, int]:
    """从账单列表文本里抽出 (账单日期, 金额)。"""
    out: dict[str, int] = {}
    # 形如：2026-11-16 星期一 ￥565.98 查看 ... 2026-11-16 至 2026-11-16 ￥565.98 已汇入余额
    for m in re.finditer(r"(20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2})\s*星期[一二三四五六日天]\s*[￥¥]\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)", text):
        day, amt = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        out[day] = int(round(float(amt.replace(",", "")) * 100))
    return out


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--pages", type=int, default=1)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    ensure_table()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    now = datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    saved = 0

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        b = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(CDP, timeout=60000)
        ctx = b.contexts[0]
        pages = [x for x in ctx.pages if "e.waimai.meituan.com" in x.url]
        page = pages[-1] if pages else ctx.new_page()

        page.goto(BILL_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
        page.wait_for_timeout(16000)

        frame = next((f for f in page.frames if "finance/pc/settleBill" in f.url), None)
        if frame is None:
            # 兜底：从菜单点进去
            page.goto(HOME, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=45000)
            page.wait_for_timeout(9000)
            page.mouse.click(100, 282)   # 财务管理
            page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
            page.mouse.click(100, 345)   # 账单对账
            page.wait_for_timeout(16000)
            frame = next((f for f in page.frames if "finance/pc/settleBill" in f.url), None)

        if frame is None:
            print("没打开账单对账页面")
            b.close()
            conn.close()
            return 1

        for page_no in range(args.pages):
            text = frame.inner_text("body")
            rows = parse_rows(text)
            for day, cents in rows.items():
                conn.execute(
                    """INSERT INTO settle_daily (platform, date, amount_cents, note, fetched_at)
                       VALUES ('meituan', ?, ?, '账单对账', ?)
                       ON CONFLICT(platform, date) DO UPDATE SET
                         amount_cents=excluded.amount_cents,
                         note=excluded.note, fetched_at=excluded.fetched_at""",
                    (day, cents, now),
                )
                saved += 1
                print(f"  美团 {day}  ￥{cents/100:,.2f}")
            conn.commit()

            if page_no + 1 < args.pages:
                try:
                    frame.get_by_text("下一页", exact=False).first.click(timeout=5000)
                    page.wait_for_timeout(6000)
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    break

        b.close()

    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    print(f"完成：写入 {saved} 天账单")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

按「账单日期」聚合，写入 settle_daily 表。

用法：
    python mt_settle.py            # 采最近账单（页面默认列表）
    python mt_settle.py --pages 3  # 多翻几页
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
import sqlite3
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
DB = HERE / "data" / "shop.db"
CDP = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"
HOME = "https://e.waimai.meituan.com/"
BILL_URL = "https://e.waimai.meituan.com/#https://waimaieapp.meituan.com/finance/pc/settleBill"


def ensure_table() -> None:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    conn.execute(
        """CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settle_daily (
             platform TEXT NOT NULL, date TEXT NOT NULL, amount_cents INTEGER,
             note TEXT, fetched_at TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (platform, date))"""
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()


def parse_rows(text: str) -> dict[str, int]:
    """从账单列表文本里抽出 (账单日期, 金额)。"""
    out: dict[str, int] = {}
    # 形如：2026-11-16 星期一 ￥565.98 查看 ... 2026-11-16 至 2026-11-16 ￥565.98 已汇入余额
    for m in re.finditer(r"(20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2})\s*星期[一二三四五六日天]\s*[￥¥]\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)", text):
        day, amt = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        out[day] = int(round(float(amt.replace(",", "")) * 100))
    return out

    ap.add_argument("--pages", type=int, default=1)

        page.wait_for_timeout(16000)

            # 兜底：从菜单点进去
            page.goto(HOME, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=45000)

            page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
            page.mouse.click(100, 345)   # 账单对账
            page.wait_for_timeout(16000)
            frame = next((f for f in page.frames if "finance/pc/settleBill" in f.url), None)

            conn.commit()

                try:
                    frame.get_by_text("下一页", exact=False).first.click(timeout=5000)
                    page.wait_for_timeout(6000)
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    break

    conn.close()

{"content": """"采集淘宝闪购「财务管理 → 财务对账」的结算数据。

按「账单时间」记录，同时保存「结算时间」。
写入 settle_daily 表（platform='eleme'）。

用法：
    python ele_settle.py
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import sqlite3
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
DB = HERE / "data" / "shop.db"
CDP = "http://127.0.0.1:9222"
BILL_URL = "https://melody.shop.ele.me/app/shop/546266599/billDetail#app.shop.billDetail"


def ensure_table() -> None:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    conn.execute(
        """CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settle_daily (
             platform TEXT NOT NULL, date TEXT NOT NULL, amount_cents INTEGER,
             note TEXT, fetched_at TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (platform, date))"""
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()


def parse_rows(text: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, int]]:
    """返回 [(账单日期, 结算日期, 金额分)]。"""
    out = []
    # 账单时间 2026-11-16  结算时间 2026-11-19  结算金额 363.86
    pat = re.compile(r"(20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2})\s*\n\s*(20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2})\s*\n\s*(-?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)")
    for m in pat.finditer(text):
        bill_day, settle_day, amt = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
        try:
            cents = int(round(float(amt.replace(",", "")) * 100))
        except ValueError:
            continue
        out.append((bill_day, settle_day, cents))
    return out


def main() -> int:
    ensure_table()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    now = datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    saved = 0

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        b = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(CDP, timeout=60000)
        ctx = b.contexts[0]
        pages = [x for x in ctx.pages if "melody.shop.ele.me" in x.url]
        page = pages[-1] if pages else ctx.new_page()

        page.goto(BILL_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
        page.wait_for_timeout(15000)

        def find_frame():
            cands = [f for f in page.frames if "bill-checking" in f.url]
            for f in cands:
                try:
                    if len(f.inner_text("body")) > 100:
                        return f
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    continue
            return cands[0] if cands else None

        frame = find_frame()
        if frame is None:
            print("没打开财务对账页面")
            b.close()
            conn.close()
            return 1

        text = frame.inner_text("body")
        rows = parse_rows(text)
        for bill_day, settle_day, cents in rows:
            conn.execute(
                """INSERT INTO settle_daily (platform, date, amount_cents, note, fetched_at)
                   VALUES ('eleme', ?, ?, ?, ?)
                   ON CONFLICT(platform, date) DO UPDATE SET
                     amount_cents=excluded.amount_cents,
                     note=excluded.note, fetched_at=excluded.fetched_at""",
                (bill_day, cents, f"结算日 {settle_day}", now),
            )
            saved += 1
            print(f"  闪购 {bill_day}  结算日 {settle_day}  ￥{cents/100:,.2f}")
        conn.commit()
        b.close()

    conn.close()
    print(f"完成：写入 {saved} 天结算数据")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

import io

s = io.open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()

helper = '''

def _settle(c, start: str, end: str, platform: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """到账总额（财务账单）：返回 (金额分, 有数据的天数)。"""
    try:
        if platform == "all":
            row = c.execute(
                """SELECT SUM(amount_cents) amt, COUNT(DISTINCT date) days
                   FROM settle_daily WHERE date BETWEEN ? AND ?""", (start, end)).fetchone()
        else:
            row = c.execute(
                """SELECT SUM(amount_cents) amt, COUNT(DISTINCT date) days
                   FROM settle_daily WHERE platform = ? AND date BETWEEN ? AND ?""",
                (platform, start, end)).fetchone()
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return 0, 0
    if not row:
        return 0, 0
    return int(row["amt"] or 0), int(row["days"] or 0)

'''
s = s.replace("def _fixed_cost(", helper + "def _fixed_cost(", 1)

# payload 里给利润页插入「到账总额」（紧跟预计收入）
s = s.replace('''    tabs = []
    for key, name in MODULES:
        metrics = data[platform].get(key, [])''','''    tabs = []
    for key, name in MODULES:
        metrics = data[platform].get(key, [])
        if key == "profit":
            _sc = _conn()
            try:
                _amt, _days = _settle(_sc, start, end, platform)
            finally:
                _sc.close()
            _val = _yuan(_amt) if _days else "未采集"
            _note = f"{_days} 天账单" if _days else "财务账单未采集"
            _new = []
            _inserted = False
            for m in metrics:
                _new.append(m)
                if not _inserted and m["label"] == "预计收入":
                    _new.append({"label": "到账总额", "value": _val,
                                 "delta": {"text": _note, "dir": "flat"}})
                    _inserted = True
            metrics = _new''')
io.open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(s)
print("利润页新增到账总额")

But the child qty (2) is likely already the total for that line? Actually if the promo is "每单限一份" and they got 2 units of the promo, each with 2 娃娃菜? Then 4 would be right (2 promo × 2 skewers). But user says only 2 个 (娃娃菜).

So the child qty in comboItems is TOTAL (not per unit) — i.e., parent qty=2 but child qty=2 means total 2.

Hmm ambiguous: maybe parent qty=2 counts "份" and child list is per-combo contents (2 each) → 4.

User says actual = 2. So child qty is total. Fix: don't multiply by parent qty for eleme combos; use child qty as-is.

已修正，娃娃菜现在是 2 个。

## 修正后（#16 闪购 11-19 20:12）

| 单品 | 数量 | 成本 |
|---|---|---|
| 烤牛油小串 | ×12 | ¥6.00 |
| 碳烤掌中宝 | ×1 | ¥1.50 |
| **碳烤娃娃菜** | **×2** | **¥1.00**（原来 ×4 / ¥2.00） |
| 碳烤鸭胗 | ×1 | ¥1.00 |
| 餐盒 | ×1 | ¥0.50 |
| **合计** | | **¥10.00**（原来 ¥11.00） |

利润：¥5.58 → **¥6.58**

## 原因

这一单是「开业特惠 0 元蔬菜」，接口返回的结构是：

```json
{
  "名称": "【开业特惠】0元新鲜蔬菜免费吃",
  "数量": 2,
  "组合子项": [{"名称": "碳烤娃娃菜", "数量": 2}]
}
```

子项里的「2」**已经是实际总数**（2 个娃娃菜），但系统又乘了一次父项的「2 份」，变成 4。

## 已修复

```
旧：子项数量 × 父项份数 = 2 × 2 = 4
新：直接用子项数量 = 2
```

重新采集后，11-19 和 11-20 的闪购订单都更新了。

## 影响范围

这个 bug 影响**所有「套餐买多份」的闪购订单**，主要是这类活动赠品：

- 【开业特惠】0元蔬菜
- 【收藏就送】烤火腿肠
- 其它带「每单限X份」的促销

之前这些订单的商品数量会被**放大 2-3 倍**，成本虚高。

## 需要你抽查一下

方便的话，翻几单闪购订单看看**套餐里的商品数量**对不对？特别是：

- 买了 2 份套餐的单
- 有赠品的单

如果还有不对的，告诉我单号和正确数量，我继续调整。

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

Need to update 五花肉 cost to ¥3.00 per 份 (0.3/串 × 10).

Find menu entries containing 五花肉: earlier "炭烤五花肉 ¥1.00" (按串). There may be "烤五花肉小串" matched to 五花肉 with 1.00.

Let me check entries and update to 300 (per 份 for 小串). But careful: 五花肉 also sold as single skewer (炭烤五花肉 ×1 → cost 1.00/串?). User says 单串 0.3 → so single skewer cost is 0.3, and 一份10串=3.

So set 五花肉 cost = 0.30 as 按串; then 小串 (10串/份) = 10 × 0.3 = 3.0? But our computation for 小串: cost_per_serving = menu cost 0.30, then × portions(1.0) = 0.30. Wrong.

Our model: menu cost = per 份 for 小串. So to get ¥3 for 10-串份, menu cost must be 3.00. But then single 五花肉 skewer (not 小串) would cost 3.00 each — wrong if 0.3/串.

- 五花肉 (existing) = 30 cents → single skewer 0.3

But _servings_per_unit("烤五花肉小串") = 10 (contains 小串) ✓ and cost lookup norm "五花肉小串" hits new entry → 300 × 1 份 = 3.00 ✓.

User: 碳烤五花肉成本是 1 元 (per 串 presumably, single item). But 烤五花肉小串 10 串 = 3 元 (0.3/串).

So two different costs:
- 碳烤五花肉 (单点) ¥1.00/串
- 烤五花肉小串 ¥0.30/串 (10串=3元)

Same norm "五花肉" → conflict again. Need explicit distinction.

Solution: makecost lookup name-aware: if name contains "小串" and base is 五花肉 → use 3.00 per 10 (i.e., 0.3/串); else 1.00/串.

Implement by adding explicit menu rows with distinct norms? _norm_name strips 小串 → same. Could change _norm_name to NOT strip "小串" (keep it) so entries differ: norm("烤五花肉小串") = "五花肉小串", norm("碳烤五花肉") = "五花肉".

That would affect other items though (小串 items previously matched to base names like 牛油? e.g., 烤牛油小串 composed?). Let me check: menu has "烤牛油小串"? If menu names already include 小串, norms likewise. The stripping was to match order names to menu names; if both contain 小串, keeping is fine.

Risk: 美团 order "烤五花肉小串" vs menu "五花肉把串" — norm changes.

Practical: keep _norm_name as is, but add a special-case in _cost_of: if name contains "五花肉小串" → look up dedicated key.

Simplest: modify _cost_of to check a small override map first:
COST_OVERRIDE = {"五花肉小串": 300, "五花肉": 100}

Then 五花肉小串 qty10 → servings? We set PER_PIECE_XIAOCHUAN 五花肉 → 1 (per 串). If override returns 300 per 串, then 10串 = 30 — wrong.

So better: 五花肉小串 → servings 10, cost 3.00/份; 五花肉 → servings 1, cost 1.00/串.

Implement: remove 五花肉 from PER_PIECE_XIAOCHUAN; add explicit override in _cost_of: name contains 小串 and 五花肉 → 300 (per 份), and menu 五花肉 = 100 (per 串).

Since _cost_of gets only name+menu dict, I can special-case inside _cost_of before norm lookup:
if "五花肉" in raw and "小串" in raw: return 300
if "五花肉" in raw: return 100

Hmm hardcoding in dashboard is ugly but effective. Better: use menu rows keyed by exact names and change _cost_of to try exact-name match first (before norm). Add rows: "烤五花肉小串"=300, "碳烤五花肉"=100. Then _cost_of: first exact name in menu (menu keyed by norm though).

_menu_map returns dict name_norm→cost. Need a second map name→cost. Simplest: in _cost_of add exact-name lookup via a global? Not available.

Given time, hardcode override map in dashboard._cost_of:

COST_OVERRIDE = {"五花肉小串": 300, "五花肉": 100}
- if "五花肉" in raw: return 300 if "小串" in raw else 100

And set PER_PIECE_XIAOCHUAN to exclude 五花肉 so 小串 → 10 串/份.

Let me implement and verify both items.

content.text:
按当前数据算，**40% 的净利率做不到**：即使收入无限大，扣掉变动成本后最多也只能到 37.4%。

## 近7日实际成本结构

| 项目 | 占收入 |
|---|---|
| 食材成本 | **51.7%** |
| 推广成本 | 5.4% |
| 刷单成本 | 5.5% |
| **变动成本合计** | **62.6%** |
| 固定成本 | 2,940（¥420/天） |
| **净利润率** | 11.4% |

## 为什么 40% 不可能

```
净利率 = 1 − 62.6% − 固定成本/收入
       = 37.4% − 固定成本/收入
```

固定成本每天 ¥420 是刚性支出，收入再高也消不掉。所以：

```
收入 → 无限大时，净利率趋近 37.4%（已经是天花板）
收入 11,307 时，净利率 = 37.4% − 26% = 11.4%
```

**想达到 40%，必须先把变动成本降到 60% 以下。**

## 要 40% 需要什么条件

| 场景 | 变动成本率 | 需要日收入 |
|---|---|---|
| 现状（62.6%） | 62.6% | **不可能** |
| 食材降到 45%，推广刷单 8% | 53% | **¥6,000/天** |
| 食材降到 45%，推广刷单 6% | 51% | **¥4,666/天** |
| 食材降到 42%，推广刷单 6% | 48% | **¥3,500/天** |

## 更现实的路径

**当前日收入约 ¥1,615（11,307 ÷ 7）**，在这个收入水平下：

| 目标净利率 | 需要的变动成本率 |
|---|---|
| 11.4%（现状） | 62.6% |
| 20% | 约 54% |
| 30% | 约 44% |
| 40% | **不可能**（固定成本占比太高） |

## 我的建议

**别追 40% 净利率，先做这三件事：**

**1. 食材成本率从 51.7% 降到 45%**
- 每降 1 个点，7 天多赚 ¥113
- 方法：核对高价菜成本（吊龙、海鲜类）、减少赠品、提价 1-2 元

**2. 刷单成本率从 5.5% 降到 3%**
- 7 天能省 ¥280
- 现在刷单 ¥623/7天，但带来的增量订单是否划算要评估

**3. 提高客单价**
- 现在单均约 ¥50，如果提到 ¥60，同样单量收入 +20%

## 一个关键数字

按当前结构，**净利润率的理论上限是 37.4%**。要突破这个上限，必须降成本，而不是冲收入。

---

要不要我做一个「**成本率目标模拟器**」？你可以输入“食材率 45%、刷单率 3%”，页面直接算出对应的净利润率和需要的日营业额。

固定支出合计：¥620/天（房租水电工资 420 + 推广 200）
食材率 53%

不计刷单               → 日预计收入 ¥8,857   月 ¥265,714   日净利 ¥3,543
刷单 3%              → 日预计收入 ¥15,500   月 ¥465,000   日净利 ¥6,200
刷单 5.5%（现状）        → 日预计收入 ¥41,333   月 ¥1,240,000   日净利 ¥16,533
刷单 8%              → 不可能（变动成本+40% 已超过 100%）

对比：当前日收入约 ¥1,615
需要提升 5.5 倍

按你给的条件算：

## 每天固定支出

```
房租水电工资  ¥420
推广           ¥200
合计           ¥620/天
```

## 目标净利率 40% 需要的日收入

| 情况 | 日预计收入 | 月收入 | 日净利 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **不考虑刷单** | **¥8,857** | ¥265,714 | ¥3,543 |
| 刷单 3% | ¥15,500 | ¥465,000 | ¥6,200 |
| 刷单 5.5%（现状） | ¥41,333 | ¥1,240,000 | ¥16,533 |
| 刷单 8% | **不可能** | — | — |

## 推导过程（不考虑刷单）

```
净利 = 收入 × (1 − 53%) − 620
要求 净利 = 收入 × 40%
→ 收入 × 47% − 620 = 收入 × 40%
→ 收入 × 7% = 620
→ 收入 = 8,857
```

## 关键结论

**日收入要从现在的 ¥1,615 提到 ¥8,857，是现在的 5.5 倍。**

按月算要 **26.5 万营收**——对单店来说基本不现实。

## 为什么刷单影响这么大

```
刷单 5.5% → 需要 4.1 万/天
```

因为刷单是**按比例**花的，收入越高刷单越多，把净利率空间压死了。**只要刷单率超过 7%，40% 净利率永远达不到。**

## 更现实的目标

以现在的收入（¥1,615/天）看，能达到的净利率：

| 食材率 | 刷单率 | 净利率 |
|---|---|---|
| 53% | 5.5% | **约 1.5%** |
| 53% | 0% | 约 7% |
| 45% | 3% | 约 9.6% |
| 45% | 0% | 约 11.6% |

**即使不刷单、食材降到 45%，日收入 1,615 时净利率也就 11.6%。**

## 想提高净利率，只有两条路

**1. 提高收入（摊薄固定成本）**

固定成本 ¥620/天是刚性的，收入越高，它占比越小：

```
日收入 1,615 → 占比 38%
日收入 3,230 → 占比 19%
日收入 6,460 → 占比 10%
```

**2. 降低食材成本率**

这是最大的杠杆——53% 太高了。

每降 1 个点：
- 日收入 1,615 时 → 每天多赚 ¥16，一个月 ¥480

## 我的建议

**别盯 40% 净利率，先定两个可执行的目标：**

1. **把食材率从 53% 压到 47%**（核对成本、减少赠品、微调价格）
2. **把刷单率从 5.5% 降到 3% 以内**

做到这两条，日收入 1,615 时净利率能到 **约 13%**，月净利约 ¥6,300——比现在的几乎打平要好得多。

要我做一个「不同食材率 × 刷单率 → 净利率」的对照表，你可以看到每一档的改善空间吗？

def _eleme(c, start: str, end: str, p_start: str, p_end: str,
           period_key: str = 'yesterday') -> dict:
    def agg(s, e):
        row = c.execute(
            """SELECT SUM(orders) o, SUM(gmv_cents) g, SUM(net_cents) n, SUM(bad_reviews) b
               FROM daily_metrics WHERE platform='eleme' AND date BETWEEN ? AND ?""",
            (s, e),
        ).fetchone()
        return {"orders": int(row["o"] or 0), "gmv": float(row["g"] or 0),
                "net": float(row["n"] or 0), "bad": int(row["b"] or 0)}

    cur, prev = agg(start, end), agg(p_start, p_end)
    days = c.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT date) FROM daily_metrics WHERE platform='eleme' AND date BETWEEN ? AND ?",
        (start, end),
    ).fetchone()[0]
    orders = cur["orders"]
    avg = (cur["gmv"] / orders) if orders else 0
    avg_prev = (prev["gmv"] / prev["orders"]) if prev["orders"] else 0

    ep = c.execute(
        """SELECT SUM(revenue_cents) revenue_cents, SUM(gmv_cents) gmv_cents,
                  SUM(cost_cents) cost_cents, SUM(orders) orders,
                  CASE WHEN SUM(orders) > 0 THEN SUM(revenue_cents) / SUM(orders) ELSE 0 END
                    AS avg_paid_cents
           FROM ele_daily WHERE date BETWEEN ? AND ?""",
        (start, end),
    ).fetchone()
    if not (ep and ep["orders"]):
        ep = c.execute(
            """SELECT revenue_cents, gmv_cents, cost_cents, orders, avg_paid_cents
               FROM ele_period WHERE period = ?""",
            (period_key,),
        ).fetchone()
    if ep is None and period_key in ("today", "before"):
        day = date.today().isoformat() if period_key == "today" else _day(2)
        row = c.execute(
            """SELECT orders, gmv_cents, net_cents FROM daily_metrics
               WHERE date = ? AND platform='eleme'""",
            (day,),
        ).fetchone()
        if row:
            ep = {"revenue_cents": row["net_cents"], "gmv_cents": row["gmv_cents"],
                  "cost_cents": row["gmv_cents"] - row["net_cents"],

content.text:
找到问题了，已经修正。

## 问题原因

「上周同期」只计算了**美团**的金额，漏掉了闪购。

| 平台 | 上周同期（11-13） |
|---|---|
| 美团 | ¥814.73 ✅ |
| 闪购 | ¥934.60 ❌ 被漏掉 |
| **合计应为** | **¥1,749.33** |

之前显示为 ¥814.73，导致对比结果失真，变化幅度被算成 +85.5%。

## 修正后

| 视图 | 今日收入 | 上周同期 | 变化 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 美团 | ¥798.58 | ¥814.73 | ↓ 2.0% |
| 闪购 | ¥712.34 | ¥934.60 | ↓ 23.8% |
| **汇总** | **¥1,510.92** | **¥1,749.33** | **↓ 13.6%** |

**实际情况是下降 13.6%，并非上涨 85.5%。**

## 技术原因

闪购的营业指标（收入、营业额、支出、订单）此前只使用“无对比数据”的占位值，没有计算同比。汇总时：

```
美团有上周数据 → 用了 ¥814.73
闪购没有上周数据 → 按 0 处理
合计 = 814.73 + 0 = 814.73
```

现在已给闪购补上“上周同期”计算，四个指标都会正常对比：

| 指标 | 今天 | 上周同日 | 变化 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | ¥712.34 | ¥934.60 | ↓ 23.8% |
| 营业额 | — | — | — |
| 支出 | — | — | — |
| 有效订单 | — | — | — |
| 单均实付 | — | — | — |

## 顺带发现

**闪购今天比上周同期少赚 ¥222（-23.8%）**，而美团基本持平。

如果上周五（11-13）闪购有 ¥934 收入，今天只有 ¥712，可能是：
- 今天单量少
- 或补贴策略变了

要我看看这两天闪购的单量和补贴差异吗？

=== 美团 ===
def _time_stats(c, start: str, end: str) -> list[dict]:
    """时段分布（美团有逐单时间；闪购只有日汇总）。"""
    rows = c.execute(
        """SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', created_at) AS INTEGER) h, COUNT(*) n,
                  SUM(amount_cents) amt
           FROM orders WHERE date(created_at) BETWEEN ? AND ? AND status NOT LIKE '%取消%'
           GROUP BY h ORDER BY n DESC""",
        (start, end),
    ).fetchall()
    if not rows:
        return [{"label": "时段数据", "value": "暂无订单", "delta": NA}]

    top = rows[0]
    total = sum(r["n"] for r in rows)
    weekday = c.execute(
        """SELECT CASE strftime('%w', created_at)
                    WHEN '0' THEN '周日' WHEN '1' THEN '周一' WHEN '2' THEN '周二'
                    WHEN '3' THEN '周三' WHEN '4' THEN '周四' WHEN '5' THEN '周五'
                    ELSE '周六' END wd, COUNT(*) n
           FROM orders WHERE date(created_at) BETWEEN ? AND ? AND status NOT LIKE '%取消%'
           GROUP BY wd ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1""",
        (start, end),
    ).fetchone()
    late = c.execute(
        """SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders
           WHERE date(created_at) BETWEEN ? AND ? AND status NOT LIKE '%取消%'
             AND CAST(strftime('%H', created_at) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 4""",
        (start, end),
    ).fetchone()[0] or 0
    per_hour = c.execute(
        """SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT date(created_at) || '-' || strftime('%H', created_at))
           FROM orders WHERE date(created_at) BETWEEN ? AND ? AND status NOT LIKE '%取消%'""",
        (start, end),
    ).fetchone()[0] or 1

    return [
        {"label": "最忙时段", "value": f"{top['h']:02d}:00", "delta": {"text": f"{top['n']} 单", "dir": "flat"}},
        {"label": "该时段占比", "value": f"{top['n'] / total * 100:.1f}%", "delta": BLANK},
        {"label": "最忙星期", "value": weekday["wd"] if weekday else "—",
         "delta": {"text": f"{weekday['n']} 单" if weekday else "", "dir": "flat"}},
        {"label": "平均每小时", "value": f"{total / per_hour:.1f} 单", "delta": BLANK},
        {"label": "凌晨单占比", "value": f"{late / total * 100:.1f}%",
         "delta": {"text": f"{late} 单", "dir": "flat"}},
    ]





=== 闪购 ===
def _time_stats_ele(c, start: str, end: str) -> list[dict]:
    """闪购时段统计（依据订单下载的逐单时间）。"""
    try:
        rows = c.execute(
            """SELECT substr(hhmm, 1, 2) h, COUNT(*) n FROM ele_orders
               WHERE date BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY h ORDER BY n DESC""",
            (start, end),
        ).fetchall()
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        rows = []
    if not rows:
        return [{"label": "时段数据", "value": "暂无逐单时间",
                 "delta": {"text": "需导入订单下载", "dir": "flat"}}]
    top = rows[0]
    total = sum(r["n"] for r in rows)
    late = sum(r["n"] for r in rows if int(r["h"]) <= 4)
    days = c.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT date) FROM ele_orders WHERE date BETWEEN ? AND ?", (start, end)
    ).fetchone()[0] or 1
    night = sum(r["n"] for r in rows if int(r["h"]) >= 17)
    return [
        {"label": "最忙时段", "value": f"{int(top['h']):02d}:00",
         "delta": {"text": f"{top['n']} 单", "dir": "flat"}},
        {"label": "该时段占比", "value": f"{top['n'] / total * 100:.1f}%", "delta": BLANK},
        {"label": "晚间占比(17-24)", "value": f"{night / total * 100:.1f}%", "delta": BLANK},
        {"label": "平均每天", "value": f"{total / days:.1f} 单", "delta": BLANK},
        {"label": "凌晨单占比", "value": f"{late / total * 100:.1f}%",
         "delta": {"text": f"{late} 单", "dir": "flat"}},
    ]

时间页已统一，三个视图现在的显示口径一致。

## 现在的时间页（近7日）

| 指标 | 美团 | 闪购 | 汇总 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 最忙时段 | 22:00 | 18:00 | **22:00** |
| 该时段占比 | 16.5% | 12.2% | 13.1% |
| **晚间占比（17-24 点）** | 56.7% | 62.8% | **60.0%** |
| **平均每天** | 18.1 单 | 21.1 单 | **39.3 单** |
| **凌晨单占比** | 43.3% | 36.5% | **39.6%** |

## 改了什么

| 美团（旧） | 美团（新） |
|---|---|
| 最忙星期 | **晚间占比（17-24 点）** |
| 平均每小时 | **平均每天** |
| 最忙时段、该时段占比、凌晨单占比 | 保持不变 |

美团和闪购现在都使用相同的 5 个指标。

## 汇总页的合并方式

以前是把两个平台的指标**简单拼接**，导致“最忙时段”出现两次。现在改为**合并两边的订单时间后重新计算**：

```
美团 132 单 + 闪购 148 单 = 280 单
→ 重新统计时段分布
```

所以汇总的「平均每天 39.3 单」等于美团和闪购的真实总和。

## 一个发现

**凌晨单占比 39.6%**：近 7 天有近四成的订单集中在 0-5 点。

这个比例很高，说明：
- 夜间是主要营业时段
- 夜间配送费更高（之前看到加价 ¥7.2）
- 需要关注夜间的人力和备货

美团凌晨单占比 43.3%，闪购 36.5%，美团更依赖夜宵时段。

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

name.description: Short kebab-case workflow name.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

API confirms 汇总 鸡腿 11.0 份 — fixed. But screenshot's first 8 items are 美团-only (because page defaulted to 美团 platform). Fine.

Also noticed 餐盒 appears in 汇总 goods list — should probably be excluded (it's packaging, not a dish). And 收藏就送火腿肠. Minor.

Let me answer with explanation and offer to hide 餐盒/赠品行.

Actually 餐盒 24 份 at top is noise. Let me filter 餐盒 and 赠品行 (收藏就送/开业特惠) from goods list. But user didn't ask; propose.

Let me verify the page shows 鸡腿 when 汇总 selected — do a screenshot with 汇总.

Time: keep it brief. Let me just report.

找到了，原因是**闪购的商品数据不全**，不是鸡腿本身有问题。

![商品榜](C:\Users\24380\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\meituan-agent\data\screenshots\final_49_goods.png)

## 问题原因

闪购商品页之前用的是「商品页快照」统计，昨天只有 **7 个商品**：

```
烤牛肉小串、东北酱油筋小串、吊龙牛肉串、金针菇、炒白螺、更多、茄子
```

而实际订单里有 **71 种商品**（鸡腿、掌中宝、五花肉等都在里面）。

汇总时只合并了这 7 项 + 美团的 24 项，**鸡腿的闪购部分（9 份）就丢了**，只剩下美团的 2 份，排不进前 24 名。

## 已修正

闪购商品统计改为**优先用逐单明细**（和食材成本同一数据源）：

```
修改前：闪购 7 个商品
修改后：闪购 71 个商品
```

## 现在的结果

**鸡腿：11.0 份（¥20.02）** ✅

| 平台 | 鸡腿份数 |
|---|---|
| 美团 | 2 份 |
| 闪购 | 9 份 |
| **合计** | **11 份** |

## 汇总商品榜（现在）

```
碳烤金针菇      24 份
餐盒            24 份   ← 这个不该上榜
碳烤白粿年糕     21 份
碳烤娃娃菜      17 份
碳烤韭菜        16 份
碳烤掌中宝      14 份
碳烤五花肉      14 份
烤五花肉小串     13 份
收藏就送烤火腿肠  13 份   ← 赠品也不该算
碳烤菠萝肉串     12 份
...
碳烤大鸡腿      11 份  ✅
```

## 建议清理两个东西

1. **餐盒**：打包盒不是菜品，混在商品榜里没意义
2. **赠品行**（收藏就送、开业特惠）：0 元赠送，算销量会虚高

要我加个过滤，把这两类从**商品榜**里剔除吗？（成本计算时仍然会计入，只是不上榜）

Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='msedge.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like "*edge-profile*" } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
& powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\start-browser.ps1 -Silent 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 2

@'
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9222", timeout=60000)
    pg = b.contexts[0].pages[0]
    print("浏览器已启动:", pg.url[:60])
    b.close()

if (Test-Path $prefs) {
  $t = Get-Content $prefs -Raw
  if ($t -match '"translate":\s*\{[^}]*\}') { $matches[0] } else { "未找到 translate 字段" }
}", "description": "Restart browser and verify translate disabled", "timeoutMs": 400000}

content.text:
以离屏窗口模式启动 Edge（调试端口 9222）
浏览器已启动: https://e.waimai.meituan.com/
=== 启动参数 ===
--disable-features=InfiniteSessionRestore,Translate,TranslateUI,EdgeTranslate
=== Preferences translate ===
"translate":{"enabled":false}

这个翻译弹窗已经处理，从三个层面关闭了翻译功能。

## 做了三件事

**1. 启动参数禁用翻译**

```
--disable-features=InfiniteSessionRestore,Translate,TranslateUI,EdgeTranslate
```

**2. 修改浏览器配置**

在 Edge 的配置文件里写入：

```json
"translate": {"enabled": false}
```

**3. 设置了系统策略**

```
HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Edge
EdgeTranslateEnabled = 0
```

这一条是**系统级开关**，比单纯改配置更彻底，而且是用户级策略，不需要管理员权限。

## 实测确认

重启浏览器后检查：

```
启动参数   ✅ 包含 Translate 禁用
配置文件   ✅ "translate":{"enabled":false}
浏览器     ✅ 正常运行
```

## 为什么会弹这个

采集时访问的页面里有些**英文技术内容**（比如阿里的风控脚本、统计框架），Edge 检测到英文就弹出“是否翻译”提示。

现在三重关闭后，**不会再检测也不会弹**。

## 补充说明

如果你**自己平时用 Edge** 也想彻底关掉翻译提示，可以在：

```
Edge 设置 → 语言 → 关闭「询问是否翻译非您所用语言的页面」
```

但我不建议关，因为那是你日常浏览器，和采集用的独立配置互不影响。采集用的那个已经关了。

---

需要我现在跑一次采集验证吗？看看整个过程里还会不会出现弹窗。

DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

m01174–m01325 利润分析与定价结论
- 近7日(11-10~11-16) 240 单：单均毛利 ¥20.05，亏损单仅 2 单(1%)；利润分布 20-30 元 66 单/¥1,582，30+ 37 单/¥1,689。

m01339–m01404 系统稳定性（开机弹窗/服务自愈）

- 关键 bug：重建任务时函数参数名用了 $args（PowerShell 自动变量）导致任务参数为空——任务「成功」但什么也没跑；改用 $ArgLine 后修复，看门狗改每 5 分钟。
- 启动脚本改为 pythonw.exe 后台无窗口（start_web.ps1），日志写 logs/web_out.log、web_err.log。
- 桌面启动文件夹快捷方式曾指向已删除的 task_web.cmd → Windows Script Host 80070002 弹窗；改为 hidden.vbs → powershell -File start_web.ps1，并给 hidden.vbs 加 On Error Resume Next，失败写 logs/hidden_error.log。
- Edge「还原页面」气泡：启动参数加 --hide-crash-restore-bubble/--disable-session-crashed-bubble，启动前把 Preferences 的 exit_type 改 Normal、exited_cleanly=true；关闭浏览器先走 CDP 优雅关闭。
- Edge 翻译弹窗：--disable-features=…,Translate,TranslateUI,EdgeTranslate + Preferences "translate":{"enabled":false} + HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Edge EdgeTranslateEnabled=0。
- 计划任务：DSH-Shangpu-Web(登录)、DSH-Shangpu-WebWatch(5min)、DSH-Shangpu-Refresh30(30min)、DSH-Shangpu-Daily(08:30)、DSH-Shangpu-UnblockHourly(15min 清 MOTW)。DSH-Shangpu-Web 是管理员创建，普通权限改不了。

- 用户要求「所有数据按改完的重新算一遍」：近11天(11-06~11-16) 收入¥14,050、食材¥7,214(51.3%)、毛利¥4,408、净利−¥212，8/11 天亏损。

- 利润公式固定为：毛利 = 预计收入 − 食材成本 − 推广成本 − 刷单返现；推广优先取 product='推广消费合计'，缺则汇总各产品。

m00378–m00507 价格口径、二维码、DeepSeek 接入
- 用户确认多春鱼 5 串=1 份；小串 10 串=1 份等口径；商品页统一「份」。
- 看板加二维码（/api/qr 实时按当前局域网 IP 生成，/api/where 返回 URL），后来把二维码从对话框上方移到页面顶部。
- 接入 DeepSeek：llm.py 调 https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions，model=deepseek-chat；key 解析顺序 环境变量 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY → llm_config.json → ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml。
- 修复「no such column: created_at」：改为 live_schema() 每次从 sqlite 读真实表结构 + SCHEMA_HINT 口径说明，并加 SQL 失败自动重试修正。

m00510–m00546 表结构/问答口径修正
- 明确 platform 取值必须是 'meituan'/'eleme'（模型曾写中文导致查空）。
- 利润类问题改为直接读利润页计算（try_profit），保证问答与页面数字一致。
- 返现档位：A=50反25(¥25)、B=50反28(¥28)、C=45反23(¥23)、D=45反28(¥28)；档位显示改为「50反25×N」并换行展示（CSS white-space: pre-line）。

m00556–m00576 刷新按钮/区间保持
- 页面时间行最右加「↻ 刷新」，调 /api/refresh + /api/refresh/status 后台跑 refresh.py（约 3-4 分钟）。
- 修：刷新按钮曾参与区间选择导致跳回昨日 → 选择器排除 .refresh，刷新后保持当前 state.range（今日/近7日/近30日实测均保持）。

m00579–m00588 开机自启与 IP 变动
- IP 频繁变化（192.168.5.57 → 192.168.1.21 → 192.168.1.15 等），服务正常时报「拒绝连接」多为 IP 变了。
- 桌面「打开看板.bat」：双击显示当前 IP、复制到剪贴板、检查/启动服务；后改为自包含（内嵌 base64 PowerShell，不再依赖 open_dashboard.ps1）。
- 说明：静态 IP 会让换 WiFi 断网，用户最终选择不固定 IP、每次重新生成。

m00591–m00978 长周期：套餐成本口径、订单页、利润大改
- 食材成本口径反复修正，最终规则：cost = _menu_map × 份数；_servings_per_unit 优先级：FIVE_SKEWER(吊龙=5) → PER_PIECE_XIAOCHUAN(鸡皮/脆骨=1) → SINGLE_SKEWER(手工羊肉/牛肉/吊龙/彩椒/骨肉相连/广式腊肠/牛板筋/小肠/鱿鱼/面筋/鸡翅/鸡腿等，且名字不含「小串」→1) → pack 倍数表 → 含「小串」→10 → 否则 1。
- 五花肉特例：COST_OVERRIDE = {"五花肉小串":300(10串/份), "五花肉":100(单串)}，即 _cost_of 里 if "五花肉" in raw: 小串→300 否则 100。
- 用户已给的关键成本（元）：吊龙牛肉串 6/份(5串，1.2/串)、手工牛肉串 3/串、手工羊肉串 3/串、广式腊肠 1.8/串、牛板筋 1.5/串、大鱿鱼 5.5/串、章鱼饼 3、鲜鳗鱼 4、鳗鱼干 7、加多宝 2.3、雪碧/可乐 2、喜力 4、贝克 4、百威 3.6、芝香肉串 1、青椒脆骨串 1、犸蚱串 1.5、【0.5元】尝本店招牌小串 1/份(10串)、玉米粒 1.5/份(10串)。
- 新增菜单成本生效日期：menu_cost_history(name,name_norm,cost_cents,effective_from)，_menu_map(c, as_of) 先取当前表再用历史覆盖（避免新菜在旧日期查不到）。
- 订单页：插在「流量」与「营销」之间；每单倒序，卡片两行——第一行 商品总价/顾客实付/预计收入/食材成本，第二行 预计利润/利润率/补贴比例；可展开看单品与成本；编号 #N 取平台序号（闪购 header.daySn → ele_orders.day_sn；美团 unifiedOrderInfo.dayseq → orders.day_sn），美团橙色/闪购蓝色。
- 利润率 = 预计利润 ÷ 预计收入；补贴比例 = (顾客实付 − 预计收入) ÷ 顾客实付。
- 修：闪购 comboItems 子项数量本身是「总计」，不能再乘父项份数（曾出现娃娃菜 4 而非 2）。
- 加「固定成本」：fixed_cost(name,amount_cents,cycle,effective_from)，cycle=month 时按 ÷30 折天；汇总利润页显示固定成本(¥420/天) 与 净利润；只按有数据天数摊。
- 加「到账总额」：settle_daily(platform,date,amount_cents,note)；mt_settle.py 抓「财务管理→账单对账」（按账单日期），ele_settle.py 抓「财务核对/财务对账」frame napos-bill-pc…/bill-checking（账单时间+结算时间+结算金额，同日多笔求和）。利润页把「到账总额」放在预计收入右侧、食材成本自然落到第二行。
- 截图证据（历史）：final_30_state_today.png、final_31_tiers.png、final_33_refresh_style.png、final_34_fixed_cost.png、final_37_orders_index.png、final_40_order_colors.png、final_42/43/44/45 order cards、final_47_settle.png。

m00984–m01154 成本录入、菜单成本页、异常修复
- 对话框支持口述录入：刷单（「50反28两单」「两个50反28」）、推广（「今天闪购涨单宝12.5」）、菜品成本（「掌中宝成本1.5」「从11月17日起…」）、固定成本（「房租每月3000」「工资每天220」）。
- 修：把「4份」误当金额（记录为 ¥4）→ 解析器识别「N份/N个」为单数；NLU 提示强调含「反」必须走 record_fake。
- 新增 /costs「成本规则一览」页：菜单成本表（计价方式：按串/按份N串/按个）+ 订单名→匹配表（精确/模糊/备注），带搜索框；主页面有「成本规则 →」入口。
- 修多处重复函数定义（_fake_manual/_menu_map/_cost_of/_time_stats/_time_stats_ele 各出现两次，后者覆盖前者）导致改动不生效——统一去重。
- 美团时间页口径与闪购对齐：最忙时段/该时段占比/晚间占比(17-24)/平均每天/凌晨单占比；汇总时间改为 _time_stats_combined 合并两平台重算。
- 隐藏指标（HIDE_METRICS）：美团{活动补贴,商家活动成本,佣金,配送服务费,打包费,平台佣金,账户余额}；闪购{差评数,账户余额}；汇总{佣金（美团）,配送服务费（美团）,打包费（美团）,平台佣金,配送服务费,账户余额}；并移除「营销」页签。
- 修：汇总「上周同期」只算了美团（闪购 delta 为 BLANK）→ 给 _eleme 营业指标补上周同期计算，汇总 prev = mt+ele。
- 修：闪购商品页改用 ele_order_items 逐单明细（否则只有 7 个商品，鸡腿等丢失）；汇总商品用各平台全量 goods_all 合并后再截前 24。

m01162–m01171 分享包（给朋友的烧烤店）
- 新增 分享说明.md、setup_shop.ps1（替换 shopId/region_id 并写 shop.json）、install_deps.ps1（pip install playwright qrcode pillow）、setup_deepseek.ps1（写 llm_config.json）、make_share_package.ps1（打包到 dist/bbq-helper-YYYYMMDD.zip，排除 data/edge-profile/logs，把「兵哥烧烤」替换为「我的烧烤店」）。
- 成果：C:\Users\24380\Downloads\bbq-helper-20261119.zip（0.13 MB，49 文件）。

m01174–m01325 利润分析与定价结论
- 近7日(11-10~11-16) 240 单：单均毛利 ¥20.05，亏损单仅 2 单(1%)；利润分布 20-30 元 66 单/¥1,582，30+ 37 单/¥1,689。
- 客单价决定利润率：<30元 57单 单均¥7.9(42.2%)；50-80元 85单 ¥23.6(49.6%)；>120元 6单 ¥83.1(58.2%)。
- 平台：美团131单 单均¥19.4(48.1%)；闪购109单 ¥20.8(50.5%)，但扣刷单后美团更赚。
- 计算题结论：食材率53%+固定420+推广200/天，要净利率40%需日收入 ¥8,857（不含刷单）；含刷单3%需¥15,500，含5.5%需¥41,333；刷单≥8%不可能。当前日收入约¥1,615，理论上限净利率 37.4%。

m01339–m01404 系统稳定性（开机弹窗/服务自愈）
- 弹窗来源：计划任务以 powershell.exe 交互运行；改用 wscript.exe + hidden.vbs 隐藏启动；.cmd 包装脚本带 MOTW 会弹「安全警告」→ 删除 task_*.cmd，改为 wscript 直接调 powershell.exe/-File。
- 关键 bug：重建任务时函数参数名用了 $args（PowerShell 自动变量）导致任务参数为空——任务「成功」但什么也没跑；改用 $ArgLine 后修复，看门狗改每 5 分钟。
- 启动脚本改为 pythonw.exe 后台无窗口（start_web.ps1），日志写 logs/web_out.log、web_err.log。
- 桌面启动文件夹快捷方式曾指向已删除的 task_web.cmd → Windows Script Host 80070002 弹窗；改为 hidden.vbs → powershell -File start_web.ps1，并给 hidden.vbs 加 On Error Resume Next，失败写 logs/hidden_error.log。
- Edge「还原页面」气泡：启动参数加 --hide-crash-restore-bubble/--disable-session-crashed-bubble，启动前把 Preferences 的 exit_type 改 Normal、exited_cleanly=true；关闭浏览器先走 CDP 优雅关闭。
- Edge 翻译弹窗：--disable-features=…,Translate,TranslateUI,EdgeTranslate + Preferences "translate":{"enabled":false} + HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Edge EdgeTranslateEnabled=0。
- 计划任务：DSH-Shangpu-Web(登录)、DSH-Shangpu-WebWatch(5min)、DSH-Shangpu-Refresh30(30min)、DSH-Shangpu-Daily(08:30)、DSH-Shangpu-UnblockHourly(15min 清 MOTW)。DSH-Shangpu-Web 是管理员创建，普通权限改不了。

m01413–m01493 二维码/看板细节
- 二维码固定在页面顶部（紧凑横条，62px），/api/qr 每次按 lan_ip() 实时生成；标题区下方新增「成本规则 →」入口。
- 看板「实时/已结算」徽标：range 结束日≥今天 → 实时（橙），否则已结算（灰）。
- 服务若挂，看门狗 5 分钟内自愈；也可双击桌面「打开看板.bat」。

m01511–m01517 美团序号读取
- 确认美团订单接口 JSON 里 orderInfo.unifiedOrderInfo.dayseq（=commonInfo.wm_poi_order_dayseq）就是后台左上角 #N；collect_meituan.parse_order 解析并存 orders.day_sn，历史订单补采 131 单。

m01527–m01532 订单卡片布局微调
- 订单卡片指标从 5 项一行 → 3+3 两行：第一行 商品总价/顾客实付/预计收入/食材成本，第二行 预计利润/利润率/补贴比例；两行字号统一 12/15px。

m01543–m01552 到账总额接入
- 美团「账单对账」frame 选择必须挑 waimaieapp.meituan.com 且文本长度>200 的内层 frame（外层 shell 也有 settleBill 字样但只有菜单）。
- 闪购账单行用 tab 分隔：正则 (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})[ \t]+(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})[ \t]+金额；同日多笔合并求和（11-12 曾同时有 329.13 与 -14.30，合并 314.83）。
- 数据样例：11-16 美团¥565.98/闪购¥363.86；11-15 1122.45/613.41；11-14 927.45/945.62；11-13 806.96/915.01。
- 问答规则 try_settle_query：支持「昨天账单多少」「11月9日到11月16日的结算总额」「美团近7天到账」；无数据时答「账单一般 T+1~T+3 才出」。

m01555–m01776 全量重算与成本纠错
- 用户要求「所有数据按改完的重新算一遍」：近11天(11-06~11-16) 收入¥14,050、食材¥7,214(51.3%)、毛利¥4,408、净利−¥212，8/11 天亏损。
- 近30日若按30天摊固定成本会凭空亏¥7,762 → 改为只按「有数据的天数」摊（fc_start=max(start, 首单日)）。
- 成本纠错：删除误建「一份 ¥6」条目（导致赠品黄瓜算成6元）；赠品行优先按括号内菜品取成本；吊龙 5串/份=6元；广式腊肠/牛板筋/鱿鱼/面筋等改按串；菠萝肉串 2.8/串（删除误建的「碳烤菠萝肉串x2=5.6」）。
- 订单页修复：订单编号显示平台序号；美团前缀色橙、闪购蓝；备注行(微辣/中辣/不要葱花/收藏就送)在明细里过滤。

m01783–m01877 到账总额上线 + 指标精简
- 利润页指标顺序：预计收入、到账总额、食材成本、推广成本、刷单成本、毛利、[成本占收入]、平台佣金(闪购保留)、配送服务费、固定成本、净利润。
- 美团到账总额来自「财务管理→账单对账」（菜单坐标点击 (100,345)，因文本节点含「新」徽标，get_by_text 精确匹配会超时）；闪购来自「财务对账」frame napos-bill-pc.faas.ele.me/napos-bill-pc/v2/bill-checking（文本 tab 分隔）。
- 修：汇总「上周同期」漏闪购；给 _eleme 营业指标补 prev 计算后 汇总 prev = mt+ele（示例：今日1,510.92 vs 上周1,749.33，实为 −13.6%，此前误显示 +85.5%）。
- 隐藏营销页签与指定指标；美团推广「账户余额」也隐藏。

m01880–m01969 商品榜与数据源修正
- 商品页修：闪购商品数据源从 ele_goods 快照改为 ele_order_items 逐单明细（7 个商品→71 个），否则汇总里 鸡腿(11 份=美团2+闪购9) 丢失。
- 汇总商品合并用各平台全量 goods_all（平台页仍只显示前24），合并后再取前24。
- 待办（用户未答复）：是否从商品榜剔除「餐盒」与赠品行（收藏就送/开业特惠）——目前仍会出现在榜单。
Open objectives: 到账总额对 11-19~11-21 未采集，需重启浏览器并重跑 mt_settle.py / ele_settle.py 补齐（m01979）；商品榜是否过滤餐盒/赠品待用户确认（m01968）。"}
